November 26, 2026

Toward Agentic Robotics: A Large-Scale Study of Harness Design for Robot-Use Agents VLA

policy harness VLM reasoning VLA control world-action models agentic robots

简要说明：本文对结合VLM推理与VLA/WAM控制的智能体机器人策略框架设计进行了大规模研究，通过八个基准上的47万次评估，提出参考方案X-Harness，在无需更新权重的情况下将基础策略性能提升最高42.8个百分点。

TLDR: This paper presents a large-scale study of harness designs for agentic robots that combine VLM reasoning with VLA/WAM control, evaluating 470,000 rollouts across eight benchmarks to derive a reference recipe, X-Harness, that improves base policies by up to 42.8 points without weight updates.

Abstract: Recent vision-language models (VLMs) can act as robot-use agents that understand diverse scenes and control robots through policy code and tools. However, they predict 3D gripper poses poorly even with extended reasoning, struggling with precise manipulation. Vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action (WAM) models are the opposite: they execute fast, smooth control on trained tasks, yet fail under domain shifts or when tasks require long-horizon memory and reasoning. Agentic robots therefore combine VLM reasoning and perception with precise VLA/WAM control through a policy harness. Yet harness design spans thousands of configurations, shifting success by tens of points with the same models. Moreover, testing even one design takes thousands of rollouts at high API and GPU cost, so prior works often commit to a single design chosen from few alternatives. To guide harness design, we evaluate over 470,000 rollouts across eight simulation benchmarks, six VLMs, and 15 VLA/WAM checkpoints. Seven controlled studies show effective harnesses must adapt to both VLM and VLA/WAM capabilities. Our findings specify what structure the VLM's policy code needs, where VLA manipulation needs help from tools and policy code, and when to involve the VLM at test time. The reference recipe X-Harness shows that these findings compose without weight updates, lifting base policies up to $+42.8$ points across memory, reasoning, and domain shifts.

摘要（中文）：近期开发的视觉-语言模型（VLM）能够充当机器人智能体，理解多样化场景，并通过策略代码和工具控制机器人。然而，即便经过深度推理，这些模型在预测3D夹爪位姿方面仍表现不佳，难以实现精准操控。视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型和世界-动作（WAM）模型则截然相反：它们能够在已训练任务上执行快速流畅的控制，但在领域迁移或任务需要长时记忆与推理时则表现不佳。因此，智能体机器人通过策略连接器（policy harness）将VLM的推理与感知能力同精准的VLA/WAM控制能力相结合。然而，连接器的设计涉及数千种配置，即便使用相同模型，成功率也可能相差数十个百分点。此外，仅测试一种设计方案就需要数千次滚动执行，消耗高昂的API和GPU成本，因此以往研究往往从少数备选方案中选定单一设计。为了指导连接器设计，我们在八个仿真基准、六个VLM和15个VLA/WAM检查点上进行了超过47万次滚动评估。七项受控研究表明，有效的连接器必须同时适配VLM和VLA/WAM的能力特性。我们的研究结果明确了以下关键问题：VLM策略代码需要怎样的结构、VLA操控在哪些环节需要工具和策略代码的辅助，以及测试时应在何时引入VLM。参考方案X-Harness表明，这些发现无需权重更新即可组合使用，在记忆、推理和领域迁移任务上，可将基础策略的性能提升最高42.8个百分点。

Authors: Yuxiang Lai, Jike Zhong, Yu-Jhe Li, Lan Wang, Chengzhi Liu, Youbao Tang, Ming Li, Xi Xiao, Xiaofeng Yang, Liang Zhao, Zheda Mai, Ruixi Fan

SOLVE: Sparse, Ordered Keyposes Make LLM Agents Versatile and Efficient Robot Manipulator Manipulation

keypose-based policy LLM agent robot manipulation training-free 6-DoF end-effector

简要说明：SOLVE 是一种免训练的多模态 LLM 智能体策略，通过稀疏有序的 6-DoF 关键位姿、运动规划和稀疏深度查询实现机器人操作，在 RoboDojo 和 RoboLab 上达到 SOTA，并在真实机器人零样本任务中以大幅降低的推理成本取得成功。

TLDR: SOLVE is a training-free, multimodal LLM agent policy that writes sparse, ordered 6-DoF keyposes, uses motion planning and sparse depth queries for robot manipulation, achieves state-of-the-art performance on RoboDojo and RoboLab, and demonstrates real-world zero-shot success with significantly reduced inference cost.

Abstract: LLM agents have made remarkable progress in robot manipulation, yet they suffer from expensive inference, dense step-by-step control, and tool bottlenecks. We introduce SOLVE, a training-free, versatile and efficient agent policy: a multimodal LLM agent writes a sparse, ordered sequence of 6-DoF end-effector keyposes per call, observes the result, and writes the next, while a motion planner interpolates between them. The agent decides the number and spacing of keyposes for both fast long-range motion and fine-grained manipulation. This granularity matches the sparsity of teleoperated manipulation: most demonstrations in DROID can be compressed into a few keyposes instead of dense actions. SOLVE grounds keyposes with sparse depth queries answered by noisy sources, such as multi-view triangulation, stereo, or monocular depth, and copes with that noise itself. It also improves from execution feedback, reflecting on its own rollouts and distilling a few rules per task. SOLVE reaches state-of-the-art performance of 74.5% on RoboDojo and 84.5% on RoboLab, with only $1.7 per episode on average, 12x less than previous dense-control agent policies. On a real robot, the same agent achieves an 88% success rate (75 of 85 episodes) over 16 challenging zero-shot tasks. Our project page is at https://serenos.github.io/solve-website.

摘要（中文）：大型语言模型智能体在机器人操作领域取得了显著进展，但仍面临推理成本高昂、逐步密集控制及工具瓶颈等问题。我们提出SOLVE——一种无需训练、通用且高效的智能体策略：多模态大语言模型智能体每次调用时生成一段稀疏的、有序的六自由度末端执行器关键位姿序列，观察执行结果后再生成下一段序列，而运动规划器则负责在这些关键位姿之间进行插值。该智能体可自主决定关键位姿的数量与间隔，以适应快速大范围运动与精细操作的不同需求。这一粒度与遥操作演示的稀疏特性相契合：DROID数据集中的大多数演示可被压缩为若干关键位姿，而非密集动作序列。SOLVE利用多视图三角测量、立体视觉或单目深度等噪声源提供的稀疏深度查询来锚定关键位姿，并能自行应对此类噪声。此外，它还通过执行反馈持续改进，反思自身滚动执行的过程，并为每项任务提炼若干规则。SOLVE在RoboDojo上达到了74.5%的最新最优性能，在RoboLab上达到84.5%，平均每次推演成本仅为1.7美元，比先前的密集控制智能体策略降低了12倍。在实际机器人上，同一智能体在16项具有挑战性的零样本任务中实现了88%的成功率（85次推演中成功75次）。我们的项目页面位于https://serenos.github.io/solve-website。

Authors: Xiang Li, Hongyu Zhou, Ya-Li Li, Tao Li, Rui Zhang, Junjie Lai, Weihua Zhang, Shengjin Wang

ELMO: Emergent Representations In Imitation Learning Via Dynamic Hierarchical Action Chunking VLA

latent action model dynamic action chunking semantic action codes imitation learning VLA planner

简要说明：ELMO 提出了一种端到端框架，通过动态分块轨迹联合训练 VLA 规划器和基于观测的解码器，学习能够捕捉任务级行为意图的语义接地动作编码，在多个基准测试及新的无捷径泛化基准上优于先前方法。

TLDR: ELMO introduces an end-to-end framework that jointly trains a VLA planner and observation-conditioned decoder over dynamically chunked trajectories, learning semantically grounded action codes that capture task-level behavioral intent for robot manipulation, outperforming prior methods on benchmarks and a new shortcut-free generalization benchmark.

Abstract: Robot trajectories naturally decompose into variable-length phases with distinct semantic intents, such as reaching, grasping, and lifting. However, training policies to minimize MSE treats all actions as equal, obscuring their semantic structure. While latent action models attempt to create a structured prediction target by compressing action chunks into latent representations, existing approaches rely on two-stage training and context-blind decoders. Consequently, their representations are context-agnostic motion codes (e.g., "move down") which fail to capture behavioural intent (e.g., "pick up the block"). To overcome these bottlenecks, we introduce the Emergent Latent-action MOdel (ELMO), an end-to-end framework that encodes robot trajectories as grounded semantic codes -- representations that ground task-level behavioural intent in the current environment. ELMO jointly trains a VLA planner and an observation-conditioned decoder over dynamically chunked trajectories, learning a semantically grounded action space without separate pretraining. Across standard benchmarks, ELMO outperforms comparable prior methods by 9.6 percentage points on LIBERO-Plus and by 0.75 in average task length on CALVIN. Furthermore, on Blocks -- our shortcut-free simulation and real-world generalization benchmark -- ELMO reaches a 38.6% success rate while all baselines remain below 5%, demonstrating its ability to capture the semantic structure of demonstrations. Website: https://uoft-isl.github.io/elmo.github.io/

摘要（中文）：机器人轨迹自然分解为具有不同语义意图的可变长度阶段，例如伸向目标、抓取和提起。然而，以最小化均方误差为目标训练策略会将所有动作等同对待，从而掩盖其语义结构。尽管潜在动作模型尝试通过将动作块压缩为潜在表示来构建结构化的预测目标，但现有方法依赖两阶段训练和上下文无关的解码器。因此，其表示是与上下文无关的运动编码（例如“向下移动”），未能捕获行为意图（例如“拿起积木”）。为克服这些瓶颈，我们提出了涌现潜在动作模型（ELMO），这是一种端到端框架，将机器人轨迹编码为基于情境的语义编码——即在当前环境中将任务级行为意图具体化的表示。ELMO在动态分块的轨迹上联合训练VLA规划器和观测条件解码器，无需单独预训练即可学习语义基元化的动作空间。在标准基准测试中，ELMO在LIBERO-Plus上超越同类先前方法9.6个百分点，在CALVIN上的平均任务长度提升0.75。此外，在Blocks——我们构建的无捷径模拟及真实世界泛化基准——中，ELMO达到38.6%的成功率，而所有基线方法均低于5%，展示了其捕获示范语义结构的能力。网站：https://uoft-isl.github.io/elmo.github.io/

Authors: Jasper Gerigk, Yang Xu, Nicholas Rhinehart, Igor Gilitschenski

Nav4Manip: From Navigation to Dexterous Mobile Manipulation through Co-Evolution VLA

dexterous mobile manipulation world-action model co-evolution navigation reinforcement learning from AI feedback

简要说明：Nav4Manip 提出了一种双向往耦合的协同进化系统，用于长距离灵巧移动操作，通过操作反馈改进导航并训练世界动作模型，在基准测试和真实机器人上取得了最佳性能。

TLDR: Nav4Manip introduces a bidirectionally coupled co-evolution system for long-horizon dexterous mobile manipulation, improving navigation with manipulation feedback and training a world-action model for manipulation, achieving SOTA on benchmarks and real robots.

Abstract: Dexterous mobile manipulation is essential for robots to perform useful tasks in complex, unstructured environments. However, existing systems face two challenges. First, navigation remains too coarse for downstream manipulation, which often requires a precise base position and approach orientation rather than merely reaching a meter-scale goal region. Second, navigation and manipulation are commonly trained in isolation, lacking a feedback loop that enables the two capabilities to co-evolve. These limitations prevent current systems from reliably executing long-horizon dexterous mobile-manipulation tasks in real-world environments. To address them, we introduce Nav4Manip, a bidirectionally coupled co-evolution system for long-horizon dexterous mobile manipulation. It comprises two complementary architectures: Nav4Manip-N learns long-horizon navigation and refines its policy through manipulation feedback, while Nav4Manip-M trains a world-action model (WAM) for downstream dexterous manipulation. We train Nav4Manip-N in three stages: multi-task co-tuning learns navigation behavior and manipulation-aware affordance prediction; rejection sampling fine-tuning (RFT) rejects low-quality policy-generated paths and fine-tunes the model on retained trajectories; and reinforcement learning from AI feedback (RLAIF) uses counterfactual preferences to further improve navigation decisions. To support this framework, we establish the Nav-N-Manip benchmark and construct Nav4Manip-Pairs from benchmark rollouts, providing large-scale paired navigation--manipulation trajectories and affordance supervision. Extensive experiments on public vision-language navigation (VLN) benchmarks and Nav-N-Manip demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, while real-world evaluations show that Nav4Manip completes diverse dexterous mobile-manipulation tasks. Project website: https://nav4manip.github.io/.

摘要（中文）：灵巧的移动操作对于机器人在复杂、非结构化环境中执行实用任务至关重要。然而，现有系统面临两大挑战。首先，导航对于下游操作而言仍过于粗糙——操作任务往往需要精确的基座位置和接近姿态，而不仅仅是到达米级的目标区域。其次，导航与操作通常被孤立地训练，缺乏使两种能力协同进化的反馈回路。这些局限性阻碍了现有系统在真实环境中可靠地执行长时程灵巧移动操作任务。为解决上述问题，我们提出Nav4Manip——一个面向长时程灵巧移动操作的双向耦合协同进化系统。该系统包含两种互补架构：Nav4Manip-N学习长时程导航并通过操作反馈优化其策略，而Nav4Manip-M则训练一个世界-动作模型（WAM）用于下游灵巧操作。我们分三个阶段训练Nav4Manip-N：多任务协同微调学习导航行为与操作感知的可行性预测；拒绝采样微调（RFT）拒绝低质量的策略生成路径，并在保留轨迹上微调模型；基于AI反馈的强化学习（RLAIF）利用反事实偏好进一步改进导航决策。为支撑该框架，我们建立了Nav-N-Manip基准测试，并从基准回放中构建Nav4Manip-Pairs数据集，提供大规模配对的导航-操作轨迹及可行性监督。在公开的视觉语言导航（VLN）基准测试和Nav-N-Manip上的大量实验表明，本方法达到了最先进的性能；同时，真实世界评估显示Nav4Manip能够完成多种灵巧移动操作任务。项目网站：https://nav4manip.github.io/。

Authors: Yusen Feng, Zixi Kang, Zhijun Yin, Changxiao Liu, Tianhong Gao, Jiazhao Zhang, Jiahang Liu, Libin Liu, Zhizheng Zhang, He Wang

Compact Vision-Language Navigation in Continuous Environmentsvia On-Policy Training and Route-Bearing Output VLN

Vision-Language Navigation on-policy training route-bearing output compact policy continuous environments

简要说明：本文提出了一种紧凑的2B参数视觉语言导航策略，通过在线策略训练和路线方位输出，在连续环境中取得了优异性能，同时可在单个消费级GPU上高效训练和运行。

TLDR: This paper introduces a compact 2B-parameter Vision-Language Navigation policy that uses on-policy training and route-bearing output to achieve strong results in continuous environments while being efficient to train and run on a single consumer GPU.

Abstract: Instruction-following robots need navigation policies that reach high accuracy and remain inexpensive to train and to run on a single graphics processing unit (GPU). The most accurate vision-language navigation policies for continuous environments rely on language models with 4 to 8 billion parameters, long observation histories, and large auxiliary corpora. Two properties of the standard training setup limit smaller policies. Imitation labels cover the states that an expert visits, whereas the running policy reaches states that its own errors produce. In addition, an image-plane waypoint exists only while the route lies inside the camera view. We present \textbf{\paper}, a monocular red-green-blue (RGB) policy with 2 billion (2B) parameters that addresses both limitations. \paper adapts Qwen3-VL-2B with low-rank adapters and processes an eight-frame memory and the current view in one forward pass. The policy predicts the route direction as a bearing in the body frame of the agent, which remains defined for every heading, and a deterministic controller converts this bearing into motion. This design allows training to relabel the states that the policy itself visits. On-policy correction improves success, while bearing decoding outperforms image-plane waypoint scanning across all evaluated start headings with identical weights. On the \valunseen split, \paper achieves \rFinSR\% success on Room-to-Room in Continuous Environments (\rtor), averaged over three seeds, and \rRxFinSR\% on its Room-Across-Room counterpart (\rxr). Inference requires \rDecMs\,ms and \rInferGB\,GiB of memory, while training takes \rCostTrainTyp\ GPU-hours on one 12\,GB consumer GPU.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 指令跟随机器人需要具备高精度的导航策略，同时该策略在单个图形处理器（GPU）上训练和运行的成本也应保持低廉。在连续环境中，最精确的视觉-语言导航策略依赖于参数量为40亿至80亿的语言模型、较长的观测历史以及大规模辅助语料库。标准训练设置的两个特性限制了较小策略的性能。一是模仿标签仅覆盖专家访问过的状态，而运行中的策略所到达的状态则是由其自身误差产生的；二是图像平面中的路径点仅在路径位于相机视野内时才存在。我们提出了\textbf{\paper}，一种参数量为20亿（2B）的单目红绿蓝（RGB）策略，旨在解决上述两个限制。\paper采用低秩适配器对Qwen3-VL-2B进行适配，并在一次前向传播中处理八帧记忆和当前视图。该策略将路线方向预测为智能体机体坐标系中的方位角，该方位角对任意朝向均有定义，并由确定性控制器将该方位角转换为运动指令。这一设计使得训练能够对策略自身访问的状态进行重新标注。在策略上进行纠正可提升成功率，而方位角解码在所有评估起始朝向下均优于使用相同权重的图像平面路径点扫描。在\valunseen划分上，\paper在连续环境房间到房间（\rtor）任务中实现了\rFinSR\%的成功率（基于三个种子的平均值），并在其Room-Across-Room（\rxr）对应任务中实现了\rRxFinSR\%的成功率。推理时所需时间为\rDecMs\,ms，内存占用为\rInferGB\,GiB，而训练在单个12\,GB消费级GPU上仅需\rCostTrainTyp\ GPU小时。

Authors: Reshad Ul Karim, Syeda Maliha Tabassum, Md. Khalilur Rhaman, Md Rashad Al Hasan Rony

M$^{2}$AdaptVLA: Multimodal Memory-Augmented Vision-Language-Action Model with Predictive Test-Time Adaptation VLA

Vision-Language-Action Model Multimodal Memory Test-Time Adaptation Wrench Memory Robotic Manipulation

简要说明：M2AdaptVLA 提出了一种集成多模态（视觉与力觉）记忆与预测性测试时自适应的视觉-语言-动作模型，在真实世界接触敏感操作任务中取得了显著成功率提升。

TLDR: M2AdaptVLA introduces a vision-language-action model with multimodal (visual and wrench) memory and predictive test-time adaptation, achieving significant success-rate gains in real-world contact-sensitive robotic manipulation tasks.

Abstract: Effective robotic manipulation calls for multimodal memory and rapid adaptation to shifts in contact dynamics. However, many existing policies, which retain either visual or wrench history, may miss key cues from the other modality. Moreover, even with wrench memory, fixed policies can struggle when contact conditions shift at deployment. To this end, we introduce M$^{2}$AdaptVLA, a vision-language-action model that integrates visual and wrench memories with predictive test-time adaptation. For visual memory, the model uses test-time training (TTT) to encode observation history in fast weights. Each entry in the bounded TTT bank combines the corresponding frame's features with a readout from these weights, preserving cues that predate the oldest retained frame. For wrench memory, a context gate controls how much the action expert draws on wrench history as it jointly denoises future actions and wrenches. For predictive test-time adaptation, the auxiliary wrench prediction loss also provides online self-supervision. Using measured wrenches as targets, we update low-rank policy adapters by backpropagating only through the final denoising step. Real-world experiments show that the TTT bank outperforms visual memory baselines on progress tracking, scene recall, and demonstration following. On contact-sensitive tasks, the context gate yields higher success rates than direct injection or gated cross-attention. Predictive test-time adaptation improves robustness to shifts in contact dynamics. On eight tasks requiring visual and wrench memory, M$^{2}$AdaptVLA achieves a mean success rate of 82.71%, a 31.46% absolute gain over the strongest baseline. The project page is available at https://tlf-tlf.github.io/M2AdaptVLAPage/.

摘要（中文）：有效的机器人操作需要多模态记忆和对接触动力学变化的快速适应能力。然而，许多现有策略仅保留视觉或力觉历史信息，可能遗漏另一种模态中的关键线索。此外，即使具备力觉记忆，固定策略在部署阶段接触条件发生变化时也可能难以应对。为此，我们提出M$^{2}$AdaptVLA，一种集成视觉与力觉记忆并具备预测性测试时适应的视觉-语言-动作模型。在视觉记忆方面，该模型采用测试时训练（TTT）将观测历史编码到快速权重中。有界TTT记忆库中的每个条目将该帧的特征与从这些权重中读取的信息相结合，从而保留早于最旧保留帧的线索。在力觉记忆方面，上下文门控控制动作专家在联合去噪未来动作和力觉信息时，从力觉历史中提取信息的程度。在预测性测试时适应方面，辅助力觉预测损失同时提供在线自监督信号。利用测量到的力觉数据作为目标，仅通过最终去噪步骤进行反向传播，更新低秩策略适配器。真实世界实验表明，TTT记忆库在进度跟踪、场景回忆和示范遵循方面优于视觉记忆基线。在接触敏感任务中，上下文门控相比直接注入或门控交叉注意力取得了更高的成功率。预测性测试时适应增强了对接触动力学变化的鲁棒性。在八项需要视觉和力觉记忆的任务中，M$^{2}$AdaptVLA实现了82.71%的平均成功率，较最强基线高出31.46个百分点。项目页面见 https://tlf-tlf.github.io/M2AdaptVLAPage/。

Authors: Liufan Tan, Tong Wang, Yuehao Yin, Jian Chen, Yihang Yin, Ying Qu, Wenyu Li, Ruyi Gan, Hao Wang

HoloBrain-0.5 Technical Report VLA

vision-language-action (VLA) cross-embodiment manipulation action diffusion residual finite scalar quantization (FSQ) humanoid robot control

简要说明：HoloBrain-0.5 是一系列用于跨本体操控的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，基于超过10,000小时的多样化数据进行训练。它包含连续和离散动作生成两种变体，在仿真和真实机器人任务（包括人形机器人控制）中表现出色。

TLDR: HoloBrain-0.5 is a family of vision-language-action (VLA) models for cross-embodiment manipulation, trained on 10,000+ hours of diverse data. It introduces continuous and discrete action-generation variants, demonstrating strong performance in simulation and real-robot tasks, including humanoid control.

Abstract: We present HoloBrain-0.5, a family of vision-language-action (VLA) models for manipulation across robot embodiments. The policies plan in a shared action space using robot state, kinematic structure, and calibrated camera observations. We standardize joint axes, coordinate frames, and tool-center points in robot descriptions (URDFs) and encode their kinematic graphs in a shared 3D representation. HoloBrain-0.5-Continuous generates action chunks by diffusion, while HoloBrain-0.5-Discrete uses residual finite scalar quantization (FSQ) and delayed autoregression. We pretrain both policies on over 10,000 hours of real-robot, simulation, and human-manipulation data spanning 15 embodiment categories. Across six closed-loop simulation settings, the discrete policy converges faster and reaches a higher mean success rate than the continuous policy (56.77% vs. 49.71%). On seven real-robot tasks, it achieves a mean progress score of 87.76% without task-specific post-training. After post-training, the continuous policy outperforms $π_{0.5}$ on the seven-task benchmark (94.52% vs. 86.25%) and an 11-task dual-arm benchmark (79.07% vs. 69.41%). The discrete-initialized continuous policy transfers five tasks zero-shot from Piper to Piper-X, scoring 63.28% on average. With target-robot demonstrations, the continuous policy scores 89.2% on Franka Panda and 92.94% on a mobile dual-arm platform. Although pretraining includes no Unitree G1 data, post-training with limited G1 demonstrations yields a mean progress score of 70.24% across three humanoid tasks, compared with 11.00% for $π_{0.5}$.

摘要（中文）：我们提出HoloBrain-0.5，这是一个面向跨机器人本体操作的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型系列。该策略在共享动作空间中，利用机器人状态、运动学结构及标定相机观测进行规划。我们统一了机器人描述文件（URDF）中的关节轴、坐标系及工具中心点，并将其运动学图编码至共享三维表示中。HoloBrain-0.5-Continuous通过扩散生成动作块，而HoloBrain-0.5-Discrete采用残差有限标量量化（FSQ）和延迟自回归。我们对两种策略均在超过10,000小时的真实机器人、仿真及人类操作数据上进行了预训练，涵盖15种本体类别。 在六项闭环仿真设置中，离散策略收敛更快，平均成功率更高（56.77%对49.71%）。在七项真实机器人任务中，无需任务特定后训练即可达到87.76%的平均进度得分。经过后训练，连续策略在七任务基准上优于π₀.₅（94.52%对86.25%），并在十一任务双臂基准上表现更佳（79.07%对69.41%）。由离散初始化后的连续策略可从Piper零样本迁移五个任务至Piper-X，平均得分为63.28%。利用目标机器人演示数据，连续策略在Franka Panda上得分为89.2%，在移动双臂平台上为92.94%。尽管预训练未包含Unitree G1数据，但在有限G1演示下的后训练仍使三项人形任务的平均进度得分达到70.24%，而π₀.₅仅为11.00%。

Authors: Xuewu Lin, Jiahao Wang, Jiawei Li, Mengdi Li, Zhengmao Sun, Yiwei Jin, Hongyu Xie, Zhengyang Feng, Kun Wu, Zihao Chen, Lianzhou Zhang, Lichao Huang, Zhizhong Su

Rehearse in 3D, Render in 2D: Physically Consistent and Editable Robot World Models WorldModel

world model 3D interaction rehearsal video generation point-flow physical consistency

简要说明：RehearsalWorld 提出了一种物理一致且可编辑的机器人世界模型，利用预训练点流模型进行三维交互预演，细化预测轨迹，并通过几何投影对齐视频生成器合成真实交互视频，在真实 DROID 抓取序列上提升了物理一致性和视频预测性能。

TLDR: RehearsalWorld introduces a physically consistent and editable robot world model that uses 3D interaction rehearsal with a pretrained point-flow model to refine predicted trajectories and then aligns a video generator with geometric projections for realistic video synthesis, improving physical consistency and video prediction on real DROID grasping sequences.

Abstract: Embodied world models aim to predict future interactions that are both visually realistic and physically consistent. Yet explicit 3D motion prediction alone does not guarantee that object structure and contact relationships are preserved. Beyond motion prediction, 3D representations provide an explicit state space for imposing structural and physical constraints. Building on this insight, we introduce RehearsalWorld, an editable robot world model driven by 3D Interaction Rehearsal (3DIR). Given an initial RGB-D observation and robot actions, Interaction-Consistent Rehearsal (ICR) uses a pretrained 3D point-flow model as a motion prior. It refines the predicted trajectories through response-aware object grouping, persistent grasp memory, and contact structure refiner, preserving scene stability, object structure, and grasp attachments. Rehearsal-Aligned Video Generation (RAVG) then uses geometric projections of the rehearsal as temporal conditioning. We fine-tune a video generator on projection-video pairs to synthesize realistic interaction videos. Thanks to the decoupling of physical response from visual synthesis, RehearsalWorld also supports independent editing of material properties and camera viewpoints. Compared with PointWorld on real DROID grasping sequences, RehearsalWorld reduces gripper-relative offset by approximately 79% to 84% across deformable, articulated, and rigid objects and lowers reference motion error. For video prediction, it achieves a PSNR of 23.92 dB and an FVD of 149.

摘要（中文）：具身世界模型旨在预测既视觉逼真又物理一致的未来交互。然而，仅靠显式的3D运动预测并不能保证物体结构和接触关系得以保持。在运动预测之外，3D表示提供了一个显式的状态空间，用于施加结构性和物理性约束。基于这一洞见，我们提出了RehearsalWorld——一种由3D交互排练（3DIR）驱动的可编辑机器人世界模型。给定初始RGB-D观测和机器人动作，交互一致性排练（ICR）利用预训练的3D点流模型作为运动先验，通过响应感知的物体分组、持久抓取记忆和接触结构优化器来细化预测轨迹，从而保持场景稳定性、物体结构和抓取附着关系。随后，排练对齐视频生成（RAVG）将排练的几何投影作为时间条件，我们在投影-视频对上微调视频生成器，以合成逼真的交互视频。由于物理响应与视觉合成的解耦，RehearsalWorld还支持对材质属性和相机视角的独立编辑。与PointWorld在真实DROID抓取序列上的对比表明，RehearsalWorld在可变形物体、关节物体和刚性物体上将夹爪相对偏移降低了约79%至84%，并降低了参考运动误差。在视频预测方面，其PSNR达到23.92 dB，FVD达到149。

Authors: Guangyu Liu, Hanzhang Wang, Huijia Zhang, Hanbei Zhan, Linjie Hu, Bin Xiao, Xuan Zhou, Dong Zhang, Hanwei Liu

CoTacWAM: Joint Modeling of Vision and Touch for Robotic Manipulation Manipulation

world-action model visuotactile robotic manipulation contact semantics autonomous retries

简要说明：本文提出了CoTacWAM，一种联合学习腕部视觉与触觉共享接触语义的世界-动作模型，在真实世界任务中展示了改进的操作性能、对缺失输入的鲁棒性以及自主重试带来的收益。

TLDR: This paper introduces CoTacWAM, a world-action model that jointly learns shared contact semantics from wrist vision and touch for robotic manipulation, demonstrating improved performance, robustness to missing inputs, and benefits from autonomous retries on real-world tasks.

Abstract: We present CoTacWAM, a world-action model that learns shared contact semantics between wrist vision and touch, achieving the best observed performance in our nominal manipulation and missing-input evaluations. The two modalities observe the same local interaction through different signals: wrist images reveal nearby geometry, while touch records physical contact. Our approach connects their common contact meaning while preserving the evidence unique to each modality, giving the policy a joint description of interaction across available input combinations. This representation supports predictive action learning alongside head-view scene context and conditions corrections after an independent detector confirms a failed attempt. Experiments across four real-world tasks demonstrate improved manipulation performance over the evaluated baselines, robustness to missing local observations, and further gains from autonomous retries.

摘要（中文）：我们提出了CoTacWAM，一种世界动作模型，它在腕部视觉与触觉之间学习共享的接触语义，在名义操作和缺失输入评估中取得了所观测到的最佳性能。这两种模态通过不同的信号观察相同的局部交互：腕部图像揭示邻近几何信息，而触觉则记录物理接触。我们的方法连接了它们共同的接触含义，同时保留了每种模态所独有的证据，为策略提供了跨可用输入组合的交互联合描述。这一表示支持在头部视角场景情境下进行预测性动作学习，并在独立检测器确认尝试失败后调节修正操作。跨四个真实世界任务的实验表明，与评估的基线相比，操作性能得到了提升，对局部观测缺失具有鲁棒性，并且通过自主重试获得了进一步的增益。

Authors: Lei Jin, Yiding Ma, Zhuohang Li, Jiachen Liu, Zibo Zhu, Kairui Liu, Chen Gao, Wei Wu, Yong Li

SEEK: Self-Evolution through Execution Knowledge for Agentic Robot Manipulation Manipulation

agentic framework self-evolving programmatic policy persistent action-effect bank robot manipulation execution knowledge

简要说明：SEEK 是一种智能体式框架，通过自进化程序化策略和持久动作-效果库，使机器人操作策略能够在多次尝试中保留和复用执行知识，从而在无需模型微调的情况下提升性能。

TLDR: SEEK is an agentic framework that enables robot manipulation policies to retain and reuse execution knowledge across attempts via a self-evolving programmatic policy and a persistent action-effect bank, improving performance without model fine-tuning.

Abstract: General-purpose multimodal foundation models enable robots to adapt during deployment from observations and execution feedback, without task-specific demonstrations or training. However, the robot retains what it learns only in the model's working context. Once the task ends, it loses this execution knowledge, such as how to carry a bowl between two grippers. On the next attempt at the task, the robot may take just as long and repeat the same mistakes. To avoid this repetition, robots must retain execution knowledge across attempts. Yet replaying past actions is insufficient, because their effects depend on the current conditions. Procedures that determine actions from the current scene address this, but when they meet conditions that earlier attempts did not cover, revising them requires the measured effects of earlier actions. We therefore propose SEEK, an agentic framework that retains both, enabling robots to improve across attempts while keeping the underlying model fixed. To adapt retained knowledge to the current scene, SEEK adopts a Self-Evolving Programmatic Policy (SEPP) that encodes manipulation as executable procedures and determines each action from current observations. As the robot executes these procedures, SEEK records the measured effects of its actions, including those from failed attempts, in a Persistent Action-Effect Bank (PAEB). Where a retained procedure applies, it acts without a model request; where it meets a condition it does not cover, this evidence guides its revision. On RoboDojo, knowledge retained over ten attempts raises SEEK's average task score from 27.0 to 54.4 and its success rate from 19.7% to 48.0% across all 42 tasks. On 34 of these tasks with GPT-6.2 Astra, SEEK reaches 80.1 after five attempts, against 49.6 for the same model acting directly, and uses 77.6% fewer model requests. https://zeyangguan.github.io/SEEK-Agentic-Robot-Manipulation/

摘要（中文）：通用多模态基础模型使机器人能够在部署期间根据观察和执行反馈进行适应，而无需特定任务的演示或训练。然而，机器人仅将所学内容保留在模型的工作上下文中。一旦任务结束，它便会丢失这类执行知识，例如如何在两个夹爪之间搬运一只碗。在下一次尝试该任务时，机器人可能仍需要同样长的时间，并重复相同的错误。为避免这种重复，机器人必须跨尝试保留执行知识。然而，仅重放过去的动作是不够的，因为其效果取决于当前条件。能够根据当前场景确定动作的程序可以解决这一问题，但当它们遇到先前尝试未覆盖的条件时，对其进行修订需要先前动作的实测效果。因此，我们提出SEEK，一个智能体框架，可同时保留以上两者，使机器人能够在保持底层模型不变的情况下跨尝试持续改进。为将保留的知识适配至当前场景，SEEK采用一种自进化程序化策略（SEPP），将操作编码为可执行程序，并根据当前观察确定每个动作。当机器人执行这些程序时，SEEK将其实测动作效果（包括失败尝试的效果）记录在持久动作—效果库（PAEB）中。在保留程序适用的场景中，机器人无需调用模型即可执行；当遇到程序未覆盖的条件时，这些证据将指导程序的修订。在RoboDojo上，跨十次尝试保留的知识使SEEK在所有42项任务上的平均任务得分从27.0提升至54.4，成功率从19.7%提升至48.0%。在其中的34项任务中，使用GPT-6.2 Astra时，SEEK在五次尝试后达到80.1分，而同一模型直接执行时为49.6分，且模型调用次数减少了77.6%。https://zeyangguan.github.io/SEEK-Agentic-Robot-Manipulation/

Authors: Zeyang Guan, Qihao Zhao, Rui Gong, Zhang Haitian, Yalun Dai, Yangyu Huang, Lingao Xiao, Haozhe Du, Xuehui Yu, Ye Lu, Jianjun Gao, Ruoyu Wang, Haowen Bai, Hao Li, Scarlett Li, Kim-Hui Yap

X-World: Transferring Video Priors to Cross-Embodiment Robot Control VLA

video diffusion cross-embodiment action chunking flow-matching bimanual manipulation

简要说明：X-World 将预训练视频扩散模型适配到跨具身机器人控制中，利用 Q-Former 和流匹配专家预测动作块，在 LIBERO 和真实双臂 UR5e 任务上表现优异。

TLDR: X-World adapts pretrained video diffusion to cross-embodiment robot control, using a Q-Former and flow-matching expert to predict action chunks from video priors, demonstrating strong performance on LIBERO and real bimanual UR5e tasks.

Abstract: Language-instructed manipulation requires robust closedloop policies, yet action-labeled robot trajectories are costly and limited in coverage. Human and robot videos provide complementary spatiotemporal priors for crossembodiment control. We propose X-World, which adapts pretrained video diffusion to variable views. A Q-Former compresses hidden states into tokens for a shared flowmatching expert that predicts action chunks. Datasetspecific projections map native states and actions. We adapt the backbone on large-scale robot and human videos, freeze it for action-only pretraining of the Q-Former and action expert, then post-train on the target platform. At inference, X-World responds at 20 Hz and overlaps updates with execution via asynchronous real-time chunking. X-World performs strongly on LIBERO and under zero-shot shifts on LIBERO-Plus. On hardware, it averages 81.7% success across six bimanual tasks on the side-mounted dual-arm UR5e, one of three real-robot configurations presented.

摘要（中文）：语言指令操控要求具备鲁棒的闭环策略，然而带有动作标注的机器人轨迹数据成本高昂且覆盖范围有限。人类与机器人视频为跨具身控制提供了互补的时空先验信息。我们提出X-World，该方法将预训练的视频扩散模型适配到可变视角。Q-Former将隐藏状态压缩为令牌，供共享的流匹配专家网络使用，以预测动作块。数据集特定的投影模块将原生状态与动作映射到统一空间。我们在大规模机器人与人类视频上对骨干网络进行适配，冻结其后仅对Q-Former和动作专家网络进行动作预训练，随后在目标平台上进行后训练。推理时，X-World以20 Hz的频率响应，并通过异步实时分块将更新与执行重叠。X-World在LIBERO基准上表现优异，并在LIBERO-Plus的零样本迁移场景下同样表现出色。在硬件实验中，X-World在侧装双臂UR5e平台上（所展示的三种真实机器人配置之一）六项双臂任务的平均成功率达到81.7%。

Authors: Chun Gu, Xiaofei Wei, Yiming Chen, Juntong Zhang, Li Zhang

Keep or Roll Back? Out-of-Loop Judges for Self-Improving VLA and End-to-End Embodied Policies VLA

self-improving policy out-of-loop judge VLA end-to-end embodied policy evaluation framework

简要说明：SealedLoop 引入了一个循环外的密封评估器来可靠地评估自我改进的具身策略，区分了评估器错误与迁移差距，并在 LIBERO 操作、NAVSIM 驾驶和真实车辆上验证，表明循环内证据不足以判断策略是否改进。

TLDR: SealedLoop introduces a sealed (out-of-loop) judge to robustly evaluate self-improving embodied policies, separating judge error from transfer gap and validating on LIBERO manipulation, NAVSIM driving, and a real vehicle, showing in-loop evidence is insufficient for deciding policy improvement.

Abstract: Self-improvement is now a practical recipe for embodied policies: a policy collects experience, is retrained, and is kept when a judge rates it higher. However, the judge is usually trained or chosen inside the same loop, so its evidence is not independent of the policy. We introduce SealedLoop, an evaluation framework that adds a sealed judge: an evaluator outside the loop that the improver cannot see or optimize against. A new policy is kept only when a sequential test on the sealed judge confirms the gain, with a bounded probability of keeping a worse one. Running the same loop under each judge, we separate two sources of a false gain, which we call judge error (the loop's judge is wrong on its own data) and transfer gap (a real gain there does not carry over to unseen conditions). We evaluate on LIBERO manipulation, NAVSIM driving, and a full-scale real vehicle. In manipulation, a success classifier accepted 65 of 196 failures in one generation. In driving, policies that gain on the loop's own frames lose in an unseen city, so even an exact in-loop judge would keep 8/15 of them. When the sealed test decides, a driving loop built to improve ends with a better policy than under its own critic (0.674 against 0.649 PDMS, from 0.638), and on driving pairs with known sealed gain the test accepted 11 of 12 real gains and none of 59 losses. In a real-world field experiment on a published improvement step, the reinforced version drove further into a curve than the version it started from in all 6 blind pairs, though neither completed it. These results show that evidence from inside the loop, however accurate, is not enough to decide whether a policy has improved. SealedLoop offers a foundation for trustworthy self-improvement of embodied policies, in which progress is judged by evidence the improving system cannot influence.

摘要（中文）：自我改进如今已成为具身策略的一种实用方法：策略收集经验、重新训练，并在评估者给出更高评分时予以保留。然而，评估者通常是在同一循环内部训练或选择的，因此其证据并非独立于策略本身。我们提出SealedLoop，一种评估框架，引入“密封评估者”——即循环外部的评估者，改进者无法看到它，也无法针对其进行优化。只有当对密封评估者的序贯检验确认改进效果时，新策略才会被保留，同时保留较差策略的概率有界。在每种评估者下运行相同的循环，我们区分了虚假改进的两个来源，分别称为“评估者误差”（循环内部的评估者在其自身数据上判断错误）和“迁移差距”（循环内部的真实改进在未见条件下无法保持）。我们在LIBERO操作任务、NAVSIM驾驶任务以及全尺寸真实车辆上进行了评估。在操作任务中，一个成功分类器在一代中接受了196个失败样本中的65个。在驾驶任务中，在循环自身帧上获得增益的策略在未见城市中表现下降，因此即使是精确的循环内评估者，也会保留15个中的8个。当由密封检验做最终决定时，一个为改进而构建的驾驶循环最终得到的策略优于其自身评论者所评定的策略（PDMS从0.638提升至0.674，对比0.649）；在已知密封增益的驾驶策略对中，该检验接受了12个真实增益中的11个，且未接受59个损失中的任何一个。在一项针对已发表改进步骤的真实场景野外实验中，强化版本在所有6组盲测配对中都比其起始版本更深入地驶入弯道，尽管两者均未完成该弯道。这些结果表明，循环内部的证据无论多么精确，都不足以判断策略是否真正改进。SealedLoop为具身策略的可信自我改进提供了基础，在该框架中，进展由改进系统无法影响的证据来判定。

Authors: Zilin Huang, Zhengyang Wan, Kangan Qian, Zihao Sheng, Sikai Chen

FreshVLA: Frequency-Regularized Time Scale Hierarchical Latent Actions for Vision-Language-Action Models VLA

Vision-Language-Action latent actions frequency-domain regularization flow-matching hierarchical action representation

简要说明：FreshVLA 提出了一种频率引导、动态敏感的学习范式，用于从无动作视频中获取时间层次化的连续潜在动作，从而提升 VLA 策略学习，并在 LIBERO、CALVIN 和真实世界实验中取得领先结果。

TLDR: FreshVLA introduces a frequency-guided, dynamics-sensitive learning paradigm for acquiring temporally hierarchical continuous latent actions from action-free videos, improving VLA policy learning and achieving state-of-the-art results on LIBERO, CALVIN, and real-world experiments.

Abstract: Learning reusable latent actions from action-free videos offers an effective route to improving Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies. However, reconstruction-oriented latent actions do not necessarily benefit policy learning: as they may encode task-irrelevant static appearance with scene identity, or entangle slowly varying task progress with fine-grained execution dynamics in limited discrete code. We propose FreshVLA, a VLA framework built on a frequency-guided, dynamics-sensitive learning paradigm for acquiring temporally hierarchical continuous latent actions. FreshVLA uses a high-pass prior to guide visual transition encoding toward dynamical regions, thereby reducing reliance on static appearance cues. It further organizes latent actions into coarse-grained task progress and fine-grained execution dynamics through cross-timescale sampling and frequency-domain regularization, enhancing their capacity to represent long-horizon behaviors. During policy training, we freeze the pretrained latent action encoder and transfer its representations to robot control through joint flow-matching of latent and robot actions. FreshVLA achieves 98.2% average success on LIBERO and 98.0% on LIBERO-Long, exceeding GR00T-N1.6 on the latter by 3.6%. It also reaches an average sequence length of 4.52 on CALVIN and strong overall success rate of 80.4% in the zero-shot LIBERO-PLUS evaluation. Furthermore, FreshVLA exhibits greater robustness to visual perturbations and a more distinct division of roles between two branches in modeling low- and high-frequency motion, respectively. In 35-step action regression, it achieves a 51.3-percentage-point higher relative error reduction than its hierarchical discrete counterpart. Real-world experiments demonstrate that FreshVLA improves the average success rate over $π_{0.5}$ by 7.5%. The FreshVLA project page is available at https://freshvla.github.io/.

摘要（中文）：从无动作视频中学习可复用的潜在动作为提升视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略提供了一条有效途径。然而，面向重建的潜在动作并不必然有利于策略学习：因为它们可能编码与任务无关的静态外观及场景身份信息，或者在有限的离散编码中将缓慢变化的任务进度与细粒度的执行动态纠缠在一起。我们提出FreshVLA，一个基于频率引导、动态感知学习范式的VLA框架，用于获取时间层次化的连续潜在动作。FreshVLA利用高通先验引导视觉转移编码聚焦于动态区域，从而减少对静态外观线索的依赖。它进一步通过跨时间尺度采样和频域正则化，将潜在动作组织为粗粒度的任务进度与细粒度的执行动态，增强其表征长时程行为的能力。在策略训练阶段，我们冻结预训练的潜在动作编码器，并通过潜在动作与机器人动作的联合流匹配将其表征迁移至机器人控制。FreshVLA在LIBERO上达到98.2%的平均成功率，在LIBERO-Long上达到98.0%，后者较GR00T-N1.6高出3.6%。在CALVIN上，FreshVLA达到平均序列长度4.52，并在零样本LIBERO-PLUS评估中取得80.4%的强整体成功率。此外，FreshVLA对视觉扰动表现出更强的鲁棒性，两个分支在建模低频与高频运动方面呈现出更明确的分工。在35步动作回归中，其相对误差降低幅度比层次化离散对应方法高出51.3个百分点。真实世界实验表明，FreshVLA相较于π0.5将平均成功率提升了7.5%。FreshVLA项目页面可在https://freshvla.github.io/获取。

Authors: Jiaming Liang, Yifeng Zhan, Rongyi He, Mu Li, Jiaqi Fan, Zhiyuan Zhang, Qiwei Liang, Zhengjie Zhang, Boyang Cai, Ningyuan Zhang, Xingjian Jing, Qiang Nie

SplatWAM: Splatting World Action Models for Real-Time 3D Imagination WorldModel

3D Gaussian Splatting World Action Model Flow Matching Policy Robot Manipulation Generative Dynamics

简要说明：SplatWAM提出了一种直接在3D高斯原语上学习动作条件动态的生成式世界动作模型，能够快速渲染新视角，并作为机器人策略主干，在LIBERO任务上超越更大型的VLA模型。

TLDR: SplatWAM introduces a generative world action model that predicts future 3D Gaussian primitives directly, enabling fast novel-view rendering and serving as a robot policy backbone, outperforming larger VLA models on LIBERO tasks.

Abstract: World models typically predict future observations in pixel or latent space, limiting their ability to directly represent true 3D scene evolution. We present SplatWAM (Splatting World Action Model), a generative world model that learns action-conditioned dynamics directly over compact 3D Gaussian primitives. A tokenizer SplatWAM-T first encodes a variable number of unposed views into a fixed budget of Gaussian tokens. A dynamics model SplatWAM-D then predicts future Gaussian states in a single forward pass per action, using log-Euclidean covariance coordinates and differentiable rendering supervision to facilitate learning in an explicit 3D space. Each predicted state can be rasterized from arbitrary viewpoints, enforcing a shared 3D representation across views by construction. On OGBench Scene, SplatWAM renders novel views 12x faster than video world models (~80 FPS on an RTX 5090) with up to 2.0 dB higher PSNR. We further introduce SplatWAM-P, a lightweight flow-matching policy head jointly trained with the dynamics model. Across 8 task suites, model-free Gaussian-token policies outperform pixel-based counterparts by up to 24.8 percentage points. SplatWAM-P improves over Latent Particle World Model (LPWM) by 12 percentage points and matches HIQL without a learned value function. On LIBERO, our ~1B model outperforms WorldVLA (~7B) and the robot-pretrained OpenVLA (~7B), while matching OpenVLA-OFT when both are trained without large-scale robot pretraining. Code and checkpoints will be released.

摘要（中文）：世界模型通常在像素或潜在空间中预测未来观察结果，这限制了它们直接表示真实三维场景演变的能力。我们提出了SplatWAM（三维高斯泼溅世界行动模型），一种生成式世界模型，直接在紧凑的三维高斯原语上学习以行动为条件的动态。分词器SplatWAM-T首先将可变数量的无位姿视图编码为固定数量的高斯令牌。动态模型SplatWAM-D随后在每个行动的单次前向传播中预测未来高斯状态，利用对数-欧几里得协方差坐标和可微渲染监督，以促进在显式三维空间中的学习。每个预测状态可以从任意视点进行光栅化，从而通过构造在不同视图间强制共享统一的三维表示。在OGBench Scene上，SplatWAM渲染新视图的速度比视频世界模型快12倍（在RTX 5090上约80帧/秒），峰值信噪比（PSNR）最高提升2.0分贝。我们进一步引入了SplatWAM-P，一个轻量级的流匹配策略头，与动态模型联合训练。在8个任务套件中，无模型的高斯令牌策略相比基于像素的对应方法最高提升24.8个百分点。SplatWAM-P相较于潜在粒子世界模型（LPWM）提升12个百分点，并在无学习价值函数的情况下达到与HIQL相当的性能。在LIBERO上，我们约10亿参数的模型优于WorldVLA（约70亿参数）和经过机器人预训练的OpenVLA（约70亿参数），同时在没有大规模机器人预训练的情况下与OpenVLA-OFT性能相当。代码和检查点将公开发布。

Authors: Frank Tsu-Fang Lu, Karthik Sundar Senthilkumar, Christopher Thirgood, Oscar Mendez, Simon Hadfield

Was the Model Given the Right Action? Auditing and Repairing Action Interfaces in Navigation World Models WorldModel

action conditioning world model rollout action encoding navigation world model input repair

简要说明：本文审计并修复了导航世界模型（NWM）中的动作编码不匹配问题，表明纠正输入准备可将视觉预测误差降低42%，并引入了用于检测和修复此类不匹配的工具ActRosetta。

TLDR: This paper audits and repairs action encoding mismatches in Navigation World Models (NWM), showing that correcting input preparation reduces visual prediction error by 42% and introduces ActRosetta, a tool for detecting and repairing such mismatches.

Abstract: World models are evaluated by predicting future observations from actions. These evaluations assume that actions are prepared the same way as during training, but an unchecked mismatch can make a model appear less accurate than it is. We audit this assumption in Navigation World Models (NWM) and find three interacting differences between its training and rollout code. Correcting the inputs, without retraining, reduces mean visual prediction error by 42%, measured with DreamSim on the RECON navigation dataset. The correction also changes the ranking of NWM checkpoints in an exploratory analysis and removes or reduces two alternative models' measured advantages. Correcting only the normalization offset instead increases error, showing why interacting mismatches must be checked together. To test whether sensitivity to input preparation extends beyond NWM, we deliberately introduce encoding errors into two alternative models; both become less accurate. We introduce ActRosetta, a tool that checks whether action encoding matches training, identifies supported causes of disagreement, and repairs inputs when sufficient information is available. Repair helps little where predictions barely respond to actions, the tool's diagnosis has limited coverage, and improved control remains unproven. For any action-conditioned world model, the lesson is the same: before reporting rollout error, verify that evaluation encodes actions exactly as training did.

摘要（中文）：世界模型通过根据动作预测未来观测结果来进行评估。这些评估假设动作的准备方式与训练时相同，但未被检查的不一致可能会使模型看起来比实际更不准确。我们在导航世界模型（NWM）中审查了这一假设，并发现了其训练代码与部署代码之间三种相互作用的差异。在不重新训练的情况下修正输入，可使平均视觉预测误差降低42%（使用DreamSim在RECON导航数据集上测量）。该修正还改变了一项探索性分析中NWM检查点的排名，并消除或削弱了两个替代模型所表现出的优势。仅修正归一化偏移反而增加了误差，这表明相互作用的失配必须一起检查。为了测试对输入准备的敏感性是否超出NWM，我们故意在两个替代模型中引入编码错误；两者均变得不那么准确。我们引入了ActRosetta，一种用于检查动作编码是否与训练匹配、识别导致分歧的已支持原因，并在信息充足时修复输入的工具。在预测对动作几乎没有响应的情况下，修复帮助甚微；该工具的诊断覆盖范围有限，且改进的控制能力尚未得到证实。对于任何基于动作条件的世界模型，教训都是一样的：在报告部署误差之前，请验证评估时动作编码是否与训练时完全一致。

Authors: Ajmain Istiak Apon, Md Mehedi Hasan, Sejuti Rahman

RoboEvo$^2$: Recursive Robot Self-Improvement via Harness-Policy Co-Evolution VLA

policy-harness co-evolution vision-language-action policies counterfactual preference distillation LIBERO-PRO cross-embodiment transfer

简要说明：RoboEvo$^2$ 提出了一种递归框架，通过策略与编码辅助的协同进化，使机器人在无需额外人工演示的情况下自主获取技能并提升任务成功率。

TLDR: RoboEvo$^2$ introduces a recursive framework where robot policies and coding-based harnesses co-evolve, enabling autonomous skill acquisition and improved task success without additional human demonstrations across multiple embodied benchmarks.

Abstract: Robots should adapt to unfamiliar environments and acquire new skills through interaction, then execute those skills efficiently with practice. Vision-language-action policies provide efficient control, but often need additional human demonstrations to handle unfamiliar settings; reasoning agents can discover solutions using broad prior knowledge and robot-control APIs, but repeated deliberation and repair are costly. Inspired by human learning through reasoning and practice, we propose RoboEvo$^2$, a framework for recursive harness-policy co-evolution. In Policy-to-Harness (P2H) evolution, policy failures guide a coding agent to search complementary Code, Code+ICL, and Code+Policy routes, consolidating verified solutions into reusable skills, routing strategies, and experience memory. In Harness-to-Policy (H2P) evolution, verified trajectories provide supervised training, while Counterfactual Preference Distillation (CPD) teaches the policy to favor successful corrections over failures from the same starting state. The improved policy provides stronger motor skills for subsequent search, while its remaining failures redirect harness evolution, closing the reciprocal loop. Through recursive co-evolution without additional human demonstrations, RoboEvo$^2$ improves standalone success from 11.0% to 84.1% and hybrid success from 30.4% to 90.5% on LIBERO-PRO, with similar gains and reduced agentic costs on RoboTwin C2R. Further experiments demonstrate autonomous task acquisition, cross-embodiment harness transfer, and 95.0% hybrid success on the Unitree G1-D. Our models and code will be publicly released.

摘要（中文）：机器人应当能够适应陌生的环境，通过交互获取新技能，并通过练习高效地执行这些技能。视觉-语言-动作策略提供了高效的控制能力，但往往需要额外的人工演示来处理陌生场景；推理型智能体可以利用广泛的前验知识和机器人控制API来发现解决方案，但反复的思考和修正代价高昂。受人类通过推理与实践进行学习的启发，我们提出了RoboEvo$^2$，一个递归的“装备-策略”协同进化框架。在“策略到装备”（P2H）进化中，策略失败引导编码智能体搜索互补的代码（Code）、代码+上下文学习（Code+ICL）和代码+策略（Code+Policy）路线，并将验证通过的解决方案整合为可复用的技能、路由策略和经验记忆。在“装备到策略”（H2P）进化中，验证通过的轨迹提供监督训练信号，同时反事实偏好蒸馏（CPD）教导策略在相同初始状态下更倾向于成功的修正而非失败的动作。改进后的策略为后续搜索提供了更强的运动技能，而其残留的失败则重新引导装备进化，形成双向闭环。通过无需额外人工演示的递归协同进化，RoboEvo$^2$在LIBERO-PRO上将从零开始的独立成功率从11.0%提升至84.1%，将混合成功率从30.4%提升至90.5%，在RoboTwin C2R上取得了类似的提升并降低了智能体运行成本。进一步的实验展示了自主任务获取、跨实体装备迁移以及在Unitree G1-D上高达95.0%的混合成功率。我们的模型和代码将公开发布。

Authors: Chenzhi Liu, Jiehong Lin, Wei Huang, Xuzhao Huang, Haoyuan Li, Yang Zhang, Junchao Huang, Chenyeyang Cai, Bo Wang, Kazuhiro Kosuge, Zhongrui Wang, Xiaojuan Qi

DemoFoundry: Toward Scalable Photorealistic Robot Data with Coding Agents and Generative Rendering Manipulation

coding agents generative rendering photorealistic robot data sim-to-real video renderer

简要说明：DemoFoundry 将编码代理与生成式渲染相结合，合成具有物理基础的照片级逼真机器人演示，提升了策略学习效果，超越了原始仿真，并接近真实数据性能。

TLDR: DemoFoundry couples coding agents with generative rendering to synthesize photorealistic, physically grounded robot demonstrations, improving policy learning over raw simulation and approaching real-data performance.

Abstract: Scaling robot learning requires demonstrations that combine realistic visual observations with reliable action supervision. Simulation-based synthesis faces a substantial visual gap relative to real environments, while video-only generation struggles to maintain physically consistent interactions and provide aligned action labels. We present DemoFoundry, an automated framework that couples coding agents with generative rendering to synthesize photorealistic and physically grounded robot demonstrations. Coding agents both construct aligned real--proxy video pairs from existing robot episodes to train a video renderer and write executable interaction programs to generate new demonstrations. Given a scene reference and task instruction, an agent reconstructs task-relevant geometry and writes a control program without requiring target-task human demonstrations. Program execution in a physics simulator produces proxy videos with aligned robot states and actions. The video renderer translates these proxy videos into scene-consistent, photorealistic observations, reducing the need for detailed appearance modeling in each scene. Automated task-execution checks select successful trajectories for rendering and policy learning. Experiments show improved visual quality and action--video consistency. Policies trained on the generated demonstrations outperform raw-simulation training and approach the performance of training on an equal number of real demonstrations.

摘要（中文）：扩展机器人学习需要将逼真的视觉观察与可靠的动作监督相结合的演示数据。基于仿真的合成方法在视觉上与真实环境存在显著差距，而仅依赖视频生成的方法则难以保持物理一致的交互并提供对齐的动作标签。我们提出了DemoFoundry，一个自动化框架，将编码智能体与生成式渲染相结合，以合成逼真且物理可信的机器人演示。编码智能体既从现有机器人片段中构建对齐的真实-代理视频对以训练视频渲染器，又编写可执行的交互程序以生成新的演示。给定场景参考和任务指令，智能体重建任务相关的几何结构并编写控制程序，无需目标任务的人工演示。在物理仿真器中执行程序可生成具有对齐机器人状态和动作的代理视频。视频渲染器将这些代理视频转换为场景一致、逼真的视觉观察，减少了对每个场景精细外观建模的需求。自动化任务执行检查筛选出成功的轨迹用于渲染和策略学习。实验结果表明，该方法在视觉质量和动作-视频一致性方面均有提升。基于生成演示训练的策略优于原始仿真训练，并接近使用同等数量真实演示训练的性能。

Authors: Ruixiang Wang, Xinyue Yao, Xuanning Zhou, Yueci Deng, Yongyi Su, Kui Jia

Autonomous Ergodic Robotic Palpation for Elastic Mapping of Curved Soft Tissues Manipulation

ergodic palpation Laplace-Beltrami operator Gaussian Process Unscented Kalman Filter tissue mapping

简要说明：本文提出了一种遍历性触诊框架，用于弯曲软组织表面的机器人组织映射，利用拉普拉斯-贝尔特拉米算子、UKF和高斯过程实现几何一致的硬夹杂物定位。

TLDR: This paper introduces an ergodic palpation framework for robotic tissue mapping on curved soft surfaces, using Laplace-Beltrami operators, UKF, and Gaussian Processes to enable geometry-consistent stiff inclusion localization.

Abstract: Autonomous robotic palpation offers repeatable, quantitative estimates of tissue properties for stiff inclusion localization. However, existing methods often rely on prior mesh models or planar surface assumptions that do not generalize to complex human anatomy. We propose an ergodic palpation framework that operates directly on curved soft surfaces using point cloud data. Central to our approach is the Laplace--Beltrami operator, which grounds both online estimation and exploration in the surface intrinsic geometry. We estimate local viscoelastic parameters using an Unscented Kalman Filter (UKF) and fuse them into a surface-aware Gaussian Process (GP). This probabilistic model drives a diffusion-based ergodic motion planner, generating a continuous exploration trajectory that feeds the new informative samples back to the GP in a closed loop. Throughout this process, a hybrid force-impedance controller regulates interaction forces to maintain contact. We evaluate the approach against existing methods in simulation and validate it in physical experiments on tissue-mimicking silicone phantoms with varying geometries and viscoelastic properties, demonstrating geometry-consistent mapping and stiff inclusion localization under contact-rich conditions.

摘要（中文）：自主机器人触诊为硬质包块定位提供了可重复、定量的组织特性估计。然而，现有方法通常依赖先验网格模型或平面表面假设，难以推广至复杂的人体解剖结构。我们提出了一种遍历触诊框架，可直接基于点云数据在弯曲软组织表面上运行。该方法的核心是拉普拉斯-贝尔特拉米算子，它将在线估计与探索均建立在表面内蕴几何之上。我们利用无迹卡尔曼滤波（UKF）估计局部黏弹性参数，并将其融合到表面感知的高斯过程（GP）中。该概率模型驱动基于扩散的遍历运动规划器，生成连续探索轨迹，并以闭环方式将新增信息样本反馈至高斯过程。在整个过程中，混合力-阻抗控制器对交互力进行调节以维持接触。我们在仿真中将该方法与现有方法进行了对比评估，并在具有不同几何形状和黏弹性特性的组织模拟硅胶体模上进行了物理实验验证，展示了在丰富接触条件下几何一致的映射与硬质包块定位性能。

Authors: Luca Beber, Cem Bilaloglu, Edoardo Lamon, Matteo Saveriano, Daniele Fontanelli, Luigi Palopoli, Sylvain Calinon

FeaXDrive2: Body-Scene Spatial Grounding for Feasibility-Aware Generative Driving AutonomousDriving

body-scene spatial grounding generative driving planning feasibility-aware collision reduction Navsim evaluation

简要说明：FeaXDrive2 提出了一种具有车身-场景空间锚定的生成式驾驶规划器，利用真实车身角点查询局部视觉特征，从而提高可行性并在 NAVSIM 评估中减少碰撞。

TLDR: FeaXDrive2 introduces a generative driving planner with body-scene spatial grounding that uses actual vehicle-body corners to query local visual features, improving feasibility and reducing collisions in NAVSIM evaluations.

Abstract: Generative driving planners may produce trajectories that appear feasible at their reference points but violate environmental constraints over the full vehicle body. We propose FeaXDrive2, an end-to-end generative planning framework that enhances vehicle-embodied spatial feasibility (VESF) through body-scene spatial grounding. The proposed method constructs spatial queries from actual vehicle-body corners and dynamically updates visual sampling locations using evolving trajectory estimates across Flow steps. Retrieved local visual features condition subsequent Action Flow-DiT velocity predictions, allowing trajectory generation to guide spatial information retrieval. Rollout-Consistent Safety Fine-Tuning (RC-F) combines high-risk trajectory supervision with reference behavior preservation, followed by planning-supervised VLM-Action Alignment. Vehicle-geometry counterfactual analysis reveals safety differences under identical trajectories but varying vehicle geometry. On NAVSIM, FeaXDrive2 reduces at-fault collisions by 36.5% relative to the base planner and improves PDMS from 87.0 to 88.8. Under NAVSIM v2 evaluation, EPDMS increases from 86.5 to 88.3. Ablation and body-clearance analyses further demonstrate the safety benefits of body-scene spatial grounding.

摘要（中文）：生成式驾驶规划器可能生成在其参考点看似可行、但在整车车身上违反环境约束的轨迹。我们提出FeaXDrive2，一种端到端生成式规划框架，通过车身-场景空间接地增强车辆实体空间可行性（VESF）。所提方法基于实际车辆车身角点构建空间查询，并利用跨Flow步骤中不断演化的轨迹估计动态更新视觉采样位置。检索到的局部视觉特征用于条件化后续的Action Flow-DiT速度预测，使轨迹生成能够引导空间信息检索。滚动一致性安全微调（RC-F）将高风险轨迹监督与参考行为保持相结合，随后进行规划监督的VLM-动作对齐。车辆几何反事实分析揭示了在相同轨迹但不同车辆几何下的安全差异。在NAVSIM上，FeaXDrive2相较于基线规划器将责任碰撞减少36.5%，并将PDMS从87.0提升至88.8。在NAVSIM v2评估下，EPDMS从86.5提升至88.3。消融实验和车身间隙分析进一步证明了车身-场景空间接地的安全优势。

Authors: Bo Leng, Baoyun Wang, Wenxin Wen, Ming Liu, Weiqi Zhang, Ran Yu, Chongfeng Wei, Zhuoren Li, Lu Xiong

Motion Beyond Pixels: Learning Future Visual Representations for Object-Centric Dynamics WorldModel

visual representation world model object-centric dynamics DINO-VAE diffusion transformer 3D object flow

简要说明：MotionRep 是一种视觉表征世界模型，联合预测未来的 DINO 特征和 3D 对象流，通过具有非对称噪声调度的扩散变压器来改进操作任务中的对象中心动力学建模，仅需三步去噪即可超越基于像素的基线。

TLDR: MotionRep is a visual representation world model that jointly predicts future DINO features and 3D object flow, using a diffusion transformer with asymmetric noise schedules to improve object-centric dynamics modeling for manipulation tasks, outperforming pixel-based baselines with only three denoising steps.

Abstract: Many embodied world models predict future states in latent spaces optimized for RGB reconstruction, which do not explicitly prioritize object-level semantics and geometry relevant to motion generation. We present MotionRep, a visual representation world model that jointly generates future DINO representations and 3D object flow, coupling semantic and geometric information with object-centric dynamics. To make high-dimensional DINO features amenable to generative modeling, we introduce DINO-VAE, which combines temporal and channel compression with latent regularization to produce compact latents while preserving semantic and geometric information. Conditioned on an initial observation, object query points, and a language instruction, a unified diffusion transformer predicts future visual representations and 3D object flow through joint attention. MotionRep employs asymmetric modality-specific noise schedules to keep the visual stream ahead of 3D object flow during joint denoising, allowing progressively refined future visual representations to guide flow generation. Experiments on simulated and real-world manipulation benchmarks demonstrate that MotionRep outperforms pixel-based baselines in 3D object flow accuracy and generalization to unseen scenes, while requiring only three denoising steps for inference. These results support predictive visual representations as an effective future-state space for object-centric dynamics modeling.

摘要（中文）：许多具身世界模型在针对RGB重建优化的潜在空间中预测未来状态，这些空间并未明确优先考虑与运动生成相关的对象级语义和几何信息。我们提出MotionRep，一种视觉表征世界模型，它联合生成未来的DINO表征和3D对象流，将语义和几何信息与以对象为中心的动态相结合。为了使高维DINO特征适用于生成建模，我们引入了DINO-VAE，该模型将时间与通道压缩同潜在正则化相结合，在保留语义和几何信息的同时生成紧凑的潜在表示。基于初始观测、对象查询点和语言指令，统一的扩散变换器通过联合注意力预测未来的视觉表征和3D对象流。MotionRep采用非对称的模态特定噪声调度，使视觉流在联合去噪过程中领先于3D对象流，从而允许逐步细化的未来视觉表征引导流的生成。在模拟和真实世界操作基准上的实验表明，MotionRep在3D对象流精度和对未见场景的泛化能力上优于基于像素的基线模型，且推理仅需三步去噪。这些结果支持预测性视觉表征作为以对象为中心的动态建模的有效未来状态空间。

Authors: Chengzhi Zhao, Juelin Li, Zhennan Wang, Sheng Wang, Zhuoman Liu, Yuhao Lu, Jiongxu Chen, Haitang Feng, Yanjie Li, Lin Shao

Riding the Wave: Sim-to-Real Humanoid Control on Elastic Terrain HumanoidEmbodied

sim-to-real humanoid control elastic terrain deformable contact proprioceptive policy

简要说明：RIPPLE 提出了一种针对弹性地形上人形机器人控制的仿真到现实框架，利用预紧质量-弹簧网格模拟可变形接触，并通过分阶段训练迁移刚性地面技能，使真实人形机器人仅凭借本体感觉即可在蹦床上保持平衡和连续跳跃。

TLDR: RIPPLE introduces a sim-to-real framework for humanoid control on elastic terrains, using a pretensioned mass-spring mesh (ElasticMembrane) for deformable contact simulation and staged training to transfer rigid-ground skills, enabling a real humanoid to balance and jump on a trampoline with only proprioception.

Abstract: Humanoid robots on deformable elastic terrains face a surface whose position and motion are coupled in space and time: deflection and rebound persist between contacts, and load at one foothold alters the support at others, so training must capture how each contact changes the support that follows. We present RIPPLE (Robust Interaction via Proprioceptive Policies on Large-deformation Elastic terrain), a simulation-to-real learning framework for humanoid control on such terrains. RIPPLE integrates ElasticMembrane, a pretensioned mass-spring mesh that models spatially coupled deflection, energy storage, and rebound, together with deformable contact into MJLab for GPU-parallel policy learning. Staged training then transfers rigid-ground skills to balance and jumping on these terrains using only proprioception, without vision or force sensing. Deployed zero-shot, the policies enable a MagicBot Z1 humanoid to balance, jump consecutively, and enter a trampoline from a rigid platform. In simulation, ElasticMembrane training holds standing success of at least 98.7% (mean over three seeds) on ElasticMembrane, IndependentSprings, and BouncyPlate under 0.3 m/s perturbations, whereas rigid-ground or contact-compliance training transfers poorly to the first two. A fixed policy tolerates stiffness from 0.35 to 2.8 times the training value, beds up to 7 m wide, and seven further simulated support scenarios, so transfer needs no calibration to the trampoline's stiffness. We plan to release the code soon. The interactive browser demo, videos, and scene configurations are available on the project page: https://fly-pigTH.github.io/wave_rider/

摘要（中文）：人形机器人在可变形弹性地形上面临的地表，其位置与运动在空间和时间上均相互耦合：接触之间持续存在挠曲与回弹，且一个落脚点的载荷会改变其他落脚点的支撑，因此训练必须捕捉每次接触如何影响后续支撑。我们提出了RIPPLE（基于本体感觉策略的大变形弹性地形稳健交互），一种用于此类地形上人形机器人控制的仿真到现实学习框架。RIPPLE集成了ElasticMembrane——一种预张紧的质点-弹簧网格，可建模空间耦合挠曲、能量存储与回弹，并将可变形接触纳入MJLab，用于GPU并行策略学习。随后，分阶段训练将刚性地面技能迁移至这些地形上的平衡与跳跃任务，且仅依赖本体感觉，无需视觉或力传感。零样本部署下，这些策略使MagicBot Z1人形机器人能够实现平衡、连续跳跃，并从刚性平台进入蹦床。在仿真中，ElasticMembrane训练在0.3 m/s扰动下，于ElasticMembrane、IndependentSprings和BouncyPlate三种地形上均保持至少98.7%的站立成功率（三种子均值），而刚性地面或接触柔顺训练在前两种地形上的迁移效果较差。固定策略可容忍训练值0.35至2.8倍的刚度范围、宽达7米的床面，以及另外七种仿真支撑场景，因此迁移无需针对蹦床刚度进行标定。我们计划近期发布代码。交互式浏览器演示、视频及场景配置可在项目页面获取：https://fly-pigTH.github.io/wave_rider/

Authors: Yinglei Zhu, Qin Li, Honghao Pan, Bozhao Wang, Binghui Xu, Jie Lu, Wentao Song, Xiyu Wang, Xinyu Zhu, Wei Liu, Xinjun Liu, Kai Lu, Huichan Zhao

Long-Horizon Planning with Latent World Models via Graph Anchors WorldModel

latent world models long-horizon planning graph anchors manipulation

简要说明：本文指出了潜在世界模型规划器中目标距离的两种失败模式，并提出 Graph Anchors，一种基于记录轨迹上图谱节点的免训练规划器，在长时程操控与导航任务中显著提升成功率。

TLDR: This paper identifies two failure modes of latent world model planners' goal distance—directional signal loss and object weighting—and proposes Graph Anchors, a training-free planner that guides planning via graph nodes on recorded trajectories, achieving dramatic success-rate improvements on long-horizon manipulation and navigation tasks.

Abstract: Latent world models plan in a compact latent space by predicting the outcomes of actions. Their planners judge a plan by the latent distance between its predicted end state and the goal image. We show that this distance fails in two distinct ways. First, it loses directional signal a few steps from the goal, causing distant goals to fail. Second, it weighs the robot arm over the manipulated object, causing manipulation to fail at contact. We measure both failures directly on recorded data by asking whether a lower latent distance corresponds to true progress toward the goal. Across five environments, six visual representations (including raw pixels and V-JEPA 2), and nine Meta-World tasks, this ranking test cleanly separates the two failures, and the graph distance to a goal predicts where closed-loop planning breaks down. Both failures share a single remedy: replacing the distant goal with a nearby target that lies on a recorded trajectory. We realize this principle with Graph Anchors, a training-free planner for frozen latent world models. It builds a sparse graph once over the model's own training frames and aims each planning step at a node a few moves ahead along the shortest path to the goal, keeping paths on recorded transitions wherever contact matters. On goals up to 400 steps away, Graph Anchors raise LeWM's success from 13% to 85% on PointMaze-Medium, from 8% to 87% on PointMaze-Large, and from 5% to 71% on Push-T, where stronger search toward the goal fails and where prior training-free planners break down under missing step horizons, subsampling shortcuts, or fragmented contact.

摘要（中文）：潜在世界模型通过在紧凑的潜在空间中预测动作结果来进行规划。其规划器通过比较预测的最终状态与目标图像之间的潜在距离来评估计划。我们表明，这种距离在两个方面存在失效问题。首先，在距离目标几步之遥时，它会丢失方向信号，导致远距离目标规划失败。其次，它会将机器人手臂的权重置于被操控物体之上，导致在接触时操控失败。我们直接在记录的数据上通过检验“较小的潜在距离是否对应朝向目标的真实进展”来衡量这两种失效。在五个环境、六种视觉表示（包括原始像素和V-JEPA 2）以及九个Meta-World任务中，这一排序测试清晰地区分了这两种失效，并且到目标的图距离能够预测闭环规划在何处崩溃。这两种失效有一个共同的解决方案：用记录轨迹上的邻近目标点替代远处目标。我们通过图锚点（Graph Anchors）实现了这一原则，这是一种无需训练、适用于冻结潜在世界模型的规划器。它基于模型自身的训练帧构建一次稀疏图，并将每一步规划指向沿到达目标最短路径上前进几步的节点，在接触关键区域时始终将路径保持在记录的转移之上。对于距离最远达400步的目标，图锚点将LeWM在PointMaze-Medium上的成功率从13%提升至85%，在PointMaze-Large上从8%提升至87%，在Push-T上从5%提升至71%；而在这些任务中，更强的目标导向搜索会失败，先前的免训练规划器也会因缺失步长范围、子采样捷径或接触不连贯而崩溃。

Authors: Syed Nazmus Sakib, Abdul Monaf Chowdhury, Peizhen Li, Nafiul Haque, Chandak Chakma, Md Mehedi Hasan, Zehong Cao, Shifat E. Arman

SkySearcher: High-Altitude Onboard VLM Reasoning for Aerial Semantic Search VLN

aerial semantic search vision-language model probabilistic map information-driven exploration UAV navigation

简要说明：SkySearcher 提出了一种机载 VLM 驱动的空中语义搜索方法，将高空气象语义线索投影到概率地面图，以高效搜索开放词汇目标，在仿真中优于基线并展示了真实无人机部署。

TLDR: SkySearcher presents an onboard VLM-driven aerial semantic search method that projects high-altitude semantic cues onto a probabilistic ground map for efficient open-vocabulary target search, outperforming baselines in simulations and demonstrating real drone deployment.

Abstract: Recent advances in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have improved semantic and visual reasoning, enabling UAVs to search for open-vocabulary queries in unstructured environments at high altitude. However, existing systems mainly follow low-altitude strategies, focusing on close-range iterative exploration, requiring storage-intensive dense 3D metric-semantic reconstructions or relying on large cloud-serviced VLMs assuming constant internet access. We propose SkySearcher, an aerial semantic search navigation method designed for large outdoor scenes. SkySearcher integrates onboard VLM reasoning with a lightweight probabilistic representation that guides an information-driven exploration. The VLM extracts semantic information at high altitude about the target or cues informing about its location. This information is projected to the ground using the camera frustum instead of limited-depth sensors, actively exploiting the expansive field of view offered by elevated sensing. The information regarding the presence or absence of semantic cues is then integrated into a probabilistic map by modeling the spatial belief of the query, maintaining a task-driven memory for the mission and guiding the exploration towards semantically promising regions. Extensive simulations for Aerial Object Goal Navigation on public benchmarks demonstrate that SkySearcher significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in success rate, flight time, and navigation precision, while a deployment of SkySercher running fully onboard a drone demonstrates the applicability of our approach.

摘要（中文）：近期视觉-语言模型（VLMs）的进展提升了语义与视觉推理能力，使无人机能够在高空非结构化环境中执行开放词汇查询搜索。然而，现有系统主要遵循低空策略，聚焦于近距离迭代探索，要求存储密集型的稠密3D度量-语义重建，或依赖假设持续互联网接入的大型云端VLM服务。我们提出SkySearcher，一种面向大型室外场景的空中语义搜索导航方法。SkySearcher将机载VLM推理与轻量级概率表征相结合，以引导信息驱动的探索。VLM在高空提取关于目标或其位置线索的语义信息，并通过相机视锥而非受限深度传感器将信息投影至地面，从而充分利用高空感知带来的广阔视场。关于语义线索存在与否的信息随后通过建模查询的空间置信度被整合进概率地图，维持面向任务的任务驱动记忆，并引导探索朝向语义上有前景的区域。在公开基准上针对空中目标目标导航的大规模仿真表明，SkySearcher在成功率、飞行时间和导航精度方面显著优于最先进的基线方法，而完全机载运行于无人机的SkySearcher部署则验证了我们方法的实用性。

Authors: Giacomo Vianello, David Morilla-Cabello, Juan Dendarieta Serrano, Ruggero Carli, Eduardo Montijano

Recoverability policy editing for closed-loop safety in autonomous driving AutonomousDriving

policy editing closed-loop safety recoverability autonomous driving nuPlan

简要说明：本文提出了一种状态级策略编辑技术，通过识别可恢复的不安全状态并选择性调整策略，在nuPlan模拟中实现安全事件减少48%，同时保持了驾驶性能。

TLDR: This paper proposes a state-level policy editing technique that guarantees closed-loop safety in autonomous driving by identifying recoverable unsafe states and selectively adjusting the policy, achieving a 48% reduction in safety incidents in nuPlan simulations while preserving driving performance.

Abstract: Autonomous driving powered by neural network models lacks safety guarantees. We propose a state-level policy editing technique that guarantees closed-loop safety under recoverable disturbances while reusing the model's existing driving capabilities. Closed-loop safety means that the vehicle remains free of collisions at all future times. We introduce the concept of policy recoverability to characterize whether a vehicle can safely return to the original policy's feasible set in finite time. Our method identifies states that are unsafe in the long term under the original policy but recoverable, and selectively edits policy outputs within this region. The vehicle corrects its actions upon entering this region and resumes the original policy upon recovery. Closed-loop simulations on nuPlan urban driving scenarios show a 48% reduction in safety incidents under the original policy while largely preserving its driving performance.

摘要（中文）：基于神经网络模型的自动驾驶缺乏安全保障。我们提出了一种状态层面的策略编辑技术，该技术在可恢复扰动下保证闭环安全性，同时复用模型现有的驾驶能力。闭环安全性意味着车辆在未来所有时刻均不发生碰撞。我们引入策略可恢复性的概念，用以刻画车辆是否能在有限时间内安全返回原始策略的可行集合。该方法识别在原始策略下长期不安全但可恢复的状态，并在此区域内选择性地编辑策略输出。车辆进入该区域后纠正其行为，并在恢复后重新采用原始策略。在nuPlan城市驾驶场景上的闭环仿真表明，在原始策略下安全事故减少了48%，同时其驾驶性能大体保持不变。

Authors: Yang Guan, Shengbo Eben Li

Beyond Natural-Language Instructions: Temporal Logic as a Task Language for VLA Models with Visual-Logical Fusion VLA

temporal logic vision-language-action model visual-logical fusion robot pretraining long-horizon tasks

简要说明：本文提出TL-VLA，一个用时序逻辑替代自然语言指令的视觉-语言-动作框架，通过类型化图编码器和视觉-逻辑融合生成动作，在长时程机器人操作基准上取得了改进。

TLDR: The paper introduces TL-VLA, a vision-language-action framework that replaces natural-language task instructions with temporal logic specifications to make spatiotemporal structure explicit, using a typed graph encoder and visual-logical fusion for action generation, and demonstrates improved performance on long-horizon robot manipulation benchmarks.

Abstract: Robotic tasks combine object relations, logical dependencies, and temporal requirements, which robot planning and industrial control commonly specify in temporal logic (TL). We introduce TL-VLA, a vision--language--action framework that replaces natural-language task instructions with temporal logic, making this spatiotemporal structure explicit. A typed graph encoder and visual--logical fusion condition continuous actions on the task specification and the current observations. To prepare a general vision--language backbone for this interface, we develop TL-aware robot pretraining with separate semantic and structural readouts: a frozen language teacher aligns task semantics, the structural readout encodes TL syntax to support complex, long-horizon tasks, and autoregressive action prediction connects the graph representation to robot behavior. Downstream policies inherit the pretrained backbone and TL encoder and learn new fusion and action modules. On CALVIN ABC$\rightarrow$D, our TL-aware initializer reaches \textbf{3.800} average chain length and \textbf{62.3\%} five-task success, compared with 3.578 and 54.5\% for a FAST initializer pretrained on the same data and 3.485 average chain length for a Qwen+NL baseline. On LIBERO-10, TL-aware initialization improves success from \textbf{91.2\% to 95.8\%}. On LIBERO-Mem, our policy reaches \textbf{65.0\%} success without observation history, compared with 45.0\% for a Qwen+NL reference. On held-out Panda planning specifications, it reaches \textbf{59.6\%} at Success@256 over three generation seeds, versus 48.4\% for Qwen+TL and 37.0\% for Qwen+NL. These results support explicit logical task conditioning and transferable TL-aware representations for robot action learning.

摘要（中文）：机器人任务融合了对象关系、逻辑依赖和时间要求，机器人规划与工业控制通常用时序逻辑（TL）来对这些任务进行规范描述。我们提出TL-VLA，一个将自然语言任务指令替换为时序逻辑的视觉-语言-动作框架，使这种时空结构变得显式化。该框架使用类型化图编码器和视觉-逻辑融合模块，根据任务规范和当前观测来连续生成动作。为使通用视觉-语言主干网络适配这一接口，我们开发了具有独立语义与结构输出的TL感知机器人预训练方法：冻结的语言教师模型对齐任务语义，结构输出编码TL语法以支持复杂的长时程任务，而自回归动作预测将图表示与机器人行为相连接。下游策略继承预训练主干网络和TL编码器，并学习新的融合与动作模块。在CALVIN ABC→D基准上，我们的TL感知初始化器达到**3.800**的平均链长和**62.3%**的五任务成功率，而使用相同数据预训练的FAST初始化器分别为3.578和54.5%，Qwen+NL基线则为3.485的平均链长。在LIBERO-10上，TL感知初始化将成功率从**91.2%提升至95.8%**。在LIBERO-Mem上，我们的策略在没有观测历史的情况下达到**65.0%**的成功率，而Qwen+NL参考方法为45.0%。在留出的Panda规划规范上，该方法在三个生成种子下达到**59.6%**的Success@256，而Qwen+TL为48.4%，Qwen+NL为37.0%。这些结果支持显式逻辑任务条件化以及可迁移的TL感知表示用于机器人动作学习。

Authors: Zezhi Liu, Jingwen Sun, Hongjin Chen, Shaojie Ren, Peiyan Tu, Xin Jin, Zhibo Chen

Co-World Model for Human-Video-to-Robot Transfer via Co-Constructed Shared Latent Dynamics VLA

world model cross-embodiment latent action alignment zero-shot transfer receding-horizon control

简要说明：CoWM 提出了一种共同世界模型，通过联合学习成对人类与机器人视频的共享潜在动态，按效果对齐潜在动作，并利用相位感知控制器实现到真实机器人的零样本技能迁移。

TLDR: CoWM proposes a co-world model that jointly learns shared latent dynamics from paired human and robot videos, aligning latent actions by their effects on objects and using a phase-aware controller to transfer skills zero-shot to real robots.

Abstract: Human videos are abundant and cheap to obtain, whereas robot trajectories remain scarce and costly, making zero-shot skill transfer from a single human demonstration an appealing route to scalable robot learning. Existing methods, however, either retarget human-specific geometry or match only static visual goals, and thus stumble over the cross-embodiment dynamics mismatch and the ungrounded action execution. We present the Co-World Model (CoWM), a predictive framework jointly optimized from paired yet unsynchronized human and robot streams. To bridge the cross-embodiment dynamics gap, CoWM disentangles each observation into a shared object-relation state and embodiment-specific context. It aligns latent actions across embodiments using effect-swap and action-sensitivity objectives,such that actions are matched by their predicted effects on the manipulated objects rather than by embodimentdependent kinematics. For grounded execution, a phase-aware receding-horizon controller estimates demonstration progress, projects the inferred human action prior onto the robot action-support density, and translates the resulting latent dynamics into executable robot commands. Extensive experiments in simulation and on two physical robot platforms demonstrate the effectiveness of CoWM, its cross-platform generalizability, and the contribution of each component. See the demo video in the supporting information for details.

摘要（中文）：人类视频资源丰富且获取成本低廉，而机器人轨迹数据稀缺且采集代价高昂，这使得从单次人类演示实现零样本技能迁移成为可扩展机器人学习的一条极具吸引力的路径。然而，现有方法要么仅对人类特有的几何结构进行重定向，要么仅匹配静态视觉目标，因而难以克服跨本体动力学差异以及缺乏 grounded 的动作执行问题。我们提出了共世界模型（Co-World Model, CoWM），这是一个由配对但未同步的人类与机器人数据流联合优化的预测框架。为弥合跨本体动力学差距，CoWM 将每次观测分解为共享的物体-关系状态和本体特定上下文两部分。它通过效应交换（effect-swap）和动作敏感性（action-sensitivity）目标函数对齐不同本体间的潜在动作，使动作根据其对被操作物体的预测效应进行匹配，而非依赖本体的运动学特征。为实现 grounded 的执行，一种相位感知的滚动时域控制器估计演示进度，将推理得到的人类动作先验投影到机器人动作支持密度上，并将由此产生的潜在动态转化为可执行的机器人指令。在仿真环境和两套物理机器人平台上开展的大量实验验证了 CoWM 的有效性、其跨平台泛化能力以及各组成部分的贡献。详见支撑信息中的演示视频。

Authors: Xuetao Li, Xuan Jiang, Chen Liu, Zhongrui Rao, Yu Ling, Hui Wang, Sheng Liu, Miao Li

DataForgeVLA: Fully Synthetic Manipulation Demonstrations for Vision-Language-Action Training VLA

synthetic demonstrations VLA training LeRobot v2.1 quality screening GR00T N1.6

简要说明：本文介绍了一个包含340个完全合成操作演示的数据集，用于VLA训练，该数据集从真实种子数据生成，无需额外遥操作，并初步证明基于该数据微调的策略在现实世界中达到80%的成功率。

TLDR: This paper introduces a dataset of 340 fully synthetic manipulation demonstrations for VLA training, generated from real seed data without additional teleoperation, and provides preliminary evidence that a policy fine-tuned on this data achieves 80% real-world success.

Abstract: We present a dataset of 340 fully synthetic manipulation demonstrations generated from real seed data for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) training. The corpus contains 32,340 frames with synchronized RGB and actions across eight object categories, represented as LeRobot v2.1 episodes with H.264 video, per-frame robot states and pose-valued action labels, language task annotations, summary statistics and quality decisions. Each synthetic demonstration is produced without additional teleoperation: a LoRA-fine-tuned Cosmos-3 model generates a manipulation video, and RoboHaMeR recovers the corresponding robot trajectory from RGB. Quality screening accepted 300 of 340 episodes for policy fine-tuning. As preliminary evidence of feasibility, a pretrained GR00T N1.6 policy fine-tuned exclusively on the 300 accepted episodes reaches 16/20 (80%) real-world pick-and-place success on the Oreo-package task. A policy fine-tuned on 105 real teleoperated episodes achieved 18/20 (90%) under the same protocol. These results are based on one object and 20 trials per policy and are therefore reported as preliminary evidence rather than a general performance claim.

摘要（中文）：我们提出一个包含340个完全合成操作演示的数据集，这些演示由真实种子数据生成，用于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型训练。该语料库包含32,340帧数据，覆盖八个物体类别，带有同步的RGB图像和动作信息，以LeRobot v2.1片段格式呈现，包含H.264视频、逐帧机器人状态、位姿型动作标签、语言任务标注、汇总统计和质量判定。每个合成演示均在无需额外遥操作的情况下生成：一个经LoRA微调的Cosmos-3模型生成操作视频，RoboHaMeR从RGB图像中恢复对应的机器人轨迹。质量筛选后，340个片段中有300个被接受用于策略微调。初步可行性证据表明，一个预训练的GR00T N1.6策略仅使用这300个被接受的片段进行微调后，在奥利奥包装任务上达到了16/20（80%）的真实世界抓取-放置成功率。在相同协议下，使用105个真实遥操作片段微调的策略达到了18/20（90%）。这些结果基于单一物体和每个策略20次试验，因此仅作为初步证据报告，而非一般性能声明。

Authors: Sergei Kurchev, Iaroslav Kolomiets, Filipp Maksimov, Elizaveta Semenyakina, Miguel Altamirano Cabrera, Artem Lykov, Dzmitry Tsetserukou

Escapingthe instruction blackhole of vision-language-action policies via optimal-transport wormholes VLA

instruction black hole optimal transport vision-language-action policy training-free plug-in task switching

简要说明：该论文识别了VLA策略中的'指令黑洞'现象，即执行过程中新指令会被忽略，并提出了Wormhole，一种基于最优传输的免训练插件，将机器人重新定位到新任务的接近阶段状态，在LIBERO上大幅提升切换成功率。

TLDR: The paper identifies the 'instruction black hole' in VLA policies where new instructions are ignored during execution, and proposes Wormhole, a training-free optimal-transport-based plug-in that relocates the robot to an approach-phase state of the new task, dramatically improving committed-switch success on LIBERO.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies are trained to follow a fixed instruction, yet people change their minds while the robot acts. We identify the instruction black hole: once a VLA policy commits to a task, new instructions are absorbed and the robot completes the old task or freezes. We quantify it with a transmission ratio and an event horizon and prove it is a blind spot of static imitation, which cannot distinguish a policy that listens from a deaf one once the execution state reveals the task. We propose Wormhole, a training-free plug-in that relocates the robot instead of re-instructing it: optimal transport selects an approach-phase state of the new task, a rate-limited traversal carries the robot there, and the unmodified policy takes over. On LIBERO,Wormhole raises committed-switch success of pi to and pi0.5 from at most 1.2% to 93.1%, matching or exceeding scripted retreat-and-restart with one fifth of its action discontinuity.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略被训练用于遵循固定指令，然而在机器人执行任务的过程中，人们常常会改变主意。我们发现了“指令黑洞”问题：一旦VLA策略承诺执行某项任务，新指令会被吸收，机器人要么完成旧任务，要么陷入停滞。我们通过传输比和事件视界对其进行了量化，并证明这是静态模仿的一个盲点——当执行状态揭示了任务内容时，静态模仿无法区分一个会“倾听”的策略与一个“耳聋”的策略。我们提出了Wormhole，这是一种无需训练的即插即用方法，通过重新定位机器人而非重新下达指令来解决问题：最优传输选择新任务的接近阶段状态，速率受限遍历将机器人携带至该状态，未修改的策略随即接管执行。在LIBERO基准上，Wormhole将π和π0.5的承诺切换成功率从最高1.2%提升至93.1%，与脚本化的后退-重启方法相当甚至更优，而其动作不连续性仅为后者的五分之一。

Authors: Xuetao Li, Chen Liu, Jing Wu, Sheng Liu, Miao Li

Ground Your Steps: Optimizing Sampling Schedules in Flow Matching Robot Policies Manipulation

flow matching sampling schedule robot policy action chunks energy distance

简要说明：本文提出 Ground Your Steps (GYS)，一种无需训练的方法，通过匹配生成和演示动作块分布来优化流匹配机器人策略中的采样调度，在 RoboTwin 2.0 基准和真实世界操作任务中提高了成功率。

TLDR: This paper introduces Ground Your Steps (GYS), a training-free method that optimizes sampling schedules in flow matching robot policies by matching generated and demonstrated action chunk distributions, improving task success rates on RoboTwin 2.0 benchmarks and real-world manipulation tasks.

Abstract: Flow matching robot policies generate action chunks by integrating a learned velocity field at inference. However, under a fixed budget of neural function evaluations (NFEs), the integration result depends on the sampling schedule. This motivates optimizing the schedule to bring the generated action distribution closer to the demonstrations and improve task success. We propose Ground Your Steps (GYS), a training-free method that optimizes the sampling schedule by matching the generated and demonstrated chunk distributions at each observation. GYS applies truncated fractional differencing along each arm joint's action sequence and compares two types of pairwise differences between action chunks at each observation: differences of a generated chunk against a demonstration, and differences of two independent generated chunks against each other. After fractional differencing, these two pairwise-difference distributions coincide exactly when the distributions of generated and demonstrated action chunks match. GYS minimizes the energy distance between these distributions to obtain an improved schedule for each task and NFE budget. Compared with the uniform grid, GYS brings the generated chunk distribution closer to the demonstrated distribution and raises the success rate through the sampling schedule alone. On RoboTwin 2.0 benchmarks, GYS improves success rates at nearly every budget, with gains of 2.8 percentage points for both $π_{0.5}$ and GR00T N1.7. The gains also transfer to three real-world manipulation tasks, reaching up to 3.3 percentage points. Code is available at https://github.com/D-Robotics-AI-Lab/GroundYourSteps.

摘要（中文）：流匹配机器人策略通过在推理时整合学习到的速度场来生成动作块。然而，在固定的神经函数评估（NFE）预算下，整合结果取决于采样调度。这促使我们优化调度，以使生成的动作分布更接近示范分布，并提高任务成功率。我们提出“稳健落步”（GYS）方法，这是一种无需训练的方法，通过在每个观测处匹配生成的动作块分布与示范的动作块分布来优化采样调度。GYS沿每个机械臂关节的动作序列应用截断分数差分，并比较每个观测处动作块之间的两类成对差异：生成块与示范块之间的差异，以及两个独立生成块之间的差异。经过分数差分后，当生成动作块分布与示范动作块分布匹配时，这两类成对差异分布恰好一致。GYS最小化这些分布之间的能量距离，从而为每个任务和NFE预算获得改进的调度。与均匀网格相比，GYS仅通过采样调度即能使生成块分布更接近示范分布，并提高成功率。在RoboTwin 2.0基准测试中，GYS在几乎所有预算下均提升了成功率，其中π₀.₅和GR00T N1.7分别提高了2.8个百分点。这些提升也迁移至三个真实世界操作任务，最高提升达3.3个百分点。代码可在https://github.com/D-Robotics-AI-Lab/GroundYourSteps获取。
