Authors: Licheng Yang, Yonghao He, Lingfeng Qian, Xin Shi, Wei Sui, Hu Su

WorldPhy: Benchmarking Fine-Grained Physical Plausibility of World Models in Robotics WorldModel

physical plausibility world model benchmark fine-grained evaluation reward model robotics scenarios

简要说明：WorldPhy提出了一个包含300个机器人任务和超过12K人工标注的基准，用于评估世界模型的细粒度物理合理性，训练了比通用VLM更符合人类评分的奖励模型WorldPhyReward，并系统评估了13个世界模型，揭示其在物理一致性上的不足。

TLDR: WorldPhy introduces a benchmark with 300 robotics tasks and over 12K human annotations to evaluate fine-grained physical plausibility of world models, training a reward model (WorldPhyReward) that better aligns with human ratings than general VLMs, and systematically evaluates 13 world models revealing their struggles with physical consistency.

Abstract: World models are increasingly used in robotics to improve the performance of embodied models. Compared with general-purpose video generation, robotics places more stringent requirements on world models. Generated videos must satisfy fine-grained physical constraints on robot motion and object interactions. However, existing world model benchmarks can overlook robotics specific physical details and struggle to assess them accurately. To address this problem, we introduce WorldPhy, a world model benchmark for accurate, fine-grained evaluation of physical plausibility in robotics. Our benchmark contains 300 tasks, each consisting of an initial-frame image and a task instruction, covering diverse robotics scenes, task categories, viewpoints, and robot configurations. We further collect over 12K high-quality human annotations, and use them to train WorldPhyReward to accurately provide scores and reasons across six fine-grained physical dimensions and an instruction-following dimension. Comparisons with general VLMs and existing reward models show that WorldPhyReward better aligns with human ratings. We system- atically evaluate 13 frontier open and closed-source world models. The results reveal that current world models struggle to consistently maintain fine-grained physical plausibility across different robotics scenarios. Our code is available at https://github.com/chuziyuan139/ WorldPhy.

摘要（中文）：世界模型越来越多地被用于机器人技术中，以提升具身模型的性能。与通用视频生成相比，机器人技术对世界模型提出了更严格的要求，生成的视频必须满足机器人运动与物体交互中细粒度的物理约束。然而，现有的世界模型基准可能忽视机器人领域特有的物理细节，并且难以准确评估这些细节。为解决这一问题，我们提出了WorldPhy，一个用于在机器人领域对物理合理性进行准确、细粒度评估的世界模型基准。该基准包含300个任务，每个任务由一幅初始帧图像和一条任务指令组成，涵盖多样的机器人场景、任务类别、视角和机器人配置。我们进一步收集了超过12K条高质量人工标注，并利用这些标注训练了WorldPhyReward，使其能够在六个细粒度物理维度以及一个指令遵循维度上准确地提供评分和原因。与通用视觉语言模型和现有奖励模型的比较表明，WorldPhyReward与人类评分具有更好的一致性。我们系统地评估了13个前沿的开源和闭源世界模型。结果表明，当前的世界模型在不同机器人场景中难以持续保持细粒度的物理合理性。我们的代码可在https://github.com/chuziyuan139/WorldPhy获取。

Authors: Ziyuan Chu, Mingzhi Zheng, Kaiyue Zhang, Jinan Zhang, Linchao Zhu

WAtcher: Watching Ahead for Safe Robotic Manipulation with Efficient World-Action Models VLA

world-action models safety-aware manipulation visual outcome prediction Safe-Guard robot manipulation

简要说明：WAtcher提出了一种安全感知的世界动作框架，在执行动作块前高效想象其视觉结果，并通过可拆卸的Safe-Guard模块在高风险时触发有限后退，从而在不降低成功率的情况下减少危险操纵试验。

TLDR: WAtcher introduces a safety-aware world-action framework that efficiently imagines outcomes of action chunks before execution and uses a detachable Safe-Guard module to trigger bounded retreats when risk is high, reducing hazardous manipulation trials without lowering success.

Abstract: World-action models (WAMs) couple future imagination with action generation, but they execute every action chunk while ignoring the potential risk. To fill this gap, we present WAtcher, a safety-aware world-action framework in which the policy imagines the outcome of the candidate chunk before execution. For fast future preview, WAtcher builds on a compact WAM whose video expert imagines the visual outcome in only two denoising steps. In addition, we propose Safe-Guard, a lightweight module kept outside the WAM that scores each candidate chunk from its imagined outcome and triggers a bounded retreat when the risk is high. Safe-Guard is detachable and can be applied to other WAMs. To train Safe-Guard, we build an autonomous pipeline to collect hazard data from RoboTwin, LIBERO, and a real robot. Specifically, the pipeline perturbs expert demonstrations and labels each candidate chunk from the physical events recorded when it is executed, such as contacts and losses of support. Using the ~25,000 labeled windows from this pipeline, Safe-Guard reaches 92.1% balanced accuracy on a blind set, and cuts hazardous closed-loop trials on training tasks from 27.0% to 10.8% without lowering task success. On a held-out 300-question benchmark, it scores 94.2%, against 72.5% and 63.3% for zero-shot GPT-6-Astra and Claude Opus 5.5. WAtcher also reaches 90.4% and 82.4% average success on RoboTwin 2.0 and ManiSkill3, on par with or above leading WAMs, and 74.0% on five real-world tasks with Safe-Guard on, against 59.5% for $π_{0.5}$. Project page: https://zyshan0929.github.io/WAtcher

摘要（中文）：世界—行动模型（WAMs）将未来想象与行动生成相结合，但它们在执行每个行动块时忽略了潜在风险。为弥补这一缺陷，我们提出了WAtcher——一种具有安全意识的“世界—行动”框架，在该框架中，策略在执行候选行动块之前先想象其可能产生的结果。为实现快速未来预览，WAtcher基于一个紧凑的世界—行动模型构建，其视频专家仅需两次去噪步骤即可想象视觉结果。此外，我们提出了Safe-Guard，一个轻量级模块，置于世界—行动模型之外，根据想象结果对每个候选行动块进行评分，并在风险较高时触发有界回退。Safe-Guard是可拆卸的，可应用于其他世界—行动模型。为训练Safe-Guard，我们构建了一条自动化流水线，从RoboTwin、LIBERO以及真实机器人中收集危险数据。具体而言，该流水线对专家演示进行扰动，并根据执行时记录的物理事件（如接触和支撑丧失）为每个候选行动块标注。利用该流水线收集的约25,000个标注窗口，Safe-Guard在盲测集上达到了92.1%的平衡准确率，并将训练任务中有害闭环试验从27.0%降至10.8%，且不影响任务成功率。在一个包含300个问题的预留基准测试中，Safe-Guard得分94.2%，而零样本GPT-6-Astra和Claude Opus 5.5分别仅得72.5%和63.3%。WAtcher在RoboTwin 2.0和ManiSkill3上的平均成功率也分别达到90.4%和82.4%，与领先的世界—行动模型持平或更高；在五个真实世界任务中，启用Safe-Guard后成功率达74.0%，而π₀.₅仅为59.5%。项目页面：https://zyshan0929.github.io/WAtcher

Authors: Ziyu Shan, Xiao Ma, Kangrui Yu, Changjie Wang, Gaoyuan Wu, Zaijia Yang, Chuanrui Zhang, Qirui Li, Yanbo Zhang, Duomin Wang, Ziwei Wang

CARE-WM: Same-Horizon Self-Conditioning with Constraint-Adaptive Regularization for Latent World Models WorldModel

latent world models self-conditioning constraint-adaptive regularization planning continuous control

简要说明：CARE-WM 提出了一种即插即用的潜在世界模型训练方法，利用自身预测进行训练并自适应调整潜在正则化强度，在不增加额外监督或架构改动的情况下提升了连续控制任务的规划成功率。

TLDR: CARE-WM presents a drop-in training method for latent world models that trains on self-predictions and adaptively calibrates latent regularization, improving planning success across continuous-control tasks without extra supervision or architectural changes.

Abstract: Planning with latent world models requires both accurate multi-step predictions and latent distances that reflect physical proximity to the goal. However, models are typically trained on ground-truth observations but must rely on their own imaginations during planning, while closer latent distances do not necessarily correspond to better task outcomes. Existing methods resort to auxiliary training objectives or additional task-cost readouts, which respectively incur extra training overhead or leave the latent geometry itself misaligned with task cost. We introduce CARE-WM, a drop-in training method that meets both requirements without additional supervision, a separate cost model, or any change to LeWM's architecture and Euclidean-cost planner. CARE-WM trains the predictor on its own predictions and adaptively calibrates the strength of latent regularization. With a single hyperparameter configuration, CARE-WM improves mean planning success over LeWM across all evaluated continuous-control tasks and matches or exceeds the best results of other LeWM-family methods on most tasks. Further analyses show lower open-loop latent prediction error and closer agreement between latent-cost rankings and physical task costs.

摘要（中文）：规划与潜在世界模型需要同时具备准确的多步预测能力，以及能够反映与目标物理接近度的潜在距离。然而，模型通常在真实观测上训练，但在规划时必须依赖自身的想象，且更近的潜在距离并不必然对应更好的任务结果。现有方法诉诸于辅助训练目标或额外的任务成本读取器，这分别带来了额外的训练开销，或使潜在几何本身与任务成本不一致。我们提出CARE-WM，一种即插即用的训练方法，在无需额外监督、独立成本模型或对LeWM架构及其欧几里得成本规划器进行任何改动的情况下，同时满足上述两项要求。CARE-WM在自身预测上训练预测器，并自适应地校准潜在正则化的强度。在单一超参数配置下，CARE-WM在所有评估的连续控制任务上相较LeWM显著提升了平均规划成功率，并在大多数任务上达到或超越了其他LeWM系列方法的最佳结果。进一步分析表明，开环潜在预测误差更低，且潜在成本排序与物理任务成本之间的一致性更高。

Authors: Yuchen Lin, Kai Zhao

Ask to Land: Learning a Mask-Conditioned Open-Vocabulary Landing Policy via Differentiable Physics VLA

open-vocabulary landing differentiable physics mask-conditioned policy quadrotor control YOLO-World with MobileSAM

简要说明：本文提出了一种掩码条件化框架，将冻结的开词汇感知前端（YOLO-World与MobileSAM）与通过可微物理训练的控制策略相结合，使四旋翼无人机能够在无需针对目标微调的情况下，降落在用户提示的平台上，包括移动平台。实际部署验证了其在多种静态和移动物体上的成功着陆。

TLDR: This paper introduces a mask-conditioned framework that integrates a frozen open-vocabulary perception frontend (YOLO-World with MobileSAM) with a control policy trained via differentiable physics, enabling a quadrotor to land on user-prompted platforms, including moving ones, without target-specific fine-tuning. Real-world deployments demonstrate successful landings on diverse static and moving objects.

Abstract: Existing drone landing systems, whether model-based or learning-based, typically rely on predefined visual markers (e.g., ArUco tags) or are trained for specific platform categories, and often assume structured target motion. Recent open-vocabulary studies enable text-prompted target selection, but integrating this capability with learned closed-loop landing control remains underexplored. To this end, we present \textit{Ask to Land}, a mask-conditioned framework that enables a quadrotor to land on various platforms described by a user in natural language, including randomly moving platforms. The core of our approach is the integration of a frozen state-of-the-art open-vocabulary perception frontend (YOLO-World with MobileSAM) and a control policy learned by differentiable physics. By providing real-time, task-agnostic semantic segmentation masks as policy inputs, our framework enables the drone to land on prompt-selected targets without target-specific fine-tuning while continuously tracking dynamic target motion during descent. The frozen frontend processes the prompt, while the policy receives the mask without text embeddings or category labels. To efficiently optimize the control policy, we leverage differentiable physics learning via Backpropagation-Through-Time (BPTT), and employ a carefully designed reward that enforces visual alignment with the landing target and altitude-adaptive descent speed, together with stable control. Real-world deployments validate that our approach achieves landings on diverse user-specified objects, including static and moving platforms.

摘要（中文）：现有无人机着陆系统，无论是基于模型还是基于学习的方法，通常依赖于预定义的视觉标记（例如ArUco标签），或针对特定平台类别进行训练，且往往假设目标运动具有结构性。近期的开放词汇研究实现了通过文本提示进行目标选择，但将此能力与学习型闭环着陆控制相结合仍未得到充分探索。为此，我们提出了\textit{Ask to Land}，一种掩码条件化框架，使四旋翼无人机能够降落在用户以自然语言描述的各种平台上，包括随机移动的平台。我们方法的核心在于整合冻结的最先进开放词汇感知前端（YOLO-World与MobileSAM）以及通过可微物理学习得到的控制策略。通过提供实时的、与任务无关的语义分割掩码作为策略输入，我们的框架使无人机能够降落在提示选定的目标上，无需针对特定目标进行微调，同时在下降过程中持续跟踪动态目标运动。冻结的前端处理提示，而策略仅接收掩码，不涉及文本嵌入或类别标签。为高效优化控制策略，我们利用基于时间反向传播（BPTT）的可微物理学习，并采用精心设计的奖励函数，该函数同时强制与着陆目标的视觉对齐、高度自适应的下降速度以及稳定控制。实际部署验证了我们的方法能够成功降落在各种用户指定的物体上，包括静态和移动平台。

Authors: Fangyu Sun, Guanyan Wu, Yang Deng, Jiahao Cui, Fanxing Li, Yuxiang Huang, Wenxian Yu, Danping Zou

Hetero-Associative Visuomotor Memory: Soft Recall as a Base for Learned Residuals in Few-Demonstration Imitation Manipulation

soft recall learned residuals few-demonstration imitation visuomotor memory retrieval temperature

简要说明：本文提出一种异联想视觉运动记忆（HAVM），利用整个演示集的软加权回忆作为学习残差的基础，在ALOHA、robomimic、LIBERO和真实SO-101机械臂上提升了少样本模仿学习的性能和速度。

TLDR: The paper proposes a hetero-associative visuomotor memory (HAVM) that uses softmax-weighted recall over demonstrations as the base for learned residuals, improving few-shot imitation learning performance and speed across ALOHA, robomimic, LIBERO, and a real SO-101 arm.

Abstract: Retrieve-and-correct policies typically refine the nearest retrieved demonstration chunk, the readout that works best when executed directly. We study what a demonstration memory should supply to the corrector instead and find that a smooth, softmax-weighted recall over the whole memory is a much better base. On ALOHA cube transfer (40 human demonstrations), soft recall is no better to execute alone than the nearest chunk; however, with keys, candidates, and training fixed, correcting it raises success by 22.4 points on fresh resets with new encoders and by 7.4 against a closed-loop-tuned top-1 corrector. On robomimic Square, it leads by 7.9 points with the two better operators and by 6.7 on a label-free draw of equal size. This gain holds on sparse, varied demonstrations under an action-aware key and leave-one-demonstration-out training, and fades or slightly reverses on dense, scripted, or generated data. Building on this finding, our hetero-associative visuomotor memory (HAVM, 14M parameters) trains offline in about five minutes, including a learned retrieval temperature $β$, and runs in 1.1 ms. Across six fresh ALOHA encoders, it reaches 76.4% within 24 s, comparable to a 264M Diffusion Policy trained for 6.7 h (78.8%) and ahead of ACT (71.7%) and fine-tuned VLAs (65.2-75.2%), while leading every 40-demonstration baseline within the benchmark's 8 s limit (74.6%; +6.5 over Diffusion Policy, +15.1 over ACT). On LIBERO, one 40-task memory reaches 92.2% and loses far less than SmolVLA to rewording; on a real SO-101 arm, it sustains 30 Hz control without stalling. Unlike pretrained foundation policies aimed at zero-shot generalization to unseen tasks and workspaces, HAVM trades broad out-of-distribution generalization for rapid adaptation to the available demonstrations.

摘要（中文）：检索-修正策略通常会对最近检索到的演示片段进行细化，这种读出方式在直接执行时效果最佳。我们研究了演示记忆应向前端修正器提供何种信息，结果发现，对整个记忆进行平滑的、经softmax加权的召回是更好的基础。在ALOHA方块转移任务（40条人工演示）中，软召回单独执行的性能并不优于最近邻片段；然而，在键、候选集和训练设置固定的情况下，修正软召回可使成功率达到新的编码器下的新重置场景提升22.4个百分点，相对于闭环调优的top-1修正器提升7.4个百分点。在robomimic Square任务中，在两种较优操作器下领先7.9个百分点，在同等规模的无标签抽取中领先6.7个百分点。这一优势在稀疏、多样化的演示数据下依然成立，前提是使用动作感知的键和留一演示法训练；而在密集、脚本化或生成数据上，该优势减弱甚至出现小幅逆转。基于这一发现，我们提出的异联想视觉运动记忆（HAVM，1400万参数）离线训练仅需约五分钟，包括学习得到的检索温度参数β，推理时间仅为1.1毫秒。在六个全新的ALOHA编码器上，它在24秒内达到76.4%的成功率，与训练了6.7小时的264M扩散策略（78.8%）相当，并优于ACT（71.7%）和微调后的VLA模型（65.2–75.2%），同时在基准测试的8秒限制内领先所有40条演示的基线方法（74.6%；较扩散策略高出6.5个百分点，较ACT高出15.1个百分点）。在LIBERO上，单个40任务记忆达到92.2%的成功率，且在措辞变更时的性能下降远小于SmolVLA；在真实的SO-101机械臂上，它能以30 Hz的频率持续控制而不中断。与旨在对未见任务和工作空间进行零样本泛化的预训练基础策略不同，HAVM以牺牲广泛的分布外泛化为代价，换取对现有演示的快速适应能力。

Authors: Runcong Wang

Aegis-VLA: Reliability-Gated Action Refinement via a Trajectory World Model for Dynamic Object Manipulation VLA

world model action refinement reliability gate dynamic object manipulation vision-language-action model

简要说明：Aegis-VLA通过轨迹世界模型预测纠正动作，并利用可靠性门控选择性地应用这些纠正，从而提升了动态对象操作任务的成功率。

TLDR: Aegis-VLA enhances vision-language-action policies for dynamic object manipulation by using a trajectory world model to predict corrections and a reliability gate to selectively apply them, improving success rates on the DOM benchmark.

Abstract: Dynamic object manipulation requires maintaining spatial and temporal alignment with targets that continue to move during inference and execution. Although future prediction can inform action correction, an accurate forecast does not establish whether modifying an existing action would be beneficial. We present Aegis-VLA, a world-model-guided vision-language-action (VLA) framework that generates predictive action corrections and separately determines whether and how strongly to apply them. A Trajectory World Model combines kinematic extrapolation with learned residual dynamics to predict object motion and estimate positional uncertainty. Discrepancy-Guided Action Refinement uses differences between history-only and base-action-conditioned end-effector forecasts to propose bounded arm corrections. A Reliability Gate learns when to admit corrections based on demonstration-relative improvements over base actions, and regulates their application during inference using predictive uncertainty and anticipated object--end-effector proximity. Rejected corrections preserve the corresponding base actions. Aegis-VLA introduces only approximately 2.45M trainable parameters. On the simulated Dynamic Object Manipulation (DOM) benchmark, Aegis-VLA achieves 56.72\% success over 1,800 evaluation trials, exceeding our reproduced DynamicVLA baseline of 45.44\% by 11.28 percentage points.

摘要（中文）：动态物体操作要求在与推理和执行过程中持续运动的目标保持空间和时间上的对齐。尽管未来预测可以为动作修正提供信息，但准确的预测并不能确定修改现有动作是否有益。我们提出了Aegis-VLA，一种世界模型引导的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）框架，该框架生成预测性动作修正，并分别决定是否及以何种强度应用这些修正。轨迹世界模型将运动学外推与学习到的残差动力学相结合，以预测物体运动并估计位置不确定性。差异引导的动作精化利用仅基于历史数据的末端执行器预测与基于基础动作条件化的预测之间的差异，提出有界的机械臂修正。一个可靠性门控根据相较于基础动作的示范相对改进学习何时允许修正，并在推理过程中利用预测不确定性和预期的物体-末端执行器接近程度来调节修正的应用。被拒绝的修正保留相应的基础动作。Aegis-VLA仅引入了约245万可训练参数。在模拟动态物体操作（DOM）基准上，Aegis-VLA在1800次评估试验中取得了56.72%的成功率，比我们复现的DynamicVLA基线高出11.28个百分点。

Authors: Lennox Wei, Jiaqi Yao, Shixin Sun, Yuanzheng Zhang, Jianhua Han, Meng Tian, Shaohui Liu, Wangmeng Zuo

Targeted Adaptation of World-Action Models via Interaction and Motion Heads VLA

Next-Interaction Heads Motion Heads Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning World-Action Models Robot Manipulation

简要说明：HeadLight识别并联合调整世界动作模型中的下一交互头部和运动头部，仅更新1.1%的参数便获得更高成功率。

TLDR: HeadLight identifies and jointly adapts Next-Interaction and Motion attention heads in World-Action Models for robot manipulation, achieving higher success with only 1.1% of parameters updated.

Abstract: World-Action Models (WAMs) are a promising new paradigm of robot manipulation policies that jointly generate future video and actions. Successful manipulation requires both identifying where to interact and modeling how the robot and objects move. Yet standard adaptation methods, such as full fine-tuning and LoRA, do not explicitly select parameters aligned with these manipulation-specific capabilities. Motivated by this challenge, we discover two functionally specialized families of attention heads: Next-Interaction Heads, which localize upcoming grasp-and-release targets, and Motion Heads, which track movement across frames. Furthermore, we introduce HeadLight, a parameter-efficient refinement method that jointly adapts Next-Interaction Heads and Motion Heads. On RoboTwin tasks unseen during fine-tuning, HeadLight achieves 62.28% success, compared with 57.89% for full fine-tuning and 58.66% for LoRA, while updating only 1.1% of parameters. Inference-time ablations further validate the functional importance of these heads: ablating Motion Heads reduces manipulation success from 57.89% to 0.94%, while ablating Next-Interaction Heads lowers it to 40.61%, both substantially more than ablating equally many random heads. Finally, we show that our approach is effective across multiple WAM architectures and real-robot manipulation settings.

摘要（中文）：世界-动作模型（WAMs）是一种前景广阔的新型机器人操作策略范式，可联合生成未来视频与动作。成功的操作既需要识别交互位置，也需要建模机器人及物体的运动方式。然而，标准的适配方法（如全量微调和LoRA）并未显式选择与这些操作特定能力对齐的参数。受该挑战驱动，我们发现了两个功能特化的注意力头家族：下一交互头（Next-Interaction Heads），用于定位即将发生的抓取与释放目标；以及运动头（Motion Heads），用于追踪跨帧运动。此外，我们提出了HeadLight，一种参数高效的精细化方法，可联合适配下一交互头和运动头。在微调中未见的RoboTwin任务上，HeadLight取得了62.28%的成功率，而全量微调和LoRA分别为57.89%和58.66%，同时仅更新1.1%的参数。推理时的消融实验进一步验证了这些注意力头的功能重要性：消融运动头使操作成功率从57.89%降至0.94%，消融下一交互头则降至40.61%，两者均显著高于消融同等数量随机注意力头所带来的影响。最后，我们证明了该方法在多种WAM架构及真实机器人操作场景中均有效。

Authors: Yuze Zhu, Jacky Li, Yusen Luo, Ken Jiankun Zheng, Chancharik Mitra, Trevor Darrell, Roei Herzig

Beyond the Happy Path: Generalizing Robot World Models from Simulated Failures WorldModel

World models Robot manipulation Simulated failures Action-conditioned prediction Generalization

简要说明：WorldReforge 通过构建模拟失败轨迹数据集，并利用交互对齐和表面一致性两种训练信号，解决了机器人世界模型在抓取失误等非理想情况下预测失效的问题，显著提高了物体运动预测精度，并能泛化到真实失败视频。

TLDR: WorldReforge addresses the failure of robot world models to predict off-happy-path manipulation by constructing a simulated dataset of failed trajectories and using two training signals, Interaction Alignment and Surface Correspondence, to significantly improve object-motion prediction, even generalizing to real failure videos.

Abstract: Robot world models are increasingly used to evaluate and plan policies, yet robot training data are dominated by successful demonstrations. Off the happy path, when a grasp is misaligned or mistimed and the object is pushed, tilted, or slips, their predictions break down. Across five pretrained action-conditioned models, object-motion error is at most 10.4% lower than that of a static baseline that copies the first frame, and two models are worse than this baseline. We present WorldReforge, which teaches world models what happens when manipulation goes wrong. We construct the Reforge dataset of 62k simulated trajectories by perturbing reference grasps in position, orientation, and closure timing, recording each resulting push, slip, or failed pickup with ground-truth object pose, contact, and surface points. WorldReforge turns this ground truth into two training signals without additional inference cost. Interaction Alignment focuses reconstruction on the small object and contact regions that a global loss underweights, and Surface Correspondence trains backbone features to follow the same physical surface points across frames. On Cosmos3 Nano, WorldReforge reduces object trajectory error by 28.2% overall and by 35.0% on unseen objects, and it lowers the error in predicting how two actions' outcomes diverge by 43.3%. Although trained only in simulation, it also improves reconstruction on DROID and on real failure videos. Controlled data studies show that failed contact and successful holding teach complementary physics: failed contact teaches how objects respond, and holding teaches how a grasped state persists. Our code, data, and models are available at aim-uofa.github.io/WorldReforge/.

摘要（中文）：机器人的世界模型越来越多地被用于评估和规划策略，然而机器人训练数据中占据主导地位的却是成功的示范。偏离顺利路径时，当抓取出现错位或时机不当，物体被推倒、倾斜或滑动，这些模型的预测便会失效。在五个预训练的动作条件模型中，物体运动误差最多仅比复制首帧的静态基线低10.4%，且有两个模型的表现甚至不如该基线。我们提出了WorldReforge，旨在教会世界模型当操作出错时会发生什么。我们通过在位置、姿态和闭合时机上扰动参考抓取，构建了包含6.2万条模拟轨迹的Reforge数据集，并记录了每次由此产生的推挤、滑动或抓取失败，同时提供物体真实位姿、接触点和表面点信息。WorldReforge将这些真实信息转化为两种训练信号，且不增加推理成本。交互对齐将重建重点聚焦于全局损失所忽略的小物体及其接触区域，而表面对应则训练骨干特征在帧间追踪同一物理表面点。在Cosmos3 Nano上，WorldReforge将物体轨迹误差总体降低28.2%，对未见物体降低35.0%，并将两个动作结果分歧的预测误差降低43.3%。尽管仅在模拟环境中训练，它同样改善了DROID数据集及真实失败视频上的重建效果。受控数据研究表明，失败接触与成功持握传授了互补的物理知识：失败接触教会物体如何响应，而持握教会被抓取状态如何维持。我们的代码、数据和模型可在aim-uofa.github.io/WorldReforge/获取。

Authors: Zhiyue Zhao, Mingyu Liu, Bolin Zhang, Liyang Li, Guangyu Huang, Canyu Zhao, Jinchuan Shi, Haokai Zhang, Hao Chen, Chunhua Shen

CoTAMP: Cooperative Task and Motion Planning for Quadruped Robots with Large Language Models Locomotion

cooperative task and motion planning quadruped robots large language models kinematic synthesis trajectory optimization

简要说明：该论文提出了CoTAMP，一个结合LLM模块和代码模块的四足机器人协同任务与运动规划框架，能够发明新颖的协同动作并生成运动学上有效的轨迹，并在仿真中进行了验证。

TLDR: The paper proposes CoTAMP, a framework combining LLM-based and code-based modules for cooperative task and motion planning of quadruped robots, enabling them to invent novel cooperative motions and generate kinematically valid trajectories, validated in simulation.

Abstract: Some environments cannot be traversed by a single quadruped robot, for example a ledge that one robot can climb only from its partner's back or a gap that must be bridged with boxes. Solving them requires cooperative task and motion planning (TAMP). Previous works are limited to the motions of a single robot or only select actions from a predefined set of skills. We propose a framework with two parts: task planning that invents motions not defined in advance, and motion generation that realizes the invented motions. Both parts consist of large language model (LLM)-based modules and code-based modules. Task planning divides the trajectory of the whole task into steps and fixes the robot poses at the step boundaries. Motion generation produces keyframes that describe the motion of each step and turns them into a continuous trajectory through kinematic synthesis. The code-based modules check every plan and motion and return failures to the LLM-based modules for correction. The whole trajectory is then refined by trajectory optimization to satisfy the dynamics. On three simulated courses with two RAIBO2 robot models, our framework produced kinematically valid references in all 30 trials, all of which converged in trajectory optimization. Compared with several baselines, our framework showed advantages in success rate, dynamic feasibility, execution time, and generation time and cost. Project page: https://woojin8098.github.io/CoTAMP/

摘要（中文）：有些环境单靠一台四足机器人无法穿越，例如，一台机器人只能借助同伴的背部攀爬的崖壁，或者必须用箱子搭桥才能跨越的沟壑。解决这些问题需要协作式任务与运动规划（TAMP）。以往的研究局限于单机器人的运动，或只能从预定义的技能集中选择动作。我们提出一个包含两部分的框架：一部分是任务规划，用于发明未预先定义的运动；另一部分是运动生成，用于实现这些新发明的运动。两部分均由基于大语言模型（LLM）的模块和基于代码的模块组成。任务规划将整个任务的轨迹划分为若干步骤，并固定步骤边界处的机器人位姿。运动生成则生成描述每个步骤运动的关键帧，并通过运动学综合将其转化为连续轨迹。基于代码的模块对每个规划和运动进行检查，并将失败信息返回给基于LLM的模块进行修正。随后，整个轨迹通过轨迹优化进行细化，以满足动力学约束。在包含两个RAIBO2机器人模型的三组模拟课程中，我们的框架在所有30次试验中都生成了运动学上有效的参考轨迹，且全部在轨迹优化中收敛。与多个基线方法相比，我们的框架在成功率、动力学可行性、执行时间以及生成时间和成本方面均表现出优势。项目页面：https://woojin8098.github.io/CoTAMP/

Authors: Woojin Kim, Jemin Hwangbo

Integration of Vision-Language-Action Control for Autonomous Forklift Unloading with Limited Real-World Data VLA

Vision-Language-Action model autonomous forklift limited real-world data simulation-to-real sequential decision-making

简要说明：本文首次将视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型应用于自主叉车卸载任务，利用仿真数据和极少量真实数据(9.38小时仿真、0.8小时真实)适配预训练VLA模型，并通过72次真实试验验证。

TLDR: This paper presents the first application of a vision-language-action (VLA) model to autonomous forklift unloading, adapting a pretrained VLA model with simulation and minimal real-world data (9.38h sim, 0.8h real) and validating it in 72 real trials.

Abstract: Forklifts play a critical role in warehousing and distribution, but existing automation systems remain limited in handling complex tasks that require sequential decision-making. Recently, vision--language--action (VLA) models have emerged as a promising approach for multi-step decision-making by directly generating control actions from visual observations and language prompts. Although VLA-based control has been extensively researched for manipulators, to the best of our knowledge, its application to forklifts remains unexplored. Therefore, this study demonstrates the integration of VLA control for an autonomous forklift unloading task with limited real-world data. Moreover, training VLA models typically requires large-scale datasets. As there is currently no public dataset for forklift operations, we use a VLA model pretrained primarily on robotic manipulator data and construct a training dataset via simulation, which can be scaled up at low cost. We then adapt the pretrained VLA model to forklift control using 9.38 h of simulation data and 0.8 h of real-world demonstrations, with the latter accounting for approximately 8% of the collected forklift data by duration. The integrated system was validated through 72 real-world trials across four model variants. The results show that the proposed system can accomplish an unloading task even with limited real-world data.

摘要（中文）：叉车在仓储和物流领域扮演着关键角色，但现有自动化系统在处理需要序贯决策的复杂任务方面仍存在局限。近年来，视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型作为一种通过直接从视觉观察和语言提示生成控制动作来实现多步决策的新兴方法，展现出良好前景。尽管基于VLA的控制已在机械臂领域得到广泛研究，但据我们所知，其在叉车上的应用尚未被探索。因此，本研究展示了一种将VLA控制集成到自主叉车卸货任务中的方法，且仅需有限的真实世界数据。此外，训练VLA模型通常需要大规模数据集。由于目前尚无公开的叉车操作数据集，我们采用了一个主要在机械臂数据上预训练的VLA模型，并通过仿真构建训练数据集，从而以低成本实现数据扩展。随后，我们利用9.38小时的仿真数据和0.8小时的真实世界演示数据对预训练的VLA模型进行叉车控制适配，其中后者按时长约占所收集叉车数据的8%。该系统通过四种模型变体在72次真实世界试验中进行了验证。结果表明，所提出的系统即使在有限真实数据条件下也能完成卸货任务。

Authors: Koshi Oishi, Seigo Ito

Learning a Whole-Body Pivot-Walking Gait for Heavy-Box Transport with a Humanoid HumanoidEmbodied

reinforcement learning whole-body control pivot walking humanoid robot sim-to-real

简要说明：本文提出了一种单一强化学习策略，联合协调人形机器人的踏步、平衡和物体操作，实现重箱的枢转行走，并成功迁移到实体机器人上。

TLDR: This paper presents a single reinforcement learning policy that jointly coordinates stepping, balance, and object manipulation for humanoid pivot walking of heavy boxes, and successfully transfers it to a real humanoid robot using an object-blind version with a time-based clock.

Abstract: Through pivot walking, humans can transport objects that are too heavy to lift. Previous humanoid studies have relied on planned sequences in which object manipulation and stepping are executed separately and the object is brought to rest between successive rotations. However, few studies have developed a single learned controller for humanoid pivot walking. In this paper, we propose a single reinforcement-learning policy that jointly coordinates stepping, balance control, and object manipulation. The policy is trained using rewards that promote alternating pivot motions and a phase reference that progresses according to the displacement of the object. In simulation, we confirmed that the humanoid can pivot a box. For deployment, we fine-tuned the policy into an object-blind version that follows a periodic clock instead of the progress reference. On the real robot, the deployed policy transported the box forward by more than 1 m in all five trials; each trial ended at a base-tilt safety stop. These results demonstrate that coordinated humanoid pivot walking can be learned with reinforcement learning and transferred to a physical humanoid robot without direct object-state sensing.

摘要（中文）：通过枢转行走，人类能够搬运那些因过重而无法直接举起的物体。以往的人形机器人研究多依赖于预设序列，其中物体操作与步伐执行相互分离，且在连续旋转之间需使物体静止。然而，鲜有研究为人形机器人枢转行走开发出单一的学习型控制器。本文提出了一种统一的强化学习策略，该策略协同协调步伐、平衡控制与物体操作。该策略依据奖励函数进行训练，以促进交替枢转动作，并通过一个随物体位移进展的相位参考来引导过程。在仿真环境中，我们验证了人形机器人能够枢转箱子。为实际部署，我们将该策略微调为不依赖物体状态感知的版本，其依据周期性时钟而非进度参考进行运作。在真实机器人上，部署后的策略在全部五次试验中均成功将箱子向前搬运超过1米；每次试验均以基座倾斜安全停止告终。这些结果表明，协调的人形机器人枢转行走可通过强化学习习得，并能在不直接感知物体状态的情况下迁移至物理人形机器人。

Authors: Rikuto Hidaka, Tsung-Yuan Chen, Kento Kawaharazuka

$\widetilde{\varepsilon}$: Does Initial Noise Induce Directional Bias in Vision-Language-Action Models? VLA

diffusion policy initial noise directional bias antithetic noise robustness

简要说明：本文揭示了VLA扩散策略中初始噪声导致的动作方向偏差，并提出通过反对称噪声训练和时间均值去除来提升动作鲁棒性，在仿真和真实机器人上显著提高成功率。

TLDR: This paper identifies a directional bias in VLA diffusion policies caused by initial noise and proposes antithetic noise training plus temporal mean removal to improve action robustness and task success rates on simulations and real robots.

Abstract: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) have widely adopted diffusion-based action generation for continuous robot motions, enabling fine-grained control across diverse tasks. However, recent studies have shown that their performance is highly sensitive to initial noise, with resulting action errors that make recovery difficult during execution. Existing approaches search for favorable noise initializations to improve performance, yet the action expert itself remains sensitive to noise. In this work, we reveal that initial noise induces a consistent directional bias in action space that closely aligns with the noise's temporal mean. We thus introduce a simple yet effective framework that improves robustness to initial noise through interventions during both training and inference. During training, we enforce consistent action predictions from antithetic noise pairs $(ε, -ε)$ and, at inference, remove the noise's temporal mean. Our method substantially reduces action deviation and improves task performance across simulation benchmarks. In real-robot experiments, our method increases the average task success rate of $π_{0.5}$ from 40% to 68%, with more stable and consistent execution.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作模型（VLAs）已广泛采用基于扩散的动作生成方法来处理连续机器人运动，从而实现对多种任务的细粒度控制。然而，近期研究表明，这类模型的性能对初始噪声高度敏感，由此产生的动作误差在执行过程中难以纠正。现有方法通过搜索有利的噪声初始化来提升性能，但动作专家本身对噪声的敏感性仍未得到解决。在本工作中，我们揭示了初始噪声会在动作空间中引发一致的方向性偏差，且该偏差与噪声的时间均值密切相关。为此，我们提出了一种简洁而有效的框架，通过在训练和推理阶段分别引入干预措施来增强模型对初始噪声的鲁棒性。训练阶段，我们强制对抗噪声对 $(ε, -ε)$ 产生一致的动作预测；推理阶段，则去除噪声的时间均值。我们的方法显著减少了动作偏差，并在多个仿真基准上提升了任务性能。在真实机器人实验中，该方法将 $π_{0.5}$ 的平均任务成功率从40%提高到68%，执行过程也更加稳定和一致。

Authors: Junmyeong Lee, Dongmin Shin, Wooseok Jeon, JunGyu Lee, Seunghyun Shin, Hae-Gon Jeon

Dynamic Forcing: Learning Action-Grounded Sparse Dynamic Representations with Dense Future Guidance for World Action Models VLA

world action models sparse dynamic representation Dynamic Forcing action-grounded learning visual prediction

简要说明：该论文提出CompactWAM与动态强制（Dynamic Forcing）框架，通过动作监督和密集未来引导学习紧凑的动作相关动态令牌，在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin及真实机器人操作中取得高成功率，同时仅使用密集未来令牌预算的一小部分。

TLDR: This paper proposes CompactWAM with Dynamic Forcing, a sparse-dense joint predictive framework for world action models that learns compact action-relevant dynamic tokens guided by action supervision and dense future guidance, achieving high success rates on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, RoboTwin, and real robot manipulation while using only a small fraction of the dense future token budget.

Abstract: World action models (WAMs) support robot control through visual prediction, but dense future modeling repeatedly encodes static context already available in the current observation, while action-relevant changes are often spatially sparse. We study sparse dynamic representation learning, retaining the current observation as a contextual anchor and using a small set of compact dynamic tokens to represent anticipated changes. We develop CompactWAM, a sparse-dense joint predictive framework that enables sparse representation learning within a video-supervised shared backbone, without requiring a reconstruction objective for the sparse pathway. Since a limited token budget alone does not specify which information to retain, we introduce Dynamic Forcing, which pairs direct action supervision with privileged dense future guidance to promote action relevance and dynamic fidelity. While action prediction gradients directly drive compact tokens to capture control-relevant cues, dense future guidance further shapes them via action functional guidance that matches sparse and dense contributions to the action expert, and dynamics-aware distribution matching, which aligns temporal relational changes relative to a static reference. At inference, a single visual forward pass encodes current observations and compact dynamic tokens for action generation, eliminating dense future modeling. CompactWAM achieves 98.4\% success on LIBERO and 77.9\% on LIBERO-Plus, retaining respective success rates of 98.3\% and 76.6\% with only 9.2\% of the dense future token budget. Evaluations on RoboTwin~2.0 and real-world manipulation further demonstrate the effectiveness of the learned sparse predictive representations.

摘要（中文）：世界动作模型通过视觉预测支持机器人控制，但密集的未来建模会重复编码当前观测中已经存在的静态上下文，而动作相关的变化通常在空间上是稀疏的。我们研究稀疏动态表示学习，保留当前观测作为上下文锚点，并使用一小组紧凑的动态令牌来表示预期变化。我们开发了CompactWAM，一种稀疏-密集联合预测框架，使得在视频监督的共享骨干网络中无需为稀疏路径设置重建目标即可实现稀疏表示学习。由于有限的令牌预算本身并不能指定要保留哪些信息，我们引入了动态强制机制，将直接的动作监督与特权密集未来引导相结合，以促进动作相关性和动态保真度。动作预测梯度直接驱动紧凑令牌捕获控制相关线索，而密集未来引导通过动作功能引导进一步塑造它们，该引导将稀疏和密集贡献与动作专家匹配，以及动态感知分布匹配，对齐相对于静态参考的时间关系变化。在推理时，单个视觉前向传递编码当前观测和用于动作生成的紧凑动态令牌，无需密集未来建模。CompactWAM在LIBERO上达到98.4%的成功率，在LIBERO-Plus上达到77.9%，仅使用9.2%的密集未来令牌预算即可保持98.3%和76.6%的相应成功率。在RoboTwin 2.0和真实世界操作上的评估进一步证明了所学习的稀疏预测表示的有效性。

Authors: Ziqiang Li, Shisheng Chen, Yunnan Wang, Wenyao Zhang, Zili Lin, Yuyang Zhang, Xudong Yang, Fangzhuo Jin, Chenyu Zhou, Wenjun Zeng, Xin Jin

DriftWAM: Faster World-Action Models via Action-Aware Video Drifting WorldModel

world-action models few-step distillation action-aware video drifting joint visual-action kernel robotic manipulation

简要说明：DriftWAM提出了一种用于世界动作模型的少步蒸馏框架，通过动作感知视频漂移和动作引导视频正则化，在激进步数减少下提升下游机器人控制性能，并在RoboTwin 2.0、LIBERO和真实机器人上验证。

TLDR: DriftWAM proposes a few-step distillation framework for world-action models that integrates action-aware video drifting and action-guided video regularization to improve downstream robotic control performance under aggressive step reduction, validated on RoboTwin 2.0, LIBERO, and real robots.

Abstract: World-action models (WAMs) unify future video prediction and action generation for robotic control, but their reliance on iterative denoising incurs substantial inference costs. Distilling these models into few-step generators offers a promising route to efficient deployment, yet maintaining task performance under aggressive step reduction remains challenging. Existing methods rely on point-wise trajectory consistency distillation, which pursues high visual fidelity while leaving downstream action information unexploited in optimizing video generation, and also lacks explicit distribution-level alignment. To address this, we propose DriftWAM, a few-step WAM distillation framework that incorporates the actions induced by predicted videos into video learning. Specifically, DriftWAM integrates action-aware video drifting, which performs video distribution matching through a joint visual--action similarity kernel to steer sample evolution under the guidance of these induced actions, with action-guided video regularization, which leverages the compatible teacher--student matches identified by the joint kernel to backpropagate action-level gradients directly into the video generator. Evaluations on the RoboTwin 2.0 and LIBERO benchmarks, as well as in real-world robotic manipulation tasks, show that DriftWAM consistently outperforms prior consistency distillation methods across few-step settings at the same inference speed.

摘要（中文）：世界-动作模型（WAMs）统一了未来视频预测与机器人控制中的动作生成，但其对迭代去噪的依赖导致了高昂的推理成本。将这些模型蒸馏为少步生成器是实现高效部署的一条有前景的路径，然而在激进的步数缩减下维持任务性能仍然具有挑战性。现有方法依赖点式轨迹一致性蒸馏，该策略追求较高的视觉保真度，却在优化视频生成时未充分利用下游动作信息，同时也缺乏显式的分布级对齐。为解决这一问题，我们提出了DriftWAM，一种少步WAM蒸馏框架，将预测视频所诱发的动作纳入视频学习之中。具体而言，DriftWAM整合了动作感知的视频漂移机制，该机制通过联合视觉-动作相似性核执行视频分布匹配，从而在这些诱发动作的引导下驱动样本演化；同时结合动作引导的视频正则化，利用联合核所识别的师生兼容匹配对，将动作级梯度直接反向传播至视频生成器。在RoboTwin 2.0和LIBERO基准测试以及真实机器人操作任务上的评估表明，在相同推理速度下，DriftWAM在少步设置中持续优于先前的一致性蒸馏方法。

Authors: Minyang Li, Siyu Xu, Yunke Wang, Ying-Cong Chen, Chang Xu, Daochang Liu

Triage Before Fine-Tuning: Feasibility-Gated Selection and Monitored Adaptation of Embodied Foundation Models for a Fixed Physical Platform AutonomousDriving

feasibility-gated selection sensing gap latency gap closed-loop monitoring fine-tuning

简要说明：本文提出TRIAGE，一种针对固定机器人平台的具身基础模型选择与微调的五阶段流程，区分传感器、延迟和分布差距，并在驾驶基准和真实车辆上验证。

TLDR: The paper presents TRIAGE, a five-stage pipeline for selecting and fine-tuning embodied foundation models on a fixed robot platform, distinguishing sensing, latency, and distribution gaps, and validating it on driving benchmarks and a real vehicle.

Abstract: Embodied foundation models are increasingly deployed by selection: a practitioner picks a public checkpoint by benchmark rank and fine-tunes it on local data. The platform is fixed before the model is chosen, with little or no local data. We ask what such a checkpoint loses on a fixed platform and which part of the loss local data can buy back. We split the gap by what can repair it. A sensing gap, information the sensors do not capture, cannot be closed with their data; a latency gap, output arriving after the control loop needs it, belongs to the loop, not the weights; only a distribution gap is fine-tuning's to repair. TRIAGE turns this into feasibility-gated selection and monitored adaptation in five stages: gates on the sensor contract and on end-to-end latency that no score can override, probes on ten minutes of local logs, a ranking by target-relevant score among the candidates that pass, and fine-tuning that is monitored and checked in closed loop before release. On driving benchmarks, a deadline below a leading closed-loop model's latency makes it collide on 80 to 90% of routes, and losing field of view moves plans 2.2 to 5.7 times more than losing resolution at equal pixels. Local frames close 75% of a stability gap but raise perturbation sensitivity at small budgets, and picking by score violates a gate in two of four deployment profiles. On a full-scale vehicle, the factory camera failed the sensing gate and an added camera repaired it. The latency gate removed the two highest-scoring candidates, neither of which completed a closed-loop trip. The selected model passed acceptance in 4 of 5 closed-loop trips, and the closed-loop check withheld a fine-tuned model that had improved offline. TRIAGE lets organizations that cannot train foundation models from scratch find out whether a public checkpoint can run on the robot or vehicle they own, and what to fix if not.

摘要（中文）：具身基础模型日益通过筛选方式被部署：从业者根据基准排名选择公开检查点，并在本地数据上进行微调。平台在模型选定之前就已固定，且几乎没有或完全没有本地数据可供参考。我们探究该检查点在固定平台上会损失什么，以及本地数据能够挽回其中哪部分损失。我们依据可修复性对差距进行划分：感知差距——传感器未捕获的信息——无法用其数据弥合；延迟差距——输出在控制回路需要之后才到达——属于回路问题而非权重问题；只有分布差距是微调可以修复的。TRIAGE将此转化为五阶段的可通过性门控选择与受监控自适应：对传感器合同和端到端延迟进行门控，任何评分均无法超越；对十分钟本地日志进行探测；在通过门控的候选者中按目标相关评分进行排序；以及在发布前于闭环中进行受监控并核查的微调。在驾驶基准测试中，若截止时间低于领先闭环模型的延迟，该模型将在80%至90%的路线上发生碰撞；在像素相等的情况下，视野丢失对规划的影响是分辨率丢失的2.2至5.7倍。本地帧可弥合75%的稳定性差距，但在小预算下会提高扰动敏感性；按评分选择在四种部署场景中有两种违反了门控约束。在全尺寸车辆上，工厂摄像头未通过感知门控，加装摄像头后得以修复。延迟门控剔除了两个评分最高的候选者，二者均未能完成闭环行驶。所选模型在5次闭环行驶中4次通过验收，而闭环检查拒绝了一个离线表现改善的微调模型。TRIAGE使无法从零训练基础模型的组织能够判断公开检查点是否可在其拥有的机器人或车辆上运行，以及若不适用应修复哪些环节。

Authors: Zilin Huang, Zhengyang Wan, Zihao Sheng, Boyue Wang, Ruolin Yang, Yuhao Luo, Sikai Chen

FailPoint-X: A Policy-Matched, Failure-Anchored Benchmark for Offline VLA Post-Training from Human Takeovers VLA

VLA post-training human takeovers failure-annotated benchmark behavior cloning offline RL

简要说明：FailPoint-X是一个用于从人类接管中进行离线VLA后训练的基准，在LIBERO-X任务上提供策略匹配的评估。它表明从恢复轨迹进行行为克隆可以提高恢复率，但可能降低名义性能，凸显了后训练中的权衡。

TLDR: FailPoint-X is a benchmark for offline VLA post-training from human takeovers, providing policy-matched evaluations on LIBERO-X tasks. It shows behavior cloning from recoveries improves recovery rates but can degrade nominal performance, highlighting trade-offs in post-training.

Abstract: Human takeovers offer corrective supervision for vision-language-action (VLA) policies, but their contribution to offline post-training must be separated from that of continued optimization. We introduce FailPoint-X, a benchmark for offline VLA post-training with human takeovers. To represent uncertainty in failure onset, an annotator marks an interval for each failure, and training takeovers start at seeded frames sampled within it. From one fixed $π_{0.5}$ checkpoint, which also initializes post-training, we assemble 629 natural failures across 10 LIBERO-X task families at up to five difficulty levels. All 2,823 takeover attempts are logged; 2,400 are accepted recoveries, of which 2,320 are used for post-training. Evaluation restarts every method from the fixed midpoints of 384 held-out failure intervals. Under matched actor-update counts, we compare behavior cloning of recoveries, value-based offline learning on recoveries and failed rollouts, and continued training on existing demonstrations. Within 1,200 steps on the 240 L1-L3 held-out failures, cloning improves recovery by 29.4 percentage points (pp) over the demonstration-only control; the value-based learner does not establish a further gain (1.5 pp). In exploratory evaluation from L1-L5 nominal starts at the same horizon, cloning loses 30.0 pp of success relative to the base policy; mixing in demonstrations reduces the loss to 16.5 pp, a reduction that shrinks under a stricter, pre-specified horizon. Restorable failure states and a shared evaluator let all methods be compared from identical starts.

摘要（中文）：人类接管为视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略提供了纠正性监督，但其对离线后训练的贡献必须与持续优化的贡献区分开来。我们引入了FailPoint-X，一个用于人类接管下离线VLA后训练的基准。为了表示失败起始时间的不确定性，标注者为每次失败标记一个区间，训练接管从该区间内采样的种子帧开始。从固定的$π_{0.5}$检查点（该检查点同时用于初始化后训练）出发，我们汇集了跨10个LIBERO-X任务族、多达五个难度级别的629个自然失败案例。所有2,823次接管尝试均被记录；其中2,400次为可接受的恢复，2,320次用于后训练。评估从384个保留失败区间的固定中点重新启动每种方法。在匹配的演员更新次数下，我们比较了恢复轨迹的行为克隆、基于价值的离线学习（使用恢复轨迹和失败轨迹），以及基于现有演示的持续训练。在240个保留的L1-L3失败区间上，经过1,200步训练，行为克隆相比仅使用演示的对照组将恢复成功率提高了29.4个百分点（pp）；基于价值的学习器未带来进一步提升（1.5 pp）。在L1-L5名义起点的探索性评估中，相同训练步数下，行为克隆相对于基础策略损失了30.0 pp的成功率；混合演示可将损失降至16.5 pp，但在更严格的预定评估时域下，该降幅会缩小。可恢复的失败状态和共享评估器使所有方法能够从相同的起点进行比较。

Authors: Zirui Li, Yujie Yan, Jingxuan Qian, Yangang Ren, Haizhou Yin, Haoran Xu, Chen Lv

$\mathrm{M}^{2}$-WAM: Efficient Hierarchical Memory Across Modalities and Timescales for World-Action Models Manipulation

world-action model hierarchical memory long-horizon manipulation interaction memory gated delta updates

简要说明：M2-WAM 为世界-动作模型引入分层记忆系统，结合密集短期视觉记忆、固定大小关联长期记忆和动作前缀交互记忆，提升了长时程机器人操作效率和成功率。

TLDR: M2-WAM introduces a hierarchical memory system for world-action models, combining dense short-term visual memory with fixed-size associative long-term memory and interaction memory for action prefixes, improving long-horizon robotic manipulation efficiency and success rates.

Abstract: Long-horizon robotic manipulation requires historical context, yet retaining extensive visual histories incurs growing storage and retrieval costs, while aggressive compression risks losing fine-grained information needed for subsequent decisions. Moreover, executed action histories capture intermediate behaviors that sparse visual observations may miss. Preserving this complementary context efficiently calls for modality-specific memory mechanisms that balance recent detail with long-term retention. To this end, we introduce $\mathrm{M}^{2}$-WAM, a world-action model equipped with hierarchical visual and interaction memories. $\mathrm{M}^{2}$-WAM preserves recent visual observations in dense short-term memory while consolidating entries evicted from this window into fixed-size associative long-term memory through gated delta updates. Within the same short- and long-term hierarchy, interaction memory encodes executed action prefixes into compact temporal representations, complementing visual observations with behavioral context. These complementary memories are integrated into world-action modeling through layer-wise retrieval, enabling memory-augmented action generation with a bounded online memory footprint independent of episode length. On the memory-dependent simulation benchmarks MIKASA-Robo and RMBench, $\mathrm{M}^{2}$-WAM achieves +53.2% and +61.2% absolute improvements in average success rates over Fast-WAM, respectively. These gains extend to real-world manipulation, where $\mathrm{M}^{2}$-WAM achieves a +29.3% absolute improvement over LingBot-VA in average success across three tasks. These results suggest that $\mathrm{M}^{2}$-WAM offers a promising approach to efficient memory-augmented world-action modeling.

摘要（中文）：长期机器人操作任务需要依赖历史上下文信息，然而保留完整的视觉历史会带来不断增长的存储与检索开销，而过度压缩则可能丢失后续决策所需的细粒度信息。此外，已执行的动作历史能够捕捉稀疏视觉观测所遗漏的中间行为。有效保留这种互补上下文，需要针对不同模态设计记忆机制，以兼顾近期细节与长期保留。为此，我们提出了$\mathrm{M}^{2}$-WAM，一种配备分层视觉记忆与交互记忆的世界-动作模型。$\mathrm{M}^{2}$-WAM将近期视觉观测保存在密集的短期记忆中，同时通过门控增量更新，将从此窗口中逐出的条目整合到固定大小的联想式长期记忆中。在相同的短期与长期分层结构下，交互记忆将已执行的动作前缀编码为紧凑的时间表示，以行为上下文补充视觉观测。这些互补的记忆通过逐层检索被整合到世界-动作建模中，从而实现记忆增强的动作生成，且在线记忆占用具有有界性，与回合长度无关。在依赖记忆的仿真基准MIKASA-Robo和RMBench上，$\mathrm{M}^{2}$-WAM相较于Fast-WAM，平均成功率分别取得了+53.2%和+61.2%的绝对提升。这些增益同样延伸至真实世界操作任务中，在三个任务上，$\mathrm{M}^{2}$-WAM相较于LingBot-VA平均成功率取得了+29.3%的绝对提升。上述结果表明，$\mathrm{M}^{2}$-WAM为高效记忆增强的世界-动作建模提供了一种具有前景的方案。

Authors: Xiaopeng Zhang, Weiqi Yuan, Xin Zhu, Jiaxi Huang, Yueqi Hu, Yin Zhang, Jian Yao, Yanjie Li

Greedy Decoding Hides Good Plans: Sample-and-Verify Planning for Vision-Language Driving Models AutonomousDriving

sample-and-verify vision-language driving models trajectory selection greedy decoding end-to-end driving

简要说明：该论文发现基于VLM的驾驶规划器中，贪心解码与最佳采样轨迹之间存在差距，并提出轻量级的采样-验证（SaV）机制来选择更好的轨迹，无需重新训练规划器，在WOD-E2E和NAVSIM上显著降低了位移误差。

TLDR: The paper identifies a gap between greedy decoding and the best sampled trajectories in VLM-based driving planners, and proposes a lightweight Sample-and-Verify (SaV) mechanism to select better trajectories without retraining the planner, achieving significant displacement error reductions on WOD-E2E and NAVSIM.

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly adopted for end-to-end driving planning, yet their performance is typically evaluated based on a single greedily decoded trajectory. However, greedy decoding may overlook better trajectories within the model's output distribution. Experiments on WOD-E2E and NAVSIM reveal a consistent performance gap between greedily decoded trajectories and the best sampled candidates, showing that planning errors can arise from trajectory selection, rather than trajectory generation alone. On WOD-E2E, when the ego vehicle should start moving, the model often assigns probability to different possible start times, causing greedy decoding to repeatedly favor waiting and produce a stationary plan even though moving trajectories are available. Motivated by these findings, we propose Sample-and-Verify (SaV), which keeps the VLM planner frozen and samples multiple candidate trajectories. A lightweight verifier is trained from ground-truth futures to estimate the relative quality of these candidates. It uses trajectory kinematics, candidate-set agreement and likelihood, and ego-motion features to select the final trajectory. On WOD-E2E, SaV reduces ADE and FDE by approximately 15% across three VLM planners on the validation set. Changes in RFS are smaller: two planners show slight decreases on val-456, while Alpamayo-1.5 improves from 7.74 to 7.81 RFS on the official test set as ADE@5s decreases by 11%. On NAVSIM, SaV reduces ADE@4s by 10-24% across three VLM planners, while PDMS changes are less consistent. These results show that trajectory selection can substantially improve displacement accuracy without additional planner training. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/hzxbzp/sample-and-verify.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言模型（VLMs）正越来越多地被用于端到端驾驶规划，但其性能通常基于单一贪心解码轨迹进行评估。然而，贪心解码可能会忽略模型输出分布中更优的轨迹。在WOD-E2E和NAVSIM上的实验揭示出贪心解码轨迹与最佳采样候选轨迹之间存在一致的性能差距，表明规划误差可能源于轨迹选择，而非仅由轨迹生成导致。在WOD-E2E上，当自车应开始移动时，模型常常将概率分配给不同的可能起始时刻，导致贪心解码反复倾向于等待并产生静止规划，尽管移动轨迹是可用的。受这些发现启发，我们提出了“采样-验证”（Sample-and-Verify, SaV）方法，该方法保持VLM规划器不变，并采样多个候选轨迹。一个轻量级验证器利用真实未来信息进行训练，以估计这些候选轨迹的相对质量。它使用轨迹运动学、候选集一致性、似然性以及自车运动特征来选择最终轨迹。在WOD-E2E上，SaV在验证集上使三种VLM规划器的ADE和FDE降低了约15%。RFS的变化较小：两种规划器在val-456上略有下降，而Alpamayo-1.5在官方测试集上从7.74提升至7.81的RFS，同时ADE@5s降低了11%。在NAVSIM上，SaV使三种VLM规划器的ADE@4s降低了10-24%，而PDMS的变化则不太一致。这些结果表明，轨迹选择可以在无需额外规划器训练的情况下显著提高位移精度。代码已在 https://github.com/hzxbzp/sample-and-verify 公开。

Authors: Zhipeng Bao, Wenjie Zhao, Yiping Li, Haohua Que, Qianwen Li

DexEngine: Scaling Human Demonstrations into Physically Executable Whole-Robot Data Manipulation

data generation pipeline residual reinforcement learning physical correction human demonstrations dexterous hands

简要说明：DexEngine 是一个仿真流程，将人类手-物操控演示大规模转化为物理可执行的全身（手臂-手）轨迹，通过残差强化学习进行物理修正，并在仿真和真实机器人上展示了改进的策略性能。

TLDR: DexEngine is a simulation pipeline that converts human hand-object manipulation demonstrations into physically executable whole-robot (arm-hand) trajectories at scale, using residual reinforcement learning for physics correction, and demonstrates improved policy performance in simulation and on a real robot.

Abstract: A growing body of recent work addresses the retargeting of human hand-object demonstrations to robotic hands. To train whole-robot policies, however, the retargeted motions must be kinematically feasible and physically executable, and be produced efficiently at scale. We present DexEngine, a simulation pipeline that turns human manipulation data into train-ready, physically executable arm-hand trajectories. DexEngine first places each clip's hand-object motion where the arms can reach it, finds an arm motion that follows the human hands, and then corrects the motion in physics simulation with residual reinforcement learning. From nine human hand-object datasets, we generate about 5,200 clips for each of four dexterous hands, augmented into 65,000 trajectories (116 h) and 325,000 episodes (578 h) in total. Even with arms attached, DexEngine tracks objects more accurately than prior floating-hand methods and runs over 10x faster than RL-based ones. Policies trained on our data far outperform those trained on the same clips without physics correction or with the arms attached after a floating-hand correction, showing that fine-tuning data need physics correction. Mid-training on our data further improves them at equal fine-tuning budget, in simulation and on a real robot.

摘要（中文）：近期，众多研究工作致力于将人类手部物体交互演示转化为机器人手的操作。然而，为了训练全身机器人策略，转化后的动作必须满足运动学上的可行性，具备物理执行条件，并且能够高效大规模生成。为此，我们提出了DexEngine——一套仿真流程，能将人类操作数据转化为可直接用于训练、物理上可执行的手臂-手部轨迹。DexEngine首先将每个片段中的手物交互动作放置在手臂可达范围内，然后寻找一段跟随人类手部运动的机械臂轨迹，并借助残差强化学习在物理仿真中对运动进行修正。基于九个人类手物交互数据集，我们为四种灵巧手各生成了约5200个片段，并扩展至总计65000条轨迹（116小时）及325000个回合（578小时）。即便装配了机械臂，DexEngine在物体跟踪精度上依旧超越先前的浮动手方法，且运行速度比基于强化学习的方法快10倍以上。利用我们数据训练的策略，在效果上大幅优于使用未经物理校正或经浮动手校正后附加手臂的相同片段训练所得策略，这表明微调数据必须经过物理校正。在同等微调预算下，使用我们的数据进行中期训练可进一步优化策略性能，无论在仿真环境还是实体机器人上均得到验证。

Authors: Wongyun Yu, Honggeun Kim, Donguk Lee, Minchan Kim, Kyoung Whan Choe, Minsu Cho

Skeptic: Grounding Failure Diagnosis for Robot Skill Discovery Manipulation

grounded failure diagnosis action-conditioned world model skill discovery multimodal traces program repair

简要说明：本文提出了Skeptic，一种无需训练的方法，通过基于实测动作结果进行失败诊断和验证晋升来控制技能入库，从而减少错误的不可行判断并提高LIBERO-Pro和Robosuite基准上的成功率。

TLDR: This paper introduces Skeptic, a training-free protocol that improves robot skill discovery by using grounded action outcomes for failure diagnosis and verified promotion for skill admission, reducing false impossibility judgments and boosting success rates on LIBERO-Pro and Robosuite benchmarks.

Abstract: Robot agents discover reusable skills by revising programs from execution feedback and retaining experience for later tasks. This process can fail when an agent treats an unsuccessful program as evidence that the task is physically impossible, ending exploration with revision budget remaining. We study this failure in Qwen3.8-27B and examine two decisions that shape skill discovery: I) how execution failures are diagnosed, and II) which lessons enter the shared skill library. Failure diagnosis requires the agent to reconstruct physical action effects from multimodal traces, while independent reproduction of a proposed repair does not require adequate task performance from its source program. We introduce Skeptic, a training-free protocol that uses measured action outcomes to guide repair and measured task success to govern skill admission. A grounded event log reports action effects and object end states from depth images and proprioception, separating sensor observations from inferred diagnoses. Verified promotion adds a development-success requirement on the source program to the existing independent reproduction check. Across 60 audited tasks, the mean number of tasks with false impossibility judgments decreases from 19.5 to 8.5 per campaign. On 80 LIBERO-Pro tasks and seven Robosuite tasks, Skeptic improves held-out success by 14.9 and 11.7 percentage points, with frozen model weights and the same program-revision budget.

摘要（中文）：机器人智能体通过从执行反馈中修正程序并保留经验以供后续任务使用，从而发现可复用的技能。当智能体将不成功的程序视为任务在物理上不可行的证据，并在修订预算尚有剩余时提前终止探索，这一过程便可能失败。我们在Qwen3.8-27B上研究了这一失败现象，并考察了塑造技能发现的两个决策：I）执行失败如何被诊断，以及II）哪些经验教训被纳入共享技能库。失败诊断要求智能体从多模态轨迹中重构物理动作效果，而对拟议修复方案的独立复现则不要求其源程序具备充分的任务表现。我们引入了Skeptic，一种无需训练的方法，利用实测的动作结果来指导修复，并以实测的任务成功来规范技能的收录。一个基于事件记录的日志从深度图像和本体感觉中报告动作效果和对象最终状态，将传感器观测与推断性诊断区分开来。经验证的提升机制在现有的独立复现检查基础上，对源程序增加了开发成功性要求。在60个经过审计的任务中，每轮被误判为不可行的任务平均数量从19.5降至8.5。在80个LIBERO-Pro任务和7个Robosuite任务上，Skeptic在保持模型权重冻结且修订预算不变的情况下，将保留集上的成功率分别提升了14.9和11.7个百分点。

Authors: Wenfang Sun, Jianghao Deng, Wenzhe Yin, Yingjun Du, Cees G. M. Snoek

OnCue: Generating Safety-Critical Driving Scenarios under Occlusion with Temporal Control AutonomousDriving

safety-critical scenarios occlusion temporal control scenario generation planner evaluation

简要说明：OnCue在遮挡下生成具有精确时间控制（曝光和接触时间）的安全关键驾驶场景，用于评估和改进规划器。

TLDR: OnCue generates safety-critical driving scenarios under occlusion with precise temporal control over exposure and contact times, enabling evaluation of planners and demonstrations for improving them.

Abstract: Occluded hazards challenge autonomous driving because visibility timing determines available avoidance actions. Existing scenario generators control hazard motion without jointly specifying exposure and reference-contact times. We propose OnCue, a framework that generates safety-critical encounters in real driving logs with these temporal conditions. Scene geometry provides hidden starts and timed waypoints for pedestrian, cyclist, and vehicle trajectory generation. An offline response oracle labels encounters as Reactive (avoidable after exposure) or Anticipatory (avoidable only with earlier visibility) and stores safe maneuvers as training demonstrations. On the Waymo Open Motion Dataset, 90.1-96.6% of valid trajectories meet both requested times within +/-0.2 s. OnCue matches the requested reaction window between them in 92.8% of shared vehicle requests versus at most 42.1% for adapted adversarial generators. Across matched cyclist encounters, longer windows lower PDM-Closed collision from 59.1% to 5.5%, while the learned planner LatentDriver shows the opposite trend. OnCue demonstrations reduce LatentDriver target collision by 54.8 points on held-out Reactive tests, but reduce overall no-target progress by 12.7 m. These results highlight the value of temporal control for evaluating and improving planners under occlusion.

摘要（中文）：遮挡物带来的危险对自动驾驶构成挑战，因为可见性时机决定了可用的避让动作。现有的场景生成器控制障碍物的运动，但未同时指定暴露时间和参考接触时间。我们提出了OnCue，一个在真实驾驶日志中生成满足这些时间条件的安全关键相遇事件的框架。场景几何信息为行人、骑行者及车辆轨迹生成提供隐藏起点和定时路径点。一个离线响应标注器将相遇事件标注为“反应型”（暴露后即可避让）或“预期型”（仅凭更早的可见性才能避让），并将安全 maneuvers 存储为训练示范。在Waymo开放运动数据集上，90.1%-96.6%的有效轨迹在±0.2秒内同时满足两个请求时间。OnCue在共享车辆请求中，92.8%的情况下满足两者之间请求的反应时间窗口，而改编的对抗性生成器最多仅为42.1%。在匹配的骑行者相遇事件中，更长的窗口将PDM-Closed碰撞率从59.1%降至5.5%，而学习型规划器LatentDriver则呈现相反趋势。OnCue示范在保留的反应型测试中将LatentDriver目标碰撞率降低54.8个百分点，但整体无目标行进距离减少12.7米。这些结果凸显了时间控制在遮挡条件下评估和改进规划器的重要价值。

Authors: Kailang Ma, Li Song, Weining Ren, Zirui Li, Xianjie Dai, Jingguang Li, Zuyi Guo, Benwang Chen, Heye Huang

An Adversarial Multi-Agent Pursuit Game for Locomotor Agility Pretraining Locomotion

self-play humanoid locomotion multiagent pursuit-evasion sparse reward physics simulation

简要说明：本文提出了MJTag，一个在仿真环境中的多智能体追逐-逃避游戏，通过竞争性自博弈和稀疏反馈预训练敏捷的人形运动控制器，从而涌现出闪避、冲刺和擒抱等策略。

TLDR: This paper introduces MJTag, a multi-agent pursuit-evasion game in simulation to pretrain agile humanoid locomotion controllers via competitive self-play and sparse feedback, enabling emergent strategies like dodging, sprinting, and tackling.

Abstract: Agile humanoid locomotion requires controllers that can adapt to rapidly changing motion demands while remaining stable and robust. Recent locomotion controllers are typically designed with either a dense reward that is carefully shaped to encourage steps and penalize falling, or by using a reference tracking reward which teaches the controller to follow predetermined motions. Once a behavior that maximizes the reward is discovered, the controller ceases to learn. While generally stable, reference tracking methods focus on motor control separately from motion generation. Self-play has been proven as an effective technique for superhuman performance on several multiagent games like Go, Starcraft, hide-and-seek, and capture-the-flag. We train neural networks to play the game of multiagent tag in a physics simulator to study if new motion generation and control strategies can emerge through sparse feedback and competitive self-play. We present MJTag, a task suite for role-conditioned locomotion during competitive pursuit-evasion. Our model is a role-conditioned policy for a low-level locomotion controller and optional planar velocity commands. MJTag's league-based play with sparse feedback enables a locomotion controller to adopt new strategies, including dodging, sprinting, and tackling.

摘要（中文）：敏捷的人形机器人运动要求控制器能够在快速变化的运动需求下保持稳定和鲁棒。现有的运动控制器通常采用两种设计方式：一种是通过精心设计的密集奖励来鼓励迈步并惩罚跌倒，另一种则是利用参考轨迹跟踪奖励，使控制器学习跟随预设动作。一旦发现能够最大化奖励的行为，控制器便停止学习。参考轨迹跟踪方法虽然通常较为稳定，但其将电机控制与运动生成分开处理。自我对弈已被证明是在多种多智能体游戏（如围棋、星际争霸、捉迷藏和夺旗）中实现超人类表现的有效技术。我们在物理仿真器中训练神经网络进行多智能体追逐游戏，以研究新的运动生成与控制策略是否能够通过稀疏反馈和竞争性自我对弈涌现出来。我们提出了MJTag，一个面向竞争性追逃过程中角色条件化运动的任务套件。我们的模型是一个角色条件化策略，用于低层运动控制器，并支持可选的平面速度指令。MJTag基于联赛制训练并结合稀疏反馈，使运动控制器能够采用新的策略，包括闪避、冲刺和擒抱。

Authors: Nathan A. C. Hogg, Matt Hyatt, Neil Klingensmith, George K. Thiruvathukal

RoboARC: Physical Puzzles for Robotic Manipulation under Spatial Constraints Manipulation

spatial constraints manipulation benchmark coding agents VLA policies MuJoCo

简要说明：RoboARC 是一个包含 90 个空间约束操作任务的基准测试，在 MuJoCo 中评估编码智能体和 VLA 策略，发现前沿编码智能体在完全状态信息下能解决许多任务，但从原始传感器输入时表现大幅下降。

TLDR: RoboARC is a benchmark of 90 spatial-constraint manipulation tasks in MuJoCo, evaluating coding agents and VLA policies in privileged and standard sensor regimes, finding that frontier coding agents can solve many tasks with full state but are much worse from raw sensors.

Abstract: Many hard manipulation tasks come down to a spatial constraint that only a few motions satisfy, such as passing a part through a gap barely wider than itself or separating two interlocked parts. These motions depend on the exact geometry of each scene, so demonstrations and skills recorded elsewhere rarely transfer. We therefore ask: when manipulation hinges on spatial constraints, can robots reason out the right motions? We introduce RoboARC, a benchmark of 90 tasks in six constraint types over rigid and soft materials, on three robots in MuJoCo. Every task is a frozen scene with a physics-based grader and a verified reference solution that replays bit-identically. Each task comes in a Privileged regime, with the full simulator state and resets, and a Standard regime with real-sensor inputs (camera images and proprioception) and a single attempt without resets. We evaluate seven coding agents and four VLA policies, none trained on these tasks. The strongest agent, GPT-6 Astra in Codex, solves 86% of the tasks in the Privileged regime and 43% in the Standard regime, and the four VLA policies, run zero-shot, solve none of their 18 one-arm puzzles. On 15 puzzles that GPT-6 Astra solved in the Privileged regime and failed in the Standard regime, object poses add 4 points and part geometry 13, but both together add 36, from 24% to 60%. Only 7% of the coding agents' failed runs pass more than half of a task, and 53% of the failed runs in the Standard regime are stuck on a single step. Frontier coding agents already reason out the right motions for many of these tasks once they know where the parts are and what shape they have. From their own sensors, in a single attempt, the strongest solves fewer than half of the tasks. The website can be found at https://roboarc.embodied-first-exam.ai

摘要（中文）：许多困难的操作任务最终都可归结为一种空间约束，只有极少数运动能够满足该约束，例如将一个部件穿过略宽于其自身的缝隙，或将两个相互卡住的零件分离。这些运动依赖于每个场景的精确几何形状，因此在别处录制的示范和技能几乎无法迁移。因此，我们提出一个问题：当操作依赖于空间约束时，机器人能否推理出正确的运动？我们引入了RoboARC，这是一个包含90个任务的基准测试，涵盖六种约束类型，涉及刚性和软性材料，并在MuJoCo中的三款机器人上运行。每个任务都是一个冻结场景，配有基于物理的评分器和一个经验证的参考解，该解可以按位一致地重放。每个任务都有两种模式：特权模式，提供完整的模拟器状态和重置功能；标准模式，使用真实传感器输入（相机图像和本体感知），且仅有一次尝试机会，不允许重置。我们评估了七个编码智能体和四个VLA策略，均未在这些任务上进行训练。最强的智能体GPT-6 Astra in Codex在特权模式下解决了86%的任务，在标准模式下解决了43%的任务；而四个VLA策略在零样本情况下运行，未能解决其18个单臂谜题中的任何一个。在GPT-6 Astra于特权模式下解决但在标准模式下失败的15个谜题中，仅物体位姿增加4分，仅零件几何形状增加13分，而两者结合则增加36分，从24%提升到60%。编码智能体失败的运行中，只有7%通过了任务的一半以上，而在标准模式中，53%的失败运行卡在单个步骤上。前沿编码智能体在知道零件位置及其形状后，已经能够针对其中许多任务推理出正确的运动。但仅依靠自身传感器、在一次尝试中，最强智能体解决的问题不到一半。相关网站可见于https://roboarc.embodied-first-exam.ai

Authors: Qineng Wang, Jianwen Lyu, Pingyue Zhang, Reuben Tan, Xiaoyu Huang, Tonghe Zhang, Kangrui Wang, Yelong Shen, Jianfeng Gao, Guanya Shi, Ruohan Zhang, Manling Li

FOCI: Trajectory Optimization on Gaussian Splats for Gaussian Robots Manipulation

trajectory optimization 3D Gaussian Splatting collision avoidance mobile manipulation legged locomotion

简要说明：FOCI 提出了一种基于高斯重叠的碰撞积分算法，直接在 3D 高斯泼溅环境上进行轨迹优化，支持多种机器人形态，在静态和动态场景中实现快速、考虑朝向的碰撞规避规划。

TLDR: FOCI introduces a collision integral based on Gaussian overlap for trajectory optimization directly on 3D Gaussian Splatting environments, enabling fast, orientation-aware collision-free planning for various robot morphologies in static and dynamic scenes.

Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has recently gained popularity as a faster alternative to Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs) in 3D reconstruction and view synthesis methods. Leveraging the spatial information encoded in 3DGS, this work proposes FOCI (Field Overlap Collision Integral), an algorithm that is able to optimize trajectories directly on the Gaussians themselves. FOCI leverages a novel and interpretable collision formulation for 3DGS using the notion of the overlap integral between Gaussians. The formulation presented applies to different robot morphologies (e.g., fixed and mobile base manipulators, legged robots, UAVs) and handles both static and dynamic Gaussian-Splat environments. Contrary to other approaches, which represent the robot with conservative bounding boxes that underestimate the traversability of the environment, we propose to represent the environment and the robot as Gaussian Splats. This not only has desirable computational properties, but also allows for orientation-aware planning, allowing the robot to pass through very tight and narrow spaces. We extensively test our algorithm in both synthetic and real Gaussian Splats, showcasing that collision-free trajectories for legged, aerial and manipulator robots can be computed in seconds, even with hundreds of thousands of Gaussians making up the environment. The code is available at https://github.com/leggedrobotics/foci

摘要（中文）：三维高斯泼溅（3DGS）近年来在三维重建和视图合成方法中作为神经辐射场（NeRFs）的更快替代方案而广受欢迎。利用3DGS中编码的空间信息，本工作提出了FOCI（场重叠碰撞积分），一种能够直接在高斯体上优化轨迹的算法。FOCI利用高斯体之间重叠积分的概念，为3DGS提出了一种新颖且可解释的碰撞公式。所提出的公式适用于不同的机器人形态（例如，固定基座和移动基座机械臂、腿式机器人、无人机），并同时处理静态和动态的高斯泼溅环境。与其他方法使用保守的包围盒来表示机器人从而低估环境可通行性不同，我们建议将环境和机器人均表示为高斯泼溅。这不仅具有理想的计算特性，还允许进行考虑朝向的规划，使机器人能够通过非常狭窄的空间。我们在合成和真实的高斯泼溅环境中广泛测试了我们的算法，结果表明，即使环境由数十万个高斯体构成，腿式、空中和机械臂机器人的无碰撞轨迹也可以在数秒内计算出来。代码可在 https://github.com/leggedrobotics/foci 获取。

Authors: Mario Gomez Andreu, Carlos Martinez Cuenca, Maximum Wilder-Smith, Victor Klemm, Vaishakh Patil, Marco Hutter, Jesus Tordesillas

OmniAct: One Policy, One Million Embodiments VLA

cross-embodiment policy kinematic graph flow-matching procedurally generated embodiments manipulation

简要说明：OmniAct 提出了一种基于运动学图条件的跨本体操作策略，通过程序化生成百万机器人仿真训练，在未见过的真实机器人上实现了强大的零样本泛化能力。

TLDR: OmniAct introduces a cross-embodiment manipulation policy conditioned on kinematic graphs, trained with procedurally generated million-robot simulations, achieving strong zero-shot generalization to unseen real-world robots.

Abstract: A single policy that controls diverse robots must not only transfer task knowledge across embodiments, but also adapt its behavior to each robot's capabilities. Existing approaches facilitate transfer through shared action representations, but these representations do not necessarily capture how differences in robot morphology should shape manipulation strategies. We introduce OmniAct, a cross-embodiment manipulation policy that conditions directly on each robot's kinematics in a specific scene to produce embodiment-specific behavior. This kinematic graph represents the robot's joint positions, motion axes, and connectivity to its visual observation, allowing the policy to account for how its embodiment related to objects and surfaces in the scene. A flow-matching policy predicts relative joint motions for each node, enabling control across robots with different degrees of freedom and kinematic configurations. To learn how physical structure shapes behavior at scale, we procedurally design and filter one million physically feasible robot embodiments; next, we develop algorithms to generate robot trajectories in simulation for all embodiments; finally, we train across diverse simulated manipulation tasks. On 2,000 embodiment-scene-held-out evaluation episodes, OmniAct achieves 63.0% success, compared to 17.8% for pi 0.5 and 57.9% for the strongest baseline; on the task families GPT-6 Astra was evaluated on, it achieves 64.7% against GPT-6 Astra's 41.1%. On a previously unseen real-world robot, it achieves nearly twice the success rate of the next best method, MolmoAct2. Beyond task success, we observe that OmniAct learns distinct manipulation strategies that exploit the capabilities and accommodate the limitations of different morphologies. Project: https://omniact.github.io/

摘要（中文）：控制多种异构机器人的单一策略，不仅需要跨具身迁移任务知识，还必须根据每个机器人的能力调整其行为。现有方法通过共享动作表征来促进迁移，但这些表征未必能捕捉机器人形态差异应如何塑造操作策略。我们提出OmniAct，一种跨具身操作策略，它直接以特定场景中每个机器人的运动学为条件，生成具身特有的行为。该运动学图表示机器人的关节位置、运动轴及其与视觉观测的连通性，使策略能够考虑其具身与场景中物体和表面的关系。流匹配策略为每个节点预测相对关节运动，从而实现对具有不同自由度和运动学配置的机器人的控制。为了在大规模上学习物理结构如何塑造行为，我们程序化设计并筛选了一百万个物理可行的机器人具身；随后，我们开发算法在仿真中为所有具身生成机器人轨迹；最后，我们在多样的仿真操作任务上进行训练。在2000个具身-场景留出评估回合中，OmniAct取得了63.0%的成功率，而pi 0.5为17.8%，最强基线为57.9%；在GPT-6 Astra评估的任务族上，OmniAct达到64.7%，而GPT-6 Astra为41.1%。在先前未见过的真实世界机器人上，其成功率几乎是次优方法MolmoAct2的两倍。除任务成功率外，我们观察到OmniAct学习到了利用不同形态能力并适应其局限性的独特操作策略。项目主页：https://omniact.github.io/

Authors: Xiang Fan, Yuheng Wang, Jiayuan Yan, Bohan Fang, Wisdom Oluchi Ikezogwo, Ainaz Eftekhar, Max Argus, Zhongzheng Ren, Jiafei Duan, Ranjay Krishna

PyRUA-Dex: Learning Programmatic Policies for Dexterous Bimanual Manipulation with Coding Agents Manipulation

programmatic policies coding agents dexterous bimanual manipulation sim-to-real no demonstrations

简要说明：PyRUA-Dex 利用编码代理无需演示即可综合程序化策略，用于灵巧双臂操作，在基准测试和真实任务（如弹钢琴、写书法）中取得最先进成果。

TLDR: PyRUA-Dex uses coding agents to synthesize programmatic policies for dexterous bimanual manipulation without demonstrations, achieving state-of-the-art results on benchmarks and real-world tasks like piano playing and calligraphy.

Abstract: Learning for dexterous manipulation is limited by the scarcity of high-quality demonstrations: retargeting from human video is imprecise, teleoperation gives no force feedback to the operator, and exoskeleton-based collection is hard to scale up. We present PyRUA-Dex, a framework that enables coding agents to develop dexterous manipulation through programmatic policy, without the need of demonstrations. The programmatic policy is developed in two stages: during exploration, multiple agents explore in parallel for task skills and ways to compose them, and a distilling agent condenses the successful attempts into a task library and one program. During refinement, this program is improved through randomized layouts for enhanced robustness and execution efficiency. In simulated environments, PyRUA-Dex achieves SOTA on Bench2Dex with a score of 72.9 and reaches 81.0% success on DexJoCo under full randomization, ahead of every trained policy on both benchmarks. In real world experiments on a bimanual platform with two 22-DoF hands, PyRUA-Dex learns to play piano, write calligraphy, and other tasks efficiently: learning a new piece from sheet music takes as little as 30 minutes. These results suggest that PyRUA-Dex is an effective framework for developing dexterous manipulation policies with coding agents in the absence of high quality dexterous manipulation demonstrations.

摘要（中文）：灵巧操作的强化学习受到高质量演示数据稀缺的限制：从人类视频中重定向不够精确，遥操作无法向操作者提供力反馈，而基于外骨骼的数据采集难以扩展。我们提出PyRUA-Dex，一个使编码智能体能够通过程序化策略发展灵巧操作能力的框架，无需演示数据。该程序化策略的开发分为两个阶段：在探索阶段，多个智能体并行探索任务技能及其组合方式，一个蒸馏智能体将成功的尝试凝练为任务库和单一程序。在优化阶段，该程序通过随机化布局进行改进，以增强鲁棒性和执行效率。在模拟环境中，PyRUA-Dex在Bench2Dex上达到最先进水平，得分为72.9，并在完全随机化条件下于DexJoCo上达到81.0%的成功率，在两项基准测试中均超越所有训练策略。在配备两只22自由度手的双臂平台上的真实世界实验中，PyRUA-Dex高效地学会了弹钢琴、写书法等任务：从乐谱学习一首新曲目仅需短短30分钟。这些结果表明，在缺乏高质量灵巧操作演示数据的情况下，PyRUA-Dex是利用编码智能体开发灵巧操作策略的有效框架。

Authors: Feixiang Ruan, Guodong Lv, Kewei Zhang, Wenbo Huang, Yintianrun Zhang, Qiang Wang, Ruiyang Si, Shunyu Yang, Shulong Jiang, Weicheng Duan, Rui Ni, Jianxin Bi, Lekai Wang, Yuze Fan, Haobo Li, Zeliang Fu, Jiankun Zhang, Duomin Wang, Enze Xie, Daquan Zhou

ROAM-Bench: Evaluating Embodied Active Spatial Intelligence through Evidence Verification VLN

embodied spatial intelligence benchmark vision-language models evidence verification indoor navigation

简要说明：ROAM-Bench 提出了一个包含 250 个手工验证任务的基准，覆盖 27 个室内环境，通过基于证据的检查在机器人运动和碰撞约束下评估视觉语言模型，揭示了推理和结果验证中的失败模式。

TLDR: ROAM-Bench introduces a benchmark with 250 manually validated embodied spatial intelligence tasks across 27 indoor environments, using evidence-based checks to evaluate vision-language models under robot motion and collision constraints, revealing failure modes in reasoning and outcome verification.

Abstract: Embodied spatial intelligence requires agents to gather information through exploration and interaction, then use it to reason and act. Existing benchmarks insufficiently distinguish correct outcomes from completion of these task requirements. We introduce ROAM-Bench to evaluate these abilities under robot motion and collision constraints. Independent checks use simulation state and episode records to assess outcomes and task requirements, with stronger checks of geometry, coverage, or placement. It comprises 250 manually validated tasks across 11 types in five groups and 27 indoor environments, covering object and room search, counting, geometric judgments, direction reasoning, and relocation. Human evaluators achieve 84% strict task success on 100 sampled tasks, with every correct outcome satisfying the required checks. Across seven frontier vision-language models, we identify two complementary failure modes: correct outcomes with unmet task requirements, and incorrect outcomes despite passing stronger checks. Oracle-input diagnostics show that more complete target observations and calibrated feedback improve final spatial judgments.

摘要（中文）：具身空间智能要求智能体通过探索和交互来收集信息，并利用这些信息进行推理和行动。现有基准测试在区分正确结果与完成这些任务要求方面存在不足。我们引入ROAM-Bench，在机器人运动与碰撞约束下评估这些能力。独立检查利用仿真状态和回合记录来评估结果与任务要求，并对几何、覆盖范围或放置位置进行更严格的检查。该基准包含250个经人工验证的任务，涵盖五组11种类型及27个室内环境，涉及物体与房间搜索、计数、几何判断、方向推理和重新定位。人工评估者在100个抽样任务中达到84%的严格任务成功率，每个正确结果均满足所需检查。在七个前沿视觉语言模型中，我们识别出两种互补的失败模式：结果正确但未满足任务要求，以及通过更严格检查但结果不正确。基于Oracle输入的诊断表明，更完整的目标观察和校准反馈能改善最终的空间判断。

Authors: Xingjian Ran, Xiaoye Mo, Sihao Liu, Li Luo, Taiqiang Wu, Ji Zhao, Wenqi Shao, Hongyang Li, Jiaqi Wang, Bo Dai

iWAM: Efficient Action Prediction from World Models without Explicit Future Prediction WorldModel

action prediction world-action models flow matching efficient inference video-model features

简要说明：iWAM 提出一种高效的动作预测方法，通过单次视频模型评估的中间特征来条件化策略，无需显式生成未来帧，同时保留世界动作模型的泛化优势。

TLDR: iWAM proposes an efficient action-prediction method that conditions policies on intermediate features from a single video-model evaluation, avoiding explicit future-frame generation while retaining the generalization benefits of world-action models.

Abstract: World-action models (WAMs) build policies on pretrained video-generation models, on the premise that predicting how a scene evolves helps determine how to act. However, generating future scenes is expensive for real-time control. This motivates efficient proxies for future imagination, but how to train such proxies without sacrificing action-prediction quality remains unclear. An effective proxy need not generate a high-resolution frame; it only needs to provide enough information to distinguish between possible futures. This leads to the design principle behind iWAM: rather than denoising an entire future frame, can we condition the action policy on intermediate features from a single video-model evaluation? We show that the answer is yes. Exploiting the reversible dynamics of flow-matching models, we invert each training future into the corresponding latent noise vector. However, a single velocity evaluation at this latent does not necessarily yield informative features for action prediction. We therefore learn a bidirectional flow map that amortizes future-generation computation, enabling a single model evaluation to provide effective conditioning features. At inference, we sample a latent noise vector from the prior and condition the policy using just one video-backbone forward pass. Across simulated benchmarks and real robots, iWAM recovers the generalization benefits of WAMs while substantially reducing its inference cost.

摘要（中文）：世界-动作模型（WAMs）在预训练视频生成模型的基础上构建策略，其前提是预测场景如何演变有助于确定如何行动。然而，生成未来场景对于实时控制而言成本高昂。这促使人们寻找高效的计算代理来替代未来想象，但如何在不过度牺牲动作预测质量的前提下训练此类代理，目前尚不明确。有效的代理无需生成高分辨率帧，只需提供足够的信息以区分可能的未来状态。这引出了iWAM背后的设计原则：与其对整个未来帧进行去噪，能否将动作策略条件化为单次视频模型评估得到的中间特征？我们证明答案是肯定的。利用流匹配模型的可逆动力学特性，我们将每个训练未来样本反演为对应的潜噪声向量。然而，在该潜变量处进行单次速度评估未必能产生对动作预测有信息量的特征。因此，我们学习了一个双向流映射，将未来生成的计算过程摊销化，使得单次模型评估即可提供有效的条件特征。在推理时，我们从先验中采样一个潜噪声向量，并仅通过一次视频骨干网络前向传播即可对策略进行条件化。在多个仿真基准和真实机器人上，iWAM保留了WAM的泛化优势，同时大幅降低了推理成本。

Authors: Vansh Kapoor, Max Sobol Mark, Sreyas Venkataraman, Max Simchowitz, Aviral Kumar

Exploratory Midtraining for Robot Policies Manipulation

midtraining behavioral coverage adversarial teleoperation online fine-tuning robot manipulation

简要说明：本文提出了一种针对机器人策略的中间训练方法，利用对抗式遥操作收集的$\beta$-Data数据构建对多样化低级行为的覆盖，从而在仿真和真实机器人操作任务中改善数据扩展性、零样本泛化能力和在线微调效率。

TLDR: This paper introduces a midtraining approach for robot policies using adversarially teleoperated data ($\beta$-Data) to build coverage over diverse low-level behaviors, improving data scaling, zero-shot generalization, and online fine-tuning efficiency in simulated and real-robot manipulation tasks.

Abstract: Robot policies predominantly learn from human-collected data emphasizing competent behavior, limiting coverage of the low-level behaviors needed to support autonomous improvement. We study how a form of midtraining can be used to build coverage over diverse low-level behaviors that connect challenging states of the robot and its environment to states from which further progress is possible ("connected behavioral coverage"). We also examine how this coverage supports downstream adaptation and online improvement. To this end, we introduce $β$-Data, a dataset collected via adversarial teleoperation, where a human adversary reversibly perturbs the environment while a human operator continues toward completion without resetting. We relabel trajectory segments with local outcomes in natural language and finetune a pretrained policy conditioned on recent action history. The resulting policy exhibits sustained use of more low-level behaviors. Across manipulation tasks in simulation and on three real-robot platforms, our approach yields more favorable data scaling laws, better zero-shot generalization, and more effective use of additional rollout time than training on standard demonstrations. During online finetuning, these policies need fewer rollouts to collect successful experience and reach higher success rates, suggesting that midtraining can prepare robots for both more robust task execution and continued autonomous improvement. Our project page and robot videos are available at https://kshitiz-1225.github.io/exploratory-midtraining-robot-policies/.

摘要（中文）：机器人策略主要从人类收集的数据中学习，这些数据强调熟练行为，从而限制了对支持自主改进所需的低级行为的覆盖范围。我们研究如何利用一种中期训练形式来构建对多样化低级行为的覆盖，这些行为将机器人及其环境的挑战性状态与能够进一步取得进展的状态连接起来（“连通行为覆盖”）。我们还考察了这种覆盖如何支持下游适应和在线改进。为此，我们引入了$β$-Data，这是一个通过对抗性远程操作收集的数据集，其中人类对抗者可逆地扰动环境，而人类操作员则在不重置的情况下继续完成任务。我们用自然语言重新标注轨迹段中的局部结果，并基于近期动作历史对预训练策略进行微调。由此产生的策略表现出对更多低级行为的持续使用。在仿真中的多种操作任务以及三个真实机器人平台上，我们的方法相较于在标准演示上的训练，展现出更有利的数据扩展规律、更好的零样本泛化能力，以及更有效地利用额外 rollout 时间的能力。在线微调过程中，这些策略需要更少的 rollout 来收集成功经验并达到更高的成功率，这表明中期训练可以使机器人为更稳健的任务执行和持续的自主改进做好准备。我们的项目页面和机器人视频可在 https://kshitiz-1225.github.io/exploratory-midtraining-robot-policies/ 获取。
