Authors: Kshitiz, Zheyuan Hu, Robyn Wu, Yizhou Li, Yunchu Zhang, Vattanary Tevy, Kavya Tayal, Shawn Yin, Aykut Onol, Kushal Arora, Dhruv Shah, Abhishek Gupta, Zackory Erickson, Aviral Kumar

A Failure-Driven Data Flywheel for Post-Training Vision-Language-Action Models AutonomousDriving

data flywheel failure-driven post-training VLA models autonomous driving

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于故障驱动的数据飞轮，用于后训练VLA模型，通过构建目标场景并利用故障率指导数据生成，在自动驾驶任务中（仿真和实车）展示了性能提升。

TLDR: This paper proposes a failure-driven data flywheel for post-training VLA models, which constructs target scenarios and uses failure rates to guide data generation, and demonstrates improvements in autonomous driving tasks in simulation and on a real vehicle.

Abstract: Pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) models rarely satisfy all behavioral requirements of a new platform, and teams without a large deployed fleet lack the data to address the resulting failures. We propose a failure-driven data flywheel for post-training such models. It constructs target scenarios absent from the available data by inserting task-relevant entities into reconstructed real-world scenes, and evaluates the model against each behavioral requirement of the target task. Failure rates form a failure map across task conditions and difficulty levels, which is re-evaluated after each round and assigns larger data generation quotas to conditions where the model still fails. We instantiate the framework in autonomous driving for occluded-pedestrian emergence and yielding at stop-sign-controlled intersections, and evaluate it on two VLA models and one non-VLA planner in simulation and on a real vehicle. For occluded-pedestrian emergence, five rounds of post-training improve the critical-phase collision-free rate on the sealed test set from 0.261 to 0.579 for AutoVLA and from 0.390 to 0.765 for ReCogDrive, while the unnecessary braking rate in paired control scenarios never exceeds 0.013. On a full-scale vehicle without real-world training, post-trained ReCogDrive achieves 4 of 5 safe passages, versus 1 of 5 for the base model. Fine-grained evaluation reveals a pattern obscured by the collision-free rate alone: both VLA models learn anticipatory deceleration before reaching the occluding vehicle, while braking after pedestrian emergence remains limited. For stop-sign yielding, the stop-before-line rate rises from 0.100 to 0.897 for AutoVLA and from 0.000 to 0.667 for ReCogDrive. With sequential training from the pedestrian-capability models, it reaches 0.599 and 0.358, respectively, while the pedestrian collision-free rate decreases by at most 0.032.

摘要（中文）：预训练视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型很少能满足新平台的全部行为需求，而没有大规模部署车队数据的团队缺乏足够的数据来解决由此产生的失效问题。我们提出了一种面向失效驱动的数据飞轮机制，用于此类模型的后训练。该机制通过将任务相关实体插入重建的真实场景中，构造出可用数据中缺失的目标场景，并针对目标任务的每项行为需求评估模型表现。失效率构成一张覆盖任务条件和难度等级的失效地图，该地图在每轮训练后重新评估，并为模型仍失效的条件分配更大的数据生成配额。我们以遮挡行人出现和停车标志控制路口让行两个自动驾驶场景为例实现了该框架，并在仿真环境和真实车辆上对两个VLA模型及一个非VLA规划器进行了评估。对于遮挡行人出现场景，五轮后训练将封闭测试集上的关键阶段无碰撞率从AutoVLA的0.261提升至0.579，从ReCogDrive的0.390提升至0.765，而配对控制场景中的非必要制动率从未超过0.013。在未经过真实世界训练的全尺寸车辆上，后训练后的ReCogDrive在5次通行中实现了4次安全通过，而基础模型仅为5次中1次。细粒度评估揭示了仅凭无碰撞率难以发现的规律：两种VLA模型均在到达遮挡车辆前学会了预期性减速，而在行人出现后的制动能力仍然有限。对于停车标志让行场景，停车线前停车率从AutoVLA的0.100提升至0.897，从ReCogDrive的0.000提升至0.667。在基于行人能力模型进行顺序训练后，该指标分别达到0.599和0.358，而行人无碰撞率最多下降0.032。

Authors: Yuhao Luo, Zihao Sheng, Zilin Huang, Zhengyang Wan, Boyue Wang, Ruolin Yang, Shuai Wang, Sikai Chen

Most of the Way There: Turning a Strong Video Prior into an Action-Conditioned World Model WorldModel

action-conditioned world model video foundation model minimal fine-tuning robotic video noise-level training

简要说明：本文介绍了 Dianjing，一种最小的动作条件世界模型适应方法，冻结了 33B 视频基础模型，仅训练其 0.34% 的参数，实现了强物理动作条件，证明了强视频先验可通过最小微调有效转化为世界模型。

TLDR: This paper introduces Dianjing, a minimal adaptation recipe for action-conditioned world modeling that freezes a 33B video foundation model and trains only 0.34% of its parameters to achieve strong physical action conditioning, demonstrating that strong video priors can be effectively turned into world models with minimal fine-tuning.

Abstract: Modern video generators excel at producing visually plausible futures guided by text and image prompts. Yet their emphasis on semantic plausibility does not guarantee fidelity to the physical consequences of specific actions. Action-conditioned world models (ACWMs), in contrast, aim to simulate how the world responds to robot actions, enabling scalable policy evaluation and improvement without costly real-world rollouts. The challenge is not merely to generate a plausible future, but to predict what follows from a specific physical action. As video priors grow stronger, we ask how little adaptation is truly needed to bridge this gap. We introduce Dianjing, a minimal recipe that preserves and unlocks the capabilities of strong video priors through unified physical action conditioning, training concentrated at the high noise levels where motion and layout, and thus the consequences of actions, are decided, and native history conditioning. Built upon MiniMax H3, a 33B video foundation model, Dianjing freezes the pretrained backbone and trains only 0.34% of its parameters using approximately 65 hours of robot video across two embodiments, without additional robot-specific pretraining or camera calibration. Controlled ablations show that where training is allocated across noise levels matters more than how actions enter the network. On WorldOracle, which evaluates predictions against paired real-world executions, Dianjing achieves the best scores on four of the five evaluation tracks and ranks second on AgiBot-Long. Our findings suggest that strong video priors already bring us most of the way to world modeling; lightweight physical action grounding can unlock their potential for real-world prediction.

摘要（中文）：现代视频生成模型在根据文本和图像提示生成视觉上合理的未来画面方面表现出色。然而，其对语义合理性的侧重并不能保证对特定动作物理后果的忠实预测。相比之下，动作条件世界模型（ACWMs）旨在模拟世界对机器人动作的响应方式，从而无需昂贵现实世界部署即可实现可扩展的策略评估与改进。挑战不仅在于生成合理的未来画面，更在于预测特定物理动作所导致的后续结果。随着视频先验模型日益强大，我们不禁要问：真正弥合这一差距所需的适配究竟可以有多小？我们提出了Dianjing——一种极简方案，通过统一的物理动作条件化、将训练集中于高噪声水平（在此阶段运动与布局——即动作的后果——得以确定）以及原生历史条件化，来保留并释放强视频先验模型的潜力。Dianjing基于MiniMax H3（一个330亿参数视频基础模型），冻结预训练主干网络，仅训练其0.34%的参数，使用约65小时涵盖两种具身形态的机器人视频数据，且无需额外的机器人专用预训练或相机标定。受控消融实验表明，训练在高噪声水平间的分配方式比动作如何输入网络更为关键。在WorldOracle基准上——该基准通过与真实世界成对执行结果进行比对评估预测性能——Dianjing在五项评估指标中的四项上取得最优成绩，并在AgiBot-Long上排名第二。我们的研究结果表明，强大的视频先验模型已使我们在世界建模方面走完大半路程；轻量化的物理动作接地即可释放其在现实世界预测中的潜力。

Authors: Zanyi Wang, Xia Chen, Liu Liu, Xianglong Guo, Dengyang Jiang, Haodong Li, Tingyang Xiao, Wenhao Hu, Zhizhong Su

Navigent: A Geometry-Grounded Agentic Framework for Vision Language Navigation VLN

Vision-Language Navigation agentic framework geometry-grounded execution critic frozen MLLM self-improvement

简要说明：Navigent 提出了一种基于几何的执行批评器，在冻结的MLLM智能体框架中验证动作与运动及地标的一致性，以实现可靠的长期导航，在R2R-CE和RxR-CE基准上取得优异成绩，并支持离线自我改进。

TLDR: Navigent introduces a geometry-grounded execution critic within an agentic VLN framework using a frozen MLLM, verifying action-to-motion and motion-to-landmark consistency to enable reliable long-horizon navigation, achieving strong results on R2R-CE and RxR-CE benchmarks with offline self-improvement.

Abstract: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) with general-purpose multimodal large language models (MLLMs) offers a flexible alternative to task-specific navigation policies, while reliable long-horizon execution remains challenging. Agents must track navigation progress, detect discrepancies between commanded and actual motion, and recognize when movement has passed relevant landmarks or entrances. We present Navigent, an agentic VLN framework built around a frozen MLLM and a Geometry-Grounded Execution Critic (GEC). GEC performs two complementary checks: action-to-motion consistency, which evaluates measured displacement against commanded movement, and motion-to-landmark consistency, which tracks agent-selected visual anchors and entrance candidates in world coordinates. Detected discrepancies interrupt the remaining action sequence and trigger reobservation, local adjustment, or node-based recovery. Historical visual memory supports progress tracking across extended routes. An offline self-improvement procedure further analyzes successful and failed training trajectories to refine navigation prompts and GEC logic while keeping model weights fixed. On the R2R-CE validation-unseen split (1,839 episodes) and RxR-CE validation-unseen split(3,669 episodes), Navigent achieves 84.0%/86.0% SR and 72.9%/69.1% SPL, respectively, demonstrating the value of geometry-grounded execution verification for reliable agentic navigation. Project Page: https://marslab-navigent.github.io/navigent.github.io/ Code: https://github.com/MarsLab-Navigent/Navigent

摘要（中文）：视觉与语言导航（VLN）结合通用多模态大语言模型（MLLMs），为特定任务导航策略提供了一种灵活的替代方案，但可靠的长时间跨度执行仍具挑战性。智能体必须跟踪导航进度，检测指令运动与实际运动之间的差异，并识别移动是否已越过相关地标或入口。我们提出Navigent，一种围绕冻结MLLM和几何接地执行评判器（GEC）构建的智能体VLN框架。GEC执行两项互补检查：动作-运动一致性，评估实测位移与指令运动之间的匹配程度；以及运动-地标一致性，跟踪智能体在世界坐标中选定的视觉锚点和入口候选。检测到的差异会中断剩余动作序列，并触发重新观察、局部调整或基于节点的恢复。历史视觉记忆支持跨长距离路线的进度跟踪。一种离线自我改进程序进一步分析成功和失败的训练轨迹，以优化导航提示和GEC逻辑，同时保持模型权重固定。在R2R-CE验证未见分割（1,839个片段）和RxR-CE验证未见分割（3,669个片段）上，Navigent分别达到84.0%/86.0%的SR和72.9%/69.1%的SPL，展示了几何接地执行验证对可靠智能体导航的价值。项目页面：https://marslab-navigent.github.io/navigent.github.io/ 代码：https://github.com/MarsLab-Navigent/Navigent

Authors: Xinyu Zhou, Weiren Cai, Yitong Chen, Shenghai Yuan, Zihang Mu, Boyu Ma, Jiahua Dong, Yanshuo Lu, Jiaqi Bai, Jianfei Yang

Towards 360$^\circ$ Embodied UAV Tracking Without Turning VLA

360-degree perception vision-language-action UAV tracking closed-loop evaluation simulation benchmark

简要说明：本文提出了一种面向无人机目标跟踪的360度全景视觉-语言-动作（VLA）框架，无需主动调整机头方向，并伴随新仿真基准与实验验证，展示了闭环跟踪性能的提升。

TLDR: This paper introduces a 360-degree panoramic vision-language-action (VLA) framework for UAV target tracking without active heading control, along with a new simulation benchmark and experimental validation showing improved closed-loop tracking performance.

Abstract: Conventional embodied UAV tracking couples target observability with heading control because targets may leave the field of view of forward-facing cameras. We investigate a complementary paradigm that uses full-spherical perception to follow designated targets without active heading adjustment. To support this setting, we introduce 360UAV-ETrack, a simulation benchmark comprising 2,652 sequences, over 1.73 million synchronized observations, eight tracking tasks, and 150 held-out closed-loop scenarios. We propose 360UAV-TVLA, a panoramic vision--language--action (VLA) framework integrating persistent visual referring (PVR), compressed temporal memory (CTM), and geometry-aligned trajectory supervision (GTS) for instance identification, motion reasoning, and three-dimensional control. Experiments across two VLA backbones show consistent gains over standard fine-tuning, with normalized average tracking frames increasing from 22.56\% to 35.28\% for $π_0$ and from 25.68\% to 33.64\% for $π_{0.5}$. Our benchmark further reveals a substantial gap between offline imitation accuracy and closed-loop tracking reliability, establishing a challenging testbed for future research https://libingyu01.github.io/360UAV-ETrack_360UAV-TVLA/

摘要（中文）：传统的具身无人机跟踪将目标可观测性与航向控制耦合在一起，因为目标可能离开前视摄像头的视野范围。我们研究了一种互补范式，利用全向感知在无需主动调整航向的情况下跟踪指定目标。为支持这一设定，我们引入了360UAV-ETrack，一个仿真基准测试集，包含2，652个序列、超过173万个同步观测数据、8个跟踪任务以及150个留出式闭环场景。我们提出了360UAV-TVLA，一种全景视觉-语言-动作（VLA）框架，整合了持续视觉指代（PVR）、压缩时间记忆（CTM）和几何对齐轨迹监督（GTS），用于实例识别、运动推理和三维控制。在两种VLA骨干网络上的实验表明，相较于标准微调，该方法均取得了一致的性能提升，归一化平均跟踪帧数从22.56%提升至35.28%（针对$π_0$），从25.68%提升至33.64%（针对$π_{0.5}$）。我们的基准测试进一步揭示了离线模仿精度与闭环跟踪可靠性之间存在显著差距，为未来研究建立了一个具有挑战性的测试平台。https://libingyu01.github.io/360UAV-ETrack_360UAV-TVLA/

Authors: Bingyu Li, Wu Du, Zhiyuan Zhao, Junyu Gao, Xuelong Li

WhatIf: Counterfactual World Models over Action-Grounded Causal Graphs for Robotic Manipulation WorldModel

counterfactual world model action-grounded causal graphs robotic manipulation Counterfactual Advantage Planning shared latent physics

简要说明：WhatIf提出了一种用于机器人操作的反事实世界模型，通过共享潜在物理和动作因果图耦合候选动作结果，实现反事实优势规划，降低方差并消除模型误差。

TLDR: WhatIf introduces a counterfactual world model for robotic manipulation that couples candidate action outcomes via shared latent physics and action-grounded causal graphs, enabling counterfactual advantage planning with reduced variance and model-error cancellation.

Abstract: World models predict what happens under an action, but choosing between actions requires comparing their outcomes in the same physical situation. Factual transitions alone determine action-wise marginal futures and average effects, but not individual effects or the probability that switching actions causes harm. We introduce WhatIf, a counterfactual world model for manipulation that couples candidate futures through shared latent physics and transition noise inferred from factual history. Each candidate action induces a sparse object-factor causal graph describing the physical pathways it activates. Rolling out these graphs under the shared situation anchors predictions to observed outcomes and confines action contrasts to the objects each action reaches. Shared type-conditioned functions support varying numbers of objects, while a round-trip loss enforces action-invariant abduction without counterfactual labels. We show that replacing an individual effect with its conditional mean incurs mean-squared error equal to its conditional variance, motivating comparisons between coupled futures. Building on these comparisons, Counterfactual Advantage Planning (CAP) ranks plans by their advantage over an incumbent within shared situations and constrains the probability of harm. Paired advantages reduce estimator variance by a factor of $1-ρ$, where $ρ$ is the correlation between branch outcomes, and cancel model errors shared by both branches. Each executed transition provides hindsight advantages to update the physics posterior, the next plan, and an amortized policy without a learned critic. We further establish when observational transitions identify interventional dynamics. Paired simulator interventions evaluate counterfactual accuracy, graph recovery, compositional generalization, and decision quality.

摘要（中文）：世界模型预测在某个动作下会发生什么，但在动作之间进行选择需要比较它们在相同物理情境中的结果。仅凭事实性转移只能确定各动作的边际未来和平均效应，却无法确定个体效应或切换动作造成伤害的概率。我们提出了WhatIf，一种用于操作的反事实世界模型，它通过共享的潜在物理机制和从事实历史中推断出的转移噪声，将候选未来耦合在一起。每个候选动作都会引发一个稀疏的对象因子因果图，描述其激活的物理路径。在共享情境下对这些图进行展开，可将预测锚定到观测结果上，并将动作对比限制在每个动作所能影响的对象范围内。共享的类型条件函数支持可变数量的对象，而往返损失则在无需反事实标签的情况下强制实现动作不变的外推。我们证明，用条件均值替代个体效应所产生的均方误差等于其条件方差，这促使我们比较耦合的未来。基于这些比较，反事实优势规划（CAP）在共享情境中依据相对现有方案的优劣对计划进行排序，并限制伤害概率。成对优势可将估计器方差降低$1-ρ$倍，其中$ρ$是各分支结果之间的相关性，并可抵消两个分支共有的模型误差。每次执行的转移都提供了事后优势，用以更新物理后验、下一个计划以及无需学习评论家的摊销策略。我们还进一步确定了观测转移何时能够识别干预动态。配对的模拟器干预评估了反事实准确性、图恢复、组合泛化和决策质量。

Authors: Xu Yang, Kailai Sun, Qianchuan Zhao

ShowNow: Fine-Grained Speculative Streaming for Responsive World Models WorldModel

speculative streaming interactive world models action-conditioned futures latency reduction video generation

简要说明：ShowNow 提出了一种用于交互式世界模型的细粒度推测式流式框架，通过在播放期间准备多个行动条件下的未来，实现响应式的行动条件视频生成。它在 ViZDoom 中将输入到显示延迟降低，并在单个 H100 上维持 16 fps 的 480p 生成。

TLDR: ShowNow introduces a fine-grained speculative streaming framework for interactive world models, enabling responsive action-conditioned video generation by preparing multiple futures during playback. It reduces input-to-display latency in ViZDoom and sustains 16 fps 480p generation on a single H100.

Abstract: Interactive world models must generate video continuously while responding promptly to user actions. Real-time throughput alone leaves input latency unresolved: coarse generation blocks delay action updates, and generation after input adds work to the response path. We introduce ShowNow, a fine-grained speculative streaming framework that uses computation available during playback to prepare action-conditioned futures before input arrives. Single-latent commitment enables frequent decisions, while configurable preparation covers one to eight actions. We construct a matched multi-future dataset to train alternative continuations from a common state; shared-history tree execution and fused commitment make their preparation efficient. On a single H100, our 5B model sustains 480p generation at 16 fps with eight prepared futures. In ViZDoom, the complete ShowNow deployment reduces median input-to-display latency from 620 to 208 ms relative to the native-block SolarWM-FT deployment. Matched-policy experiments reduce restart empty ticks from 1.56% to 0.09% (94%) and improve on-time responses to action changes. These results establish complementary roles for fine-grained commitment and advance preparation, with measured trade-offs in visual fidelity and long-horizon consistency. ShowNow turns playback-time computation into responsive visual interaction. Project: https://github.com/showlab/ShowNow.

摘要（中文）：交互式世界模型必须持续生成视频，同时快速响应用户操作。仅具备实时吞吐量并不能解决输入延迟问题：粗粒度的生成块会延迟动作更新，而在输入之后再进行生成则会在响应路径中增加额外计算。我们提出了ShowNow，一种细粒度推测式流式框架，利用播放期间可用的计算资源，在输入到达之前预生成动作条件下的未来帧。单潜变量提交机制支持频繁决策，而可配置的预生成范围覆盖一至八个动作。我们构建了一个匹配的多未来数据集，从共同状态训练替代延续；共享历史树执行与融合提交机制使其预生成高效运行。在单张H100上，我们的5B模型以16 fps维持480p生成，并预生成八个未来帧。在ViZDoom中，完整的ShowNow部署将中位输入到显示延迟从原生块式SolarWM-FT部署的620毫秒降低至208毫秒。匹配策略实验将重启空转帧率从1.56%降至0.09%（降幅达94%），并提升了动作变化的按时响应能力。这些结果确立了细粒度提交与前置预生成之间的互补作用，并测得了在视觉保真度和长时一致性方面的权衡。ShowNow将播放期计算转化为响应式视觉交互。项目主页：https://github.com/showlab/ShowNow。

Authors: Yiren Song, Guian Fang, Mike Zheng Shou

Commit2Drive: Perception-Grounded Language Decisions as Commitments for Trajectory Planning in Vision-Language-Action Driving Models AutonomousDriving

Vision-Language-Action model trajectory planning consistency constraint closed-loop driving Maneuver Bank

简要说明：Commit2Drive 通过将语言决策视为从轨迹中经确定性规则读取的承诺，并利用反事实训练和自动数据管道，提高了视觉-语言-动作驾驶模型中语言与动作的一致性，在闭环驾驶中取得具有竞争力的成绩。

TLDR: Commit2Drive improves language-action consistency in vision-language-action driving models by treating language decisions as commitments derived from trajectory via deterministic rules, using counterfactual training and automatic data pipelines to achieve competitive closed-loop driving scores.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models introduce language reasoning into end-to-end autonomous driving. They output a language decision together with a trajectory, which makes the planner more interpretable. However, in existing methods the language decision is either an independent output or an index that selects among similar candidate trajectories, and its annotations are not verified against the trajectory. As a result, the language decision and the trajectory are often inconsistent in closed-loop driving. To address this, we propose Commit2Drive, a framework that imposes the language decision as a consistency constraint on trajectory planning. The decision is a commitment, a maneuver class with a continuous parameter that one deterministic rule reads from any trajectory, and it is grounded in facts reported by the perception of the model itself. A Maneuver Bank maps the commitment to a code with a kinematic meaning, and consistency losses train the planner to execute every admissible decision of a scene, so that the trajectory follows the decision. An automatic data pipeline supplies the supervision. Decisions are labeled from the future motion of the expert, counterfactual executions train the decision and the trajectory together, and rule-based functions with a Vision-Language Model (VLM) generate, review and refine the language annotations. The code is a lookup that involves no hidden state of the language model, so Commit2Drive is extensible to rule-based decisions, which the same planner executes without retraining. Commit2Drive uses a 0.5B language model and runs closed-loop inference online on a single consumer graphics card. On Bench2Drive, Commit2Drive reaches a Driving Score (DS) of 78.50 and a Success Rate (SR) of 55.91% with a lightweight model, which is competitive with the state of the art, and greatly reduces the language-action inconsistency. Code will be released soon.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型将语言推理引入端到端自动驾驶。该类模型在输出轨迹的同时生成语言决策，从而使规划器更具可解释性。然而，现有方法中，语言决策要么是独立输出，要么是从相似候选轨迹中选取的索引，且其标注未与轨迹进行交叉验证。因此，在闭环驾驶中，语言决策与轨迹往往不一致。为解决这一问题，我们提出Commit2Drive框架，将语言决策作为轨迹规划的一致性约束。该决策是一种承诺，即一个带有连续参数的操纵类别，可由任意轨迹通过确定性规则读取，且其依据来自模型自身感知所报告的事实。操纵库（Maneuver Bank）将承诺映射为具有运动学含义的编码，一致性损失函数训练规划器执行场景中每一个可行决策，从而确保轨迹遵循决策。自动化数据管线提供监督信号：决策依据专家的未来运动进行标注，反事实执行将决策与轨迹联合训练，基于规则的函数结合视觉-语言模型（VLM）生成、审查并精炼语言标注。该编码是一种查表操作，不涉及语言模型的隐藏状态，因此Commit2Drive可扩展至基于规则的决策，同一规划器无需重新训练即可执行这些决策。Commit2Drive使用0.5B参数的语言模型，可在单张消费级显卡上在线运行闭环推理。在Bench2Drive基准上，Commit2Drive以轻量模型取得了78.50的驾驶分数（DS）和55.91%的成功率（SR），与当前最先进方法相当，并大幅降低了语言-动作不一致性。代码将很快开源。

Authors: Zikai Zhang, Hubert P. Shum, Toby Breckon

Event-WAM: Learning to Act with Event-Derived Futures Manipulation

World Action Models Event-derived supervision Latent flow matching Robust manipulation RGB-Event fusion

简要说明：Event-WAM 将事件衍生的视觉变化作为辅助的未来监督，用于世界动作模型，在无需推理时事件观测的情况下提高了操作鲁棒性。

TLDR: Event-WAM introduces event-derived visual changes as auxiliary future supervision for world action models, improving manipulation robustness without requiring event observations at inference.

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) leverage future visual modeling for robotic action learning, with recent studies exploring alternative or complementary objectives beyond conventional RGB prediction. We introduce Event-WAM, which incorporates event-derived visual changes as auxiliary future supervision alongside RGB. Event-WAM constructs temporally structured event representations from RGB demonstrations and encodes them using a frozen pretrained RGB video VAE, without training an event-specific VAE. Joint RGB--Event latent flow matching provides appearance- and change-oriented supervision without requiring event observations or explicit future generation at inference. Across simulated benchmarks, Event-WAM maintains comparable performance under standard conditions, while robustness gains under perturbations are benchmark-dependent, including improvements on LIBERO-Plus. Real-world evaluations further demonstrate improved manipulation success under both standard and unseen perturbation conditions. Further analyses show that policy improvements are not consistently accompanied by higher future prediction fidelity, suggesting the potential of change-oriented supervision for action learning.

摘要（中文）：世界动作模型（WAMs）利用未来视觉建模进行机器人动作学习，近期研究探索了传统RGB预测之外的替代或互补目标。我们提出Event-WAM，将事件驱动的视觉变化作为辅助未来监督信号，与RGB相结合。Event-WAM从RGB示范中构建具有时间结构的事件表示，并使用冻结的预训练RGB视频VAE对其进行编码，无需训练专门的事件VAE。RGB-事件联合潜空间流匹配提供了面向外观和变化的监督，推理时无需事件观测或显式未来生成。在模拟基准测试中，Event-WAM在标准条件下保持相当的性能，而在扰动条件下的鲁棒性提升因基准而异，包括在LIBERO-Plus上的改进。真实世界评估进一步表明，在标准和未见扰动条件下，操作成功率均有提升。进一步分析显示，策略改进并非始终伴随更高的未来预测保真度，这提示面向变化的监督在动作学习中具有潜在价值。

Authors: Jongseong Bae, Hyunwoo Kim, Yeongin Lee, Eubin So, Ha Young Kim

Off the Driven Path: Transferable Road Understanding in Driving VLAs AutonomousDriving

Road understanding Scene graph Vision-language-action models Geographic diversity Trajectory compliance

简要说明：本文提出Road-KSU框架，通过基于场景图的VQA和轨迹合规指标来探测端到端驾驶策略内化的道路知识。研究发现驾驶性能与道路理解之间存在双重分离，表明地理多样性对于可迁移的道路知识至关重要。

TLDR: This paper introduces Road-KSU, a framework for probing the road knowledge internalized by end-to-end driving policies via scene-graph-based VQA and trajectory compliance metrics. It reveals a double dissociation between driving performance and road understanding, showing that geographic diversity is key to transferable road knowledge.

Abstract: End-to-end driving policies increasingly operate without explicit HD maps at inference, raising the question of what road knowledge they actually internalize. To probe this knowledge through model outputs, we introduce Road-KSU, a framework that automatically converts HD maps and actor annotations into a road-centric scene graph. From this, we derive road-focused question answering and reasoning targets, complemented by map-based trajectory compliance metrics. Pairing Road-KSU with geographically disjoint splits yields a $2 \times 2$ evaluation crossing output modality (language vs. action) with place familiarity (seen vs. unseen roads). On NAVSIM, 95% of test samples lie within 10m of a training sample, and scores of 13 published planners on turns rise steeply with the number of training drives through the test location, pointing to memorized road geometry. Retraining on geographically disjoint splits and probing with Road-KSU confirm that action-space performance degrades most on unfamiliar turns, with failures dominated by geometric compliance. Language accuracy, however, drops on road-centric VQA on straight and curved roads alike, and remains stable on dynamic scene content. Scaling the training data further reveals a double dissociation: more drives through the same places improve driving on unseen roads but leave road question answering unchanged, whereas spreading a fixed data budget over more places increases road question answering with little change in driving performance. These findings show that improved driving scores need not imply broader road understanding on unseen roads, and identify geographic diversity as key to transferable road knowledge.

摘要（中文）：端到端驾驶策略在推理时日益不再依赖显式的高精地图，这引出了一个问题：它们实际上内化了哪些道路知识。为通过模型输出探测这些知识，我们引入了Road-KSU，一个将高精地图和智能体标注自动转换为以道路为中心的场景图的框架。由此，我们推导出以道路为核心的问答与推理目标，并辅以基于地图的轨迹合规性指标。将Road-KSU与地理上不相交的数据划分相结合，形成了一个\(2 \times 2\)的评估体系，交叉比较输出模态（语言vs.行动）与地点熟悉度（已见vs.未见道路）。在NAVSIM上，95%的测试样本位于训练样本10米范围内，且13个已发表规划器在转弯处的得分随通过测试地点的训练行驶次数增加而急剧上升，这表明模型记住了道路几何结构。在地理上不相交的划分上重新训练并用Road-KSU进行探测，证实动作空间性能在陌生转弯处退化最为严重，失败主要由几何合规性主导。然而，语言准确性在直道和弯道上的道路中心VQA中均有所下降，而在动态场景内容上保持稳定。进一步扩展训练数据揭示了双重分离：更多经过同一地点的行驶改善了在未见道路上的驾驶表现，但对道路问答没有影响；而将固定数据预算分散到更多地点则提高了道路问答性能，驾驶表现变化不大。这些发现表明，驾驶得分的提高并不必然意味着对未见道路的更广泛道路理解，并指出了地理多样性是可迁移道路知识的关键。

Authors: Lena Wild, Christian Helten, Katie Z Luo, Jakob Thumm, Rafael Valencia, Patric Jensfelt, Marco Pavone

FlipVLA: Backdoor Attacks on Vision-Language-Action(VLA) Models Only Through Bit Flips VLA

backdoor attack bit flip VLA models OpenVLA GR00T

简要说明：FlipVLA提出了一种仅通过固定比特翻转在视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中植入后门的方法，无需重新训练，在保持干净场景性能的同时实现了高攻击成功率。

TLDR: FlipVLA introduces a method to implant backdoors into Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models via a fixed set of bit flips, without retraining, achieving high attack success while preserving clean performance on tasks.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models generate robot actions from visual observations and language instructions in real-world environments, making malicious model tampering a potential threat to physical safety. We study whether object-triggered backdoors can be implanted through a small, fixed set of parameter bit flips without retraining. The central challenge is to make persistent weight modifications disrupt trigger-present behavior while preserving performance on non-trigger inputs. We propose FlipVLA, a two-stage selector-amplifier method that exploits existing visual features within an FC-GELU-FC structure. The selector constructs a trigger-dependent response in a selected channel, using GELU to attenuate background activity. The amplifier modifies a connected downstream weight to convert this response into an action-relevant perturbation. Channel screening and discrete bit search construct both components under a limited modification budget. Experiments on OpenVLA-OFT and GR00T N1.7 across four LIBERO suites achieve attack success rates of 90.22% to 100%, with task success decreasing by at most 1.5 percentage points on clean scenes.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在真实环境中根据视觉观察和语言指令生成机器人动作，这使得恶意篡改模型可能对物理安全构成威胁。我们研究是否可以通过少量、固定的参数位翻转，在无需重新训练的情况下植入对象触发的后门。核心挑战在于，如何在不影响非触发输入性能的前提下，持久地修改权重以破坏含触发器的行为。我们提出FlipVLA，一种两阶段的“选择器-放大器”方法，利用FC-GELU-FC结构内已有的视觉特征。选择器在选定通道中构建依赖于触发的响应，并利用GELU衰减背景活动。放大器修改相连的下游权重，将该响应转化为与动作相关的扰动。通过通道筛选和离散位搜索，在有限修改预算下构建这两个组件。在OpenVLA-OFT和GR00T N1.7上、覆盖四个LIBERO套件的实验中，攻击成功率达到90.22%至100%，而干净场景下的任务成功率最多下降1.5个百分点。

GeoTex: Geometry-as-Texture Encoding and History-Grounded 4D Occupancy Forecasting AutonomousDriving

4D occupancy forecasting geometry-as-texture world model history-grounded decoder-only adaptation

简要说明：GeoTex 提出了一种几何作为纹理的编码方法用于自动驾驶中的4D占用预测，相比GenieDrive提高了mIoU和IoU，同时减少了参数。

TLDR: GeoTex proposes a geometry-as-texture encoding for 4D occupancy forecasting in autonomous driving, improving mIoU and IoU over GenieDrive with fewer parameters.

Abstract: 4D occupancy forecasting models 3D scene evolution to support future prediction and scenario generation in autonomous-driving world models. Semantic occupancy abstracts image color and texture into discrete labels, leaving 3D voxel arrangements as the primary cues for distinguishing local shapes within each class. Existing methods borrow image-encoding frameworks to obtain compact latent representations through height channelization or plane factorization, but do not sufficiently model within-column height patterns and cross-column relations jointly before compression, weakening these geometric cues. Forecasting also underutilizes complementary history and struggles to retain reliable observation evidence. We therefore propose GeoTex, an occupancy world model combining geometry-as-texture encoding with history-grounded forecasting. GeoTex Representation jointly encodes within-column height patterns and cross-column relations into compact continuous latent representations and restores 3D structure through content-dependent height unfolding and geometric interaction. GeoTex Prediction retains initial evidence throughout rollout in fixed cross-observation relational memory and incorporates complementary recent history through target-referenced residual updates. After prediction training, decoder-only adaptation improves semantic decoding of predicted states. GeoTex improves average forecasting mIoU and IoU by 9.79% and 11.91% relative to GenieDrive while reducing parameters from 3.47M to 2.33M, with gains increasing at longer horizons. Code is included in the supplementary material.

摘要（中文）：4D占用预测模型三维场景演化，以支持自动驾驶世界模型中的未来预测与场景生成。语义占用将图像颜色和纹理抽象为离散标签，使得三维体素排列成为区分各类别内部局部形状的主要线索。现有方法借鉴图像编码框架，通过高度通道化或平面分解获得紧凑的潜在表示，但在压缩前未能充分联合建模列内高度模式与跨列关系，从而削弱了这些几何线索。预测过程也未能充分利用互补的历史信息，且难以保留可靠的观测证据。为此，我们提出GeoTex——一种结合几何即纹理编码与历史锚定预测的占用世界模型。GeoTex表示模块将列内高度模式与跨列关系联合编码为紧凑的连续潜在表示，并通过内容相关的高度展开与几何交互恢复三维结构。GeoTex预测模块在固定的跨观测关系记忆中于整个推演过程中保留初始证据，并通过目标参考残差更新融入互补的近期历史信息。完成预测训练后，仅解码器适配可改善预测状态的语义解码。相较于GenieDrive，GeoTex在平均预测mIoU和IoU上分别提升9.79%和11.91%，同时将参数量从3.47M降至2.33M，且提升幅度随预测时域延长而增大。代码包含在补充材料中。

Authors: Shijun Guo, Yaming Yang, Haoran Xu, Wei Zhao, Ziyu Guan, Cai Xu, Peixi Peng

HOG-WAM: Improving Visual Robustness through Future Gradient Prediction Manipulation

visual robustness world-action model HOG prediction auxiliary supervision robot manipulation

简要说明：本文提出了HOG-WAM，通过向世界动作模型添加未来方向梯度直方图（HOG）预测作为辅助监督，提高了机器人策略在观测损坏下的视觉鲁棒性，在仿真和物理任务中均取得效果提升。

TLDR: This paper introduces HOG-WAM, which adds future Histogram of Oriented Gradients (HOG) prediction as auxiliary supervision to a world-action model, improving visual robustness of robot policies against observation corruptions in simulation and physical tasks.

Abstract: World-action models jointly predict future observations and actions, yet visual corruption can disrupt the resulting policies. We introduce HOG-WAM, which adds future Histograms of Oriented Gradients (HOG) as structural supervision derived directly from demonstration images. An auxiliary HOG diffusion transformer (DiT) module reads RGB features through asymmetric attention, allowing its objective to shape the visual representation used for control. The module is used only during training and removed at inference, preserving FastWAM's RGB-to-action architecture. We evaluate four controlled observation corruptions through a visual-corruption extension of RoboTwin, termed RoboTwin-Plus; HOG-WAM achieves the highest success among the compared policies under all four. Mixed-noise success increases from 78.86% to 82.86% relative to FastWAM, with comparable performance on clean scenes. On LIBERO Plus, overall success increases from 74.49% to 75.26%, with the largest gain under sensor noise, from 74.14% to 78.89%. Across four Franka tasks, average success increases from 40% to 59% under clean observations and from 17% to 24% under noisy observations. A representation ablation favors combining RGB observations with auxiliary HOG prediction over replacing RGB with HOG. These findings support future-gradient prediction as complementary supervision for visually robust control, with larger absolute gains on physical tasks than in simulation. Code is available at https://github.com/iPPLab/HOG-WAM.

摘要（中文）：世界-动作模型联合预测未来的观测和动作，然而视觉污染可能破坏由此产生的策略。我们提出了HOG-WAM，该方法将未来方向梯度直方图（HOG）作为直接从演示图像中提取的结构性监督信号引入。一个辅助的HOG扩散Transformer（DiT）模块通过非对称注意力读取RGB特征，使其目标函数能够塑造用于控制的视觉表示。该模块仅在训练期间使用，推理时移除，从而保持FastWAM的RGB到动作架构。我们通过RoboTwin的视觉污染扩展版本RoboTwin-Plus，评估了四种受控观测污染类型；在全部四种污染条件下，HOG-WAM在对比策略中取得了最高成功率。与FastWAM相比，混合噪声下的成功率从78.86%提升至82.86%，且在干净场景下性能相当。在LIBERO Plus上，总体成功率从74.49%提升至75.26%，其中在传感器噪声条件下提升最大，从74.14%提升至78.89%。在四项Franka任务中，干净观测下的平均成功率从40%提升至59%，噪声观测下的平均成功率从17%提升至24%。表征消融实验表明，将RGB观测与辅助HOG预测相结合优于用HOG替代RGB。这些发现支持未来梯度预测作为视觉鲁棒控制的互补监督信号，且在物理任务上的绝对增益大于仿真环境。代码已开源，见https://github.com/iPPLab/HOG-WAM。

Authors: Boxuan Dong, Yupeng Qian, Ying Wu, Heshuai Li, Junhao Tan, Zhenxiong Tan, Weijia Wu, Weihao Yu

$μ$MPC: Microsecond-Scale Nonlinear and World Model Control from Edge to GPU via Koopman-Linearized Precompilation Other

Koopman Model Predictive Control Real-time control Edge inference World model

简要说明：该论文提出了μMPC，一种微秒级MPC框架，利用学习到的Koopman线性化动力学和预计算的控制到输出映射来减少在线计算，在四旋翼、四足机器人和四旋翼集群等机器人基准测试中实现了显著加速。

TLDR: This paper presents μMPC, a microsecond-scale MPC framework that leverages learned Koopman-linearized dynamics and precomputed control-to-output maps to reduce online computation, achieving significant speedups across robotics benchmarks including quadrotors, quadrupeds, and quadrotor swarms.

Abstract: We present $μ$MPC, a fast model predictive control (MPC) framework that reduces online computation using learned Koopman-linearized dynamics. By precomputing finite-horizon control-to-output maps, $μ$MPC eliminates lifted-state trajectories, yielding an action-only Koopman-Compiled QP (KC-QP) with $Hn_u$ decision variables, independent of lifted dimension. A fixed, precomputed primal operator enables efficient primal-dual iterations using only matrix-vector products and projections, accommodating changing goals and constraints without refactorization. This efficiency also enables control-aware dynamics learning through differentiable KC-QPs in the training loop and batched DAgger-style data aggregation. $μ$MPC achieves solve times as low as $23μ$s on a desktop CPU and 24 ms onboard a 168 MHz Crazyflie microcontroller. It scales to 4096D quadruped control in under 5 ms, visual planning with 2048D world models in 0.4 ms, and collision-aware planning for 200 quadrotors at over 30 Hz on the GPU. Across these benchmarks, $μ$MPC achieves up to $108\times$ faster constrained MPC and $1907\times$ faster visuomotor planning than competing methods.

摘要（中文）：我们提出了μMPC，一种快速模型预测控制（MPC）框架，通过利用学习得到的Koopman线性化动力学来减少在线计算量。通过预计算有限时域的控制到输出映射，μMPC省去了提升状态轨迹，从而生成仅含动作变量的Koopman编译二次规划（KC-QP），其决策变量数为Hn_u，与提升维数无关。固定的预计算原始算子使得仅需矩阵-向量乘积和投影操作即可高效执行原始-对偶迭代，且无需重构即可适应目标与约束的变化。这一高效性还使得在训练循环中能够通过可微分的KC-QP实现控制感知的动力学学习，并支持批式DAgger风格的数据聚合。μMPC在桌面CPU上的求解时间低至23微秒，在168 MHz的Crazyflie微控制器上为24毫秒。它可扩展至4096维四足机器人控制（求解时间低于5毫秒）、2048维世界模型的视觉规划（0.4毫秒），以及在GPU上以超过30 Hz的频率对200架四旋翼进行考虑碰撞的规划。在上述基准测试中，与现有方法相比，μMPC在约束MPC上实现了高达108倍的加速，在视觉运动规划上实现了高达1907倍的加速。

Authors: Devesh Nath, Glen Chou

Geometric Acceleration Obstacles: Physical Boundary Structure and Affine Safety Certificates Other

acceleration obstacles collision avoidance safe navigation quadratic program multi-agent navigation

简要说明：本文提出了几何加速度障碍物（GAO），对加速度障碍物的几何结构进行了统一且物理验证的刻画，推导出仿射安全约束，用于动态环境中的实时机器人导航，并展示了可扩展性和物理实验验证。

TLDR: This paper presents Geometric Acceleration Obstacles (GAO), a unified and physically validated characterization of acceleration obstacle geometry, deriving affine safety constraints for real-time robot navigation in dynamic environments, with demonstrated scalability and physical experiments.

Abstract: Safe robot navigation in dynamic environments requires collision avoidance that respects motion constraints while remaining computationally efficient. Conventional velocity-obstacle (VO) methods characterize collision-inducing motions in velocity space. Although some formulations account for acceleration-limited velocity transitions, their collision constraints remain tied to specific velocity-tracking models. Acceleration obstacles (AO) address this limitation by representing collision-inducing inputs directly in acceleration space. However, existing AO methods either rely on conservative approximations or derive analytical structure expressions without verifying their geometric correspondence. To address this gap, this paper presents Geometric Acceleration Obstacles (GAO), which provides, to the best of our knowledge, the first unified and physically validated characterization of AO geometry and its supporting structure. Specifically, we derive configuration-dependent half-planes that globally support the collision set and establish their tightness, thereby separating certified collision-free acceleration inputs from collision-inducing parts. These geometric results yield unified affine safety constraints. Combined with actuator limits, these constraints define a quadratic program (QP) for real-time navigation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GAO achieves competitive success rates and the lowest control effort among the evaluated methods, with millisecond-level computational latency. Further circle-interchange simulations demonstrate scalability to 1,000 agents. Physical experiments validate the approach in pedestrian encounters, reciprocal multi-agent navigation, and high-speed maneuvering.

摘要（中文）：安全机器人导航在动态环境中需要避开障碍物，同时尊重运动约束并保持计算效率。传统的速度障碍法（VO）在速度空间中刻画引发碰撞的运动。尽管某些公式考虑到了加速受限的速度转换，但其碰撞约束仍与特定的速度跟踪模型紧密相关。加速度障碍（AO）通过直接在加速度空间中表示引发碰撞的输入，解决了这一局限性。然而，现有的AO方法要么依赖保守近似，要么推导出解析结构表达式却未验证其几何对应性。为填补这一空白，本文提出了几何加速度障碍（GAO），据我们所知，这是首个对AO几何及其支撑结构进行统一且经物理验证的刻画。具体而言，我们推导出依赖构型的半平面，这些半平面全局支撑碰撞集合，并确立了它们的紧致性，从而将经过认证的无碰撞加速度输入与引发碰撞的部分分离。这些几何结果产生了统一的仿射安全约束。结合执行器限制，这些约束定义了一个用于实时导航的二次规划（QP）问题。大量实验表明，GAO在评估方法中达到了具有竞争力的成功率，并且控制代价最低，同时具备毫秒级计算延迟。进一步的圆形交叉仿真展示了其扩展到1000个智能体的能力。物理实验验证了该方法在行人相遇、互惠多智能体导航以及高速机动场景中的有效性。

Authors: Xuheng Gao, Yuhan Pang, Bi-Ke Zhu, Ronghao Chen, Lingxiao Meng, Jiankun Wang, Max Q. -H. Meng

Dynamic Task Update Benchmark (DTU-Bench): Evaluating Runtime Task Adaptation in Robotic Manipulation VLA

VLA policies benchmark runtime task adaptation robotic manipulation LIBERO

简要说明：本文提出了DTU-Bench基准，用于评估VLA策略在机器人操作过程中适应动态指令变化的能力，揭示了在执行中途更新任务时性能的显著下降。

TLDR: This paper introduces DTU-Bench, a benchmark evaluating VLA policies' ability to adapt to dynamic instruction changes during robotic manipulation, revealing a significant performance drop when tasks are updated mid-execution.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies perform well on fixed-instruction robotic manipulation benchmarks, but their ability to adapt to instruction changes during execution remains understudied. We introduce the Dynamic Task Update Benchmark (DTU-Bench), evaluating 40 task revisions across seven update types and three execution stages using LIBERO, a simulated robotic manipulation benchmark. We compare performance when a new instruction is given before execution starts versus during execution, and examine whether the new task instructions are followed. Across 13 representative VLA configurations, average task success is 95.8% on the original object-manipulation tasks, compared with only 1.6% when the instruction changes which object to manipulate during execution. Controlled diagnostics show that policies often complete the original task before the updated one, and that their responses depend on the robot's physical state. We further test whether a simple scripted controller that releases the grasped object and moves the arm back helps robots respond to instruction changes. This improves success from 2% to 38% for π0.5 and from 8% to 48% for DM0.5, but can cause unwanted object motion. These findings reveal limitations that fixed-instruction benchmarks and task-success metrics alone can overlook in evaluating robotic manipulation. Project page: https://dtu-bench.github.io/

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略在固定指令的机器人操作基准测试中表现良好，但其在执行过程中适应指令变化的能力仍未得到充分研究。我们提出了动态任务更新基准（DTU-Bench），利用模拟机器人操作基准LIBERO，对涵盖七种更新类型和三个执行阶段的40项任务修订进行评估。我们比较了在执行开始前给出新指令与在执行过程中给出新指令时的性能差异，并检验新任务指令是否得到遵循。在13种代表性的VLA配置中，原始物体操作任务的平均成功率为95.8%，而当指令在执行过程中更改操作目标物体时，平均成功率仅为1.6%。受控诊断实验表明，策略通常先完成原始任务再执行更新后的任务，且其响应取决于机器人的物理状态。我们进一步测试了一种简单的脚本控制器——释放抓取的物体并将机械臂收回——以帮助机器人响应指令变化。该方法将π0.5的成功率从2%提升至38%，将DM0.5的成功率从8%提升至48%，但可能导致不必要的物体移动。这些发现揭示了仅依赖固定指令基准和任务成功率指标在评估机器人操作时可能忽视的局限性。项目页面：https://dtu-bench.github.io/

Authors: Yanran Jiang, Cécile Paris, Dana Kulić, Leimin Tian

AGLR: Attribute-Guided Latent Refinement for Fine-Grained Humanoid Motion Generation and Editing HumanoidEmbodied

humanoid motion generation attribute-guided latent refinement motion editing geometric constraints zero-shot transfer

简要说明：AGLR提出了一个通过属性引导的潜在精炼实现细粒度人形运动生成与编辑的统一框架，实现了高成功率、快速推理及零样本迁移。

TLDR: AGLR presents a unified framework for fine-grained humanoid motion generation and editing via attribute-guided latent refinement, achieving high success rates with fast inference and zero-shot transfer.

Abstract: Humanoid motion generation must accommodate evolving task requirements, where localized adjustments should satisfy new geometric constraints without disrupting desired motion details. However, language-based control lacks geometric precision, while joint-level constraints require explicit spatial targets. Local geometric constraints are also underdetermined, complicating target satisfaction and source preservation. We present AGLR (Attribute-Guided Latent Refinement), a unified framework for fine-grained humanoid motion generation and editing through source-anchored refinement. A compact geometric interface supports composable, time-varying control of limb extents, torso orientation, and root trajectories. Given a generated or encoded base latent, an Attribute Residual Adapter predicts a single-pass correction, with dual-level supervision enforcing target matching and selective preservation across attributes and motion coordinates. On HumanML3D-G1, AGLR achieves the highest controllable-generation and preservation-constrained editing success rates among evaluated methods. Editing take only 9.1 ms for a cached 500-frame motion, without additional sampling or test-time optimization. Zero-shot evaluation on BONES-SEED-G1 further demonstrates transfer without fine-tuning.

摘要（中文）：类人运动生成必须适应不断变化的任务需求，其中局部调整应在不破坏期望运动细节的前提下满足新的几何约束。然而，基于语言的控制缺乏几何精度，而关节级约束则要求明确的空间目标。局部几何约束同样存在欠定问题，使得目标满足与源保留之间的平衡更加复杂。我们提出了AGLR（属性引导的潜在细化），一个通过源锚定细化实现细粒度类人运动生成与编辑的统一框架。该框架采用紧凑的几何接口，支持对肢体范围、躯干朝向和根部轨迹进行可组合的、时变的控制。给定生成或编码的基 latent，属性残差适配器预测单次修正，通过双重监督在属性和运动坐标层面强制实现目标匹配与选择性保留。在HumanML3D-G1数据集上，AGLR在可控制生成和保留约束编辑成功率方面均优于所评估的其他方法。对于缓存的500帧运动，编辑仅需9.1毫秒，无需额外采样或测试时优化。在BONES-SEED-G1上的零样本评估进一步证明了无需微调即可实现迁移的能力。

Authors: Shuai Yuan, Yuwei Gui, Mingshuang Luo, Zhuo Li, Siyuan Meng, Wenhao Cui, RuiBing Hou, Bingpeng Ma

Can Visual World Models See Force? Manipulation

force awareness world models VLA models video representation probing robot manipulation

简要说明：本文探讨视觉基础模型（包括世界模型和VLA策略）能否从视频中捕捉交互力信息，发现大多数模型能检测接触但无法感知力的大小，且机器人后训练并未改善这一能力。

TLDR: This paper investigates whether visual foundation models, including world models and VLA policies, can capture interaction force information from video, finding that most models detect contact but not force magnitude, and robot post-training does not improve this capability.

Abstract: World models and vision-language-action policy models are increasingly proposed as foundations for robot manipulation. They predict how scenes evolve and which actions to take, yet successful manipulation depends not solely on following observable trajectories but also on the hidden variable of interaction force. Neurophysiology has shown that humans possess a visual prior for this hidden variable, motivating us to ask the question: Do the representations of visual foundation models also capture the forces involved in an interaction? We define force awareness as the ability of representations to (1) indicate when contact force is applied, (2) track how it changes during an interaction, and (3) reflect how large it is. We probe frozen image, video, world- and policy model representations with a lightweight readout trained on synchronized video and force measurements from two manipulation datasets. Our experiments show that most models capture when contact occurs but not how much force is being applied. Surprisingly, robot post-training does not improve this either, highlighting an important gap in current models capabilities.

摘要（中文）：世界模型和视觉-语言-动作策略模型日益被视为机器人操作的基础。它们预测场景如何演变以及应采取哪些行动，然而成功的操作不仅依赖于对可观测轨迹的遵循，还依赖于交互力这一隐藏变量。神经生理学研究表明，人类对这一隐藏变量存在视觉先验，这促使我们提出一个问题：视觉基础模型的表征是否也能捕捉交互中涉及的力？我们将力感知定义为表征具备以下能力：（1）指示何时施加接触力，（2）跟踪交互过程中力的变化，以及（3）反映力的大小。我们使用在同步视频和来自两个操作数据集的力测量数据上训练的轻量级读取器，对冻结的图像、视频、世界模型和策略模型表征进行探测。实验结果表明，大多数模型能捕捉接触发生的时间，但无法捕捉施加力的大小。令人惊讶的是，机器人的后训练也无法改善这一点，这凸显了当前模型能力中的一个重要差距。

Authors: Felix Tristram, Benjamin D. Killeen, Nassir Navab

CHASE: Curiosity-Guided Skill Acquisition for Embodied Task Execution Manipulation

skill acquisition curiosity partial observability task execution embodied robot

简要说明：CHASE 提出了一种好奇心驱动的框架，使机器人能够在具身任务执行过程中解决任务相关的不确定性并获取缺失技能，并在仿真和真实机器人上得到验证。

TLDR: CHASE introduces a curiosity-driven framework enabling robots to resolve task-relevant uncertainty and acquire missing skills during embodied task execution, validated in simulation and on real robots.

Abstract: Robots executing tasks in partially observed environments must resolve uncertainty while operating with incomplete skills. Inspired by human curiosity, we investigate how robots can formulate task-relevant hypotheses, seek evidence, and acquire missing skills during task execution. We propose CHASE, a Curiosity-guided Harness for Acquiring Skills from Evidence, which operationalizes curiosity as selecting investigations that resolve task uncertainty and expand executable capabilities. Four modules connect dynamic scene understanding, hypothesis-driven planning, on-demand skill acquisition, and verified execution. The planner balances information value, skill reuse, and acquisition/execution cost. Missing skills trigger bounded exploration, learning from verified segments, and held-out admission during acquisition; separate checks verify physical effects and acquired evidence. Newly admitted skills expand the executable investigation set, closing the loop between resolving uncertainty and acquiring capabilities. Simulation and real-robot experiments evaluate investigation, skill acquisition, and task execution. CHASE achieves 50-80% task success under combined information and capability gaps, with 70-90% evidence resolution.

摘要（中文）：机器人在部分可观测环境中执行任务时，必须在技能不完整的情况下消除不确定性。受人类好奇心的启发，我们研究机器人如何在任务执行过程中提出与任务相关的假设、寻找证据并获取缺失技能。我们提出了CHASE（Curiosity-guided Harness for Acquiring Skills from Evidence，好奇心引导的证据技能获取框架），该框架将好奇心操作化为选择能够解决任务不确定性并扩展可执行能力的调查行为。四个模块将动态场景理解、假设驱动规划、按需技能获取和可验证执行连接起来。规划器在信息价值、技能复用以及获取/执行成本之间进行权衡。缺失技能会触发有界探索，从已验证片段中学习，并在获取过程中进行留出式准入检验；同时通过独立检查验证物理效果和已获取证据。新准入的技能扩展了可执行的调查集合，从而在消除不确定性与获取能力之间形成闭环。仿真和真实机器人实验对调查、技能获取和任务执行进行了评估。在信息和能力双重缺失的情况下，CHASE实现了50-80%的任务成功率，以及70-90%的证据解决率。

Authors: Zixuan Wang, Wei Zhang, Chenlei Zhu, Naiyu Chen, Xihua Wang, Jie Chen

BOT-Scale: A Traceable Evaluation Methodology for Robotic Manipulation Manipulation

traceable evaluation manipulation scoring behavioral factors BOTScorer BOT-Events

简要说明：BOT-Scale 提出了一种可追溯的机器人操作评估方法，将分数定义为基于行为因子记录的结果条件惩罚之和，并提供了自动评分系统 BOTScorer 和带注释的数据集 BOT-Events。

TLDR: BOT-Scale introduces a traceable evaluation methodology for robotic manipulation, defining scores as sum of outcome-conditioned penalties over behavioral-factor records, with an automatic scoring system BOTScorer and annotated dataset BOT-Events.

Abstract: A successful manipulation rollout can still involve a mid-task object drop or a placement deviation. Existing evaluators reduce such deviations to a single score or attach explanations computed separately; the score itself explains neither its basis nor what to fix. We show that a manipulation score becomes traceable when defined as the sum of outcome-conditioned penalties over retained behavioral-factor records. Explanation and score share the same computation, so each factor-level deduction names an inspectable deviation. BOT-Scale applies this principle by adapting behavioral assessment scales from medicine. It organizes twelve candidate factors into four assessment layers; each factor is tied to observable evidence and an explicit decision criterion. Reference calibration fixes a penalty per factor, and a closed-form rule aggregates the factor records into a score with per-factor contributions. We developed BOTScorer, an automatic scoring system based on the seven factors retained by data-driven screening, to validate this methodology. We provide BOT-Events, a dataset with eight-rater quality scores and factor-event annotations, alongside the traceable, interpretable score. The code will be released publicly.

摘要（中文）：一次成功的操控执行流程中，仍可能发生任务中途物体掉落或放置偏差等问题。现有评估器往往将这些偏差简化为单一分数，或将解释性内容另行计算，导致分数本身既不能说明其依据，也无法指出应修正之处。我们证明，当操控得分被定义为基于保留的行为因素记录的各项惩罚之和时，该分数便具有可追溯性。解释与得分共享同一套计算逻辑，因此每一项因素层面的扣分均对应一个可供核查的偏差。BOT-Scale 通过借鉴医学中的行为评估量表来实现这一原则。它将十二个候选因素组织为四个评估层级，每个因素均与可观察的证据及明确的判定标准相关联。参考标定确定了各因素的固定惩罚值，并通过一个闭式规则将因素记录聚合为包含各因素贡献度的总分。为验证该方法的有效性，我们开发了 BOTScorer——一个基于数据驱动筛选所保留的七个因素的自动评分系统。我们提供了 BOT-Events 数据集，其中包含八位评分者的质量评分及因素事件标注，以及可追溯、可解释的评分结果。相关代码将公开发布。

Authors: Yunfei Xue, Kemi Chen, Weiling Chen, Wei Gao, Tiesong Zhao, Zheng-Jun Zha

CamAct: Learning Robotic Manipulation from In-the-Wild Videos via Camera Motion VLA

camera motion in-the-wild videos VLA motion supervision manipulation

简要说明：CamAct 提出从野外视频中恢复相机运动，作为 VLA 策略的额外监督信号，在 LIBERO、RoboCasa 和真实世界任务中提升了操作成功率，无需目标交互演示。

TLDR: CamAct proposes using camera motion recovered from in-the-wild videos as an additional source of supervision for VLA policies, improving manipulation success on LIBERO, RoboCasa, and real-world tasks without requiring object-interaction demonstrations.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models benefit from large, diverse datasets for robotic manipulation, yet collecting robot demonstrations remains costly. Recent work has explored egocentric videos as a source of supervision, primarily drawing on demonstrations of human-object interaction. We show that in-the-wild videos can improve robotic manipulation even when they contain no demonstrations of object manipulation. Specifically, camera motion recovered from these videos provides an additional source of motion supervision that complements robot demonstrations. Building on this finding, we introduce CamAct, which incorporates this camera-motion supervision into VLA policies alongside robot demonstrations, extending the use of human videos for manipulation learning beyond object interactions. Experiments show that incorporating this video supervision during fine-tuning improves success rates from 96.40% to 98.10% on LIBERO and from 22.96% to 29.32% on RoboCasa 365. The resulting policy also demonstrates strong results in out-of-distribution generalization on LIBERO-Plus and real-world manipulation tasks.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型受益于大规模、多样化的机器人操作数据集，然而采集机器人示范数据仍然成本高昂。近期研究探索了以自我中心视频作为监督信号的来源，主要利用人-物交互示范。我们发现，即使野外视频中不包含物体操作的示范，它们仍能提升机器人操作性能。具体而言，从这些视频中恢复的相机运动提供了一种额外的运动监督来源，与机器人示范形成互补。基于这一发现，我们提出了CamAct，该方法将这种相机运动监督与机器人示范共同整合到VLA策略中，将人类视频在操作学习中的应用从物体交互扩展到了更广泛的场景。实验表明，在微调阶段引入这种视频监督后，LIBERO上的成功率从96.40%提升至98.10%，RoboCasa 365上的成功率从22.96%提升至29.32%。所得策略在LIBERO-Plus的分布外泛化测试以及真实世界操作任务中也展现出优异表现。

Authors: Haoming Gu, Yunpeng Qing, Zhi Hou, Weinan Zhang

Autonomous Vineyard Exploration using LiDAR Sensing: A Field Evaluation on Legged-Wheeled Quadruped Robot Locomotion

LiDAR autonomous exploration legged-wheeled quadruped RANSAC row following

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于LiDAR的葡萄园自主探索系统，部署在腿轮四足机器人上，野外评估展示了370米的持续行跟随，并分析了失败模式。

TLDR: This paper presents a LiDAR-based autonomous exploration system for vineyards deployed on a legged-wheeled quadruped robot, with field evaluations demonstrating sustained row following over 370m and analysis of failure modes.

Abstract: Autonomous navigation in vineyards presents significant challenges due to uneven terrain, sparse vegetation, and the repetitive geometric nature of vineyard rows. This paper evaluates a LiDAR-based autonomous exploration system deployed on a Unitree Go2 Wheeled quadruped robot. Our approach utilizes an iterative RANSAC-based line detection pipeline to identify vineyard rows and a finite-state navigation strategy to govern row selection and traversal. Field evaluations conducted at Denbies Vineyard (UK) demonstrate the system's ability to perform sustained autonomous row following, completing a 370m up-and-down traversal without intervention. We analyze the failure modes encountered, specifically focusing on line detection instability in sparse vegetation and the trade-offs of spatial filtering. The results suggest that, while RANSAC provides a robust geometric primitive, additional temporal filtering and adaptive perception are required for reliable lane-to-lane transitions in commercial vineyard environments. A video of the experimental results is available at: youtu.be/1om1HFGF4ps

摘要（中文）：葡萄园中的自主导航由于地形不平坦、植被稀疏以及葡萄园行间几何结构的重复性而面临重大挑战。本文评估了一套基于激光雷达的自主探索系统，该系统部署在Unitree Go2轮式四足机器人上。我们的方法利用基于迭代RANSAC的直线检测管道来识别葡萄园行，并采用有限状态导航策略来管理行的选择与穿越。在丹比斯葡萄园（英国）进行的实地评估表明，该系统能够持续进行自主行间跟随，在无干预情况下完成了370米的上下来回穿越。我们分析了所遇到的失效模式，重点聚焦于稀疏植被下直线检测的不稳定性以及空间滤波的权衡。结果表明，尽管RANSAC提供了稳健的几何基元，但在商业葡萄园环境中实现可靠的行间转换仍需额外的时间滤波与自适应感知。实验结果的视频可在以下链接获取：youtu.be/1om1HFGF4ps

Authors: Spencer Sweeney, Hongbo Li, Michael Ziegltrum, Dimitra Koumoutsou, Andromachi Maria Delfaki, Taskin Padir, Dimitrios Kanoulas

A Simple Yet Effective Agent for Open-World Aerial Object Search VLN

aerial object search vision-language model training-free agent depth-based navigation aerial VLN

简要说明：SimpleUAV 是一种基于冻结的现成 VLM 的无训练航空搜索代理，利用基于深度的局部几何进行导航和动作选择。它在 UAV-ON 和 AerialDojo-200K 上达到了最先进的成功率，并能有效迁移到 TravelUAV 上的航空视觉语言导航。

TLDR: SimpleUAV is a training-free aerial search agent built on a frozen off-the-shelf VLM, using depth-based local geometry for navigation and action selection. It achieves state-of-the-art success rates on UAV-ON and AerialDojo-200K, and transfers effectively to aerial VLN on TravelUAV.

Abstract: Open-world aerial object search methods often rely on persistent spatial maps, learned world models, or task-specific policy training. To examine how far a minimal, training-free design can go, we introduce SimpleUAV, an agent built around a frozen, off-the-shelf vision-language model (VLM). SimpleUAV separates current-view target assessment from history-conditioned action selection, combining fresh candidate evidence with lightweight search context. Local geometry converts visual selections into bounded straight-line movements, depth-based checks halt blocked segments, and measured execution feedback guides subsequent decisions. This closed loop sustains search without persistent spatial maps or task-specific training. SimpleUAV achieves 41.61% Success Rate (SR) on UAV-ON and 11.98% on AerialDojo-200K, compared with 23.80% and 3.20% for the strongest prior baselines, respectively. With limited benchmark-specific adaptation, the same core agent transfers to aerial Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) on TravelUAV, improving Full SR by at least 19.66% across all three splits under L1 assistance. These results establish a strong baseline for evaluating when additional architectural complexity benefits aerial search.

摘要（中文）：开放式世界中的空中目标搜索方法通常依赖于持久化的空间地图、学习到的世界模型或针对特定任务的策略训练。为探究一种极简且无需训练的设计能达到何种效果，我们提出了SimpleUAV，这是一种围绕冻结的、现成的视觉-语言模型（VLM）构建的智能体。SimpleUAV将当前视角的目标评估与基于历史信息的动作选择相分离，将即时的候选证据与轻量级的搜索上下文相结合。局部几何信息将视觉选择转化为有界直线运动，基于深度的检查会终止受阻路段，而实测的执行反馈则用于指导后续决策。这一闭环机制实现了无需持久空间地图或任务特定训练的持续搜索。SimpleUAV在UAV-ON上的成功率为41.61%，在AerialDojo-200K上为11.98%，而现有最强基线的成功率分别为23.80%和3.20%。在有限的基准测试特定适配下，同一核心智能体可迁移至TravelUAV上的空中视觉-语言导航（VLN）任务，在L1辅助下，其完整成功率（Full SR）在所有三个数据划分上均提升了至少19.66%。这些结果为评估何时额外的架构复杂性有益于空中搜索任务建立了强有力的基线。

Authors: Jitai Hao, Liangxing Yang, Zhenyang Li, Fan Liu, Qiang Huang, Jun Yu

WISER-RL: A Wake-Sleep Learning Mechanism for Robot Reinforcement Learning from One Demonstration RLRobot

wake-sleep diffusion policy offline RL single demonstration experience replay

简要说明：WISER-RL提出了一种唤醒-睡眠机制，结合模仿学习、选择性经验回放和优势引导的离线强化学习，使机器人能够从单个人类演示中学习，并在六个LIBERO任务和两个真实机器人任务上实现100%成功率。

TLDR: WISER-RL introduces a wake-sleep mechanism combining imitation, selective experience replay, and advantage-guided offline RL to enable robot learning from a single human demonstration, achieving 100% success on six LIBERO tasks and two real-robot tasks.

Abstract: A robot learning from one human demonstration may rarely succeed on its own, leaving reinforcement learning (RL) with little reward feedback. We introduce WISER-RL ({W}ake--sleep policy improvement loop, {I}mitation, and {S}elective {E}xperience {R}eplay), a composite reinforcement learning framework that turns assisted practice into autonomous control. During wake, GPTDAgger monitors disagreement among actions sampled by a diffusion policy. When disagreement crosses a threshold, a frozen GPT controller uses retrieved experience to continue the episode. During sleep, Conflict-Aware Experience Reweighting (CAER) compares visually matched successful trajectories and downweights conflicting action windows with more steps remaining to success. The policy imitates the reweighted successes and learns from both successes and failures through offline advantage-guided RL before collecting the next round. After final online PPO refinement, the autonomous policy succeeded in 100% evaluations on each of six LIBERO tasks and 100% trials on each of two real-robot tasks.

摘要（中文）：摘要：机器人仅凭人类的一次演示往往难以独立成功，这使得强化学习（RL）缺乏足够的奖励反馈。我们提出WISER-RL（{W}ake--sleep策略改进循环、{I}模仿与{S}选择性经验回放），这是一种复合强化学习框架，将辅助练习转化为自主控制。在清醒阶段，GPTDAgger监测扩散策略采样动作之间的不一致性。当不一致性超过阈值时，冻结的GPT控制器利用检索到的经验继续执行回合。在睡眠阶段，冲突感知经验重加权（CAER）比较视觉匹配的成功轨迹，并对剩余步骤更多的冲突动作窗口进行降权。策略模仿重加权后的成功经验，并通过离线优势引导RL从成功和失败中同时学习，再收集下一轮数据。经过最终的在线PPO微调，自主策略在六个LIBERO任务上的评估中均达到100%成功率，在两个真实机器人任务上的试验中也均达到100%成功率。

Authors: Kwunhang Wong, Yang Bai, Qingyang Bao, Liudi Yang, Chenzhi Liu, Jiehong Lin, Wei Huang, Lin Li, Ziyuan Liu, Yujie Yang, Gitta Kutyniok, Zhongrui Wang, Xiaojuan Qi

iMFPO: Improving Mean Flow Policy Optimization with Drift-Aware Velocity Alignment for Embodied Control RLRobot

flow-based policy reinforcement learning velocity alignment embodied control one-step generation

简要说明：iMFPO 提出了一种具有解耦速度学习和漂移感知速度对齐的单步生成策略优化框架，在四足和类人机器人上实现了高效的基于流的动作生成，并大幅降低了推理延迟。

TLDR: iMFPO proposes a one-step generative policy optimization framework with decoupled velocity learning and drift-aware velocity alignment, enabling efficient flow-based action generation for embodied control across quadruped and humanoid robots with drastically reduced latency.

Abstract: Flow-based generative policies offer expressive action modeling for embodied control, yet achieving efficient one-step generation under reward-driven policy optimization remains challenging. In particular, evolving action distributions during online reinforcement learning may introduce inconsistencies between instantaneous-velocity learning and interval-averaged action generation. To address this challenge, we propose iMFPO, a one-step generative policy optimization framework with decoupled velocity learning and drift-aware velocity alignment. A shared interval-conditioned actor supports instantaneous-velocity supervision and interval-averaged action generation. JVP-corrected velocity regression is jointly optimized with reward-driven policy objectives, with action-level guidance from a frozen PPO teacher during training. At inference, iMFPO directly generates actions through interval-averaged velocity prediction, achieving one-step control without iterative flow integration. Across Go2, G1, H1, and Spot, zero-latent evaluation yields mean returns of 35.69, 34.44, 416.23, and 29.86. On Go2, action-generation latency drops from 15.57 ms to 0.41 ms relative to 64-step RFPO. Code: https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/iMFPO. Website: https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/iMFPO.

摘要（中文）：基于流的生成策略为具身控制提供了富有表现力的动作建模，然而在奖励驱动的策略优化下实现高效的单步生成仍具挑战性。特别是，在线强化学习过程中动作分布的动态演变可能导致瞬时速度学习与区间平均动作生成之间的不一致性。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了iMFPO，一种解耦速度学习与漂移感知速度对齐的单步生成策略优化框架。共享的区间条件演员网络同时支持瞬时速度监督与区间平均动作生成。JVP校正的速度回归与奖励驱动的策略目标联合优化，并在训练期间引入冻结的PPO教师提供动作级引导。在推理阶段，iMFPO通过区间平均速度预测直接生成动作，无需迭代流积分即可实现单步控制。在Go2、G1、H1和Spot上，零延迟评估的平均回报分别为35.69、34.44、416.23和29.86。在Go2上，相比64步RFPO，动作生成延迟从15.57毫秒降至0.41毫秒。代码：https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/iMFPO。网站：https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/iMFPO。

Authors: Lisiyu Pan, Ting Huang, Zeyu Zhang, Hao Tang

Measuring the Value of One Shared Image at Robot Handoffs in Vision-and-Language Navigation VLN

vision-and-language navigation robot handoffs shared image RxR SAGE

简要说明：本文量化了视觉-语言导航中机器人交接时发送单张共享图像的价值，表明在最后一个动作块前发送视图可显著提高接收方的成功率，恢复高达30%的全历史优势。

TLDR: The paper quantifies the value of sending a single shared image at robot handoffs in Vision-and-Language Navigation, showing that transmitting the view before the lead's last action block significantly improves receiver success rates, recovering up to 30% of the full-history advantage.

Abstract: When the lead robot cannot continue, what should it send the teammate that must finish the route? We replay a frozen receiver at each contact under alternative messages. Across 3,920 autonomous departures in 106 environments, adding the view before the lead's last action block to its executed actions raised success by 7.51 percentage points (pp) per RxR handoff and 8.54 pp per SAGE handoff. Per departure the gains were 2.23 and 1.44 pp, respectively. The lead continuing in simulation defines the empirical full-history ceiling (Solo). At contact, the lead had accumulated a median of 41 frames. Sending one frame when available recovered 24% of the full-history advantage over actions alone in SAGE and 30% in RxR. Over an estimated progress cue in SAGE, the image rescued 100 routes and reversed 54 successes. Near-goal receivers finished outside less often (63.1% to 51.7%, post hoc). In secondary comparisons the earlier view outperformed the contact view by 6-7 pp per handoff. Exact-route specificity and image gains at controlled starts with mostly unknown progress or outside the goal region remained unresolved. Gains were detectable from about 7 kB per handoff. Random transmission matched within size bins nearly equaled the learned sender's team success. At a required handoff, a view of the approach to the last maneuver helps the receiver finish.

摘要（中文）：当领航机器人无法继续前行时，它应该向必须完成路线的队友发送什么信息？我们在替代消息条件下，于每次接触时重放一个冻结的接收器。在106个环境中进行的3，920次自主出发中，在领航者执行动作的基础上添加其最后一个动作模块之前的视图，使RxR交接成功率提高了7.51个百分点，SAGE交接成功率提高了8.54个百分点。每次出发的增益分别为2.23和1.44个百分点。领航者在模拟中继续前进定义了经验性的全历史上限（Solo）。在接触时，领航者累计中位数为41帧。在可用时发送一帧，恢复了SAGE中仅动作全历史优势的24%，在RxR中恢复了30%。相对于SAGE中的估计进度线索，图像挽救了100条路线，逆转了54次成功。接近目标的接收器在外部完成的频率更低（事后检验：63.1%降至51.7%）。在次要比较中，较早视图每次交接比接触视图高出6-7个百分点。在受控起始条件下，对于大部分未知进度或目标区域外的情况，精确路线特异性和图像增益仍未得到解决。每次交接约7 kB时即可检测到增益。在大小分箱内匹配的随机传输几乎等同于学习型发送者的团队成功率。在必需的交接中，接近最后机动动作的视图有助于接收器完成路线。

Authors: Yuze Lu

DuoWM:Integrating Dual 6-DoF Visual Flows into Action-Conditioned Drone World Model WorldModel

action-conditioned world model drone 6-DoF transformation video prediction trajectory following

简要说明：DuoWM 提出了一种双 6-DoF 视觉流条件（动作流和对象流）的动作条件第一视角无人机视频世界模型，在 Sekai-drone 数据集上提升了视频质量、3D 一致性和轨迹跟踪能力。

TLDR: DuoWM introduces a dual 6-DoF visual flow condition (action flow and object flow) for action-conditioned first-person drone video world models, improving video quality, 3D consistency, and trajectory following on the Sekai-drone dataset.

Abstract: Action-conditioned video world models generate future observations from an initial frame and a camera trajectory, but often fail to align camera commands with visual dynamics or represent full 6-DoF scene transformations. We present DuoWM, a first-person drone video world model with two complementary visual conditions. Action flow projects future camera positions and orientations into each target frame, while Object flow forward-warps the initial observation and overlays local 6-DoF transformations to ground the induced scene motion. We further introduce transform-aware pretraining, which pairs object appearance with explicit transformation axes before standard RGB video training. On Sekai-drone dataset, DuoWM achieves the best results across video quality, 3D consistency, and trajectory following. Compared with Captain Safari, the state-of-the-art method, our approach reduces real-domain FVD and LPIPS by 17.2\% and 21.6\%, respectively, while improving game-domain AUC@30 from 0.5003 to 0.5719 and AUC@15 from 0.3088 to 0.3747.

摘要（中文）：动作条件视频世界模型根据初始帧和相机轨迹生成未来观测，但常常难以将相机指令与视觉动态对齐，或无法表示完整的六自由度场景变换。我们提出DuoWM，一种具有两种互补视觉条件的第一人称无人机视频世界模型。动作流将未来的相机位置和姿态投影到每个目标帧中，而对象流则前向扭曲初始观测，并叠加局部六自由度变换，以锚定所引发的场景运动。我们进一步引入变换感知预训练，在标准RGB视频训练之前，将对象外观与显式变换轴配对。在Sekai-drone数据集上，DuoWM在视频质量、三维一致性和轨迹跟随方面均取得了最佳结果。与最先进的方法Captain Safari相比，我们的方法在真实域中将FVD和LPIPS分别降低了17.2%和21.6%，同时将游戏域中的AUC@30从0.5003提升至0.5719，AUC@15从0.3088提升至0.3747。

Authors: Zixuan Li, Kangyao Huang, Meng Xu, Wan Tian, Xiaoyu Tang, Jinge Sun, Yingliang Yao, He Chen, Lingzhong Meng, Yunzhi Xue, Jingyu Chen

PROVE: Predict-to-Specify and Observe-to-Verify for Human-Aligned Evaluation of Mobile Manipulation Manipulation

mobile manipulation evaluation goal image generation reward design evaluator distillation RoboCasa365

简要说明：PROVE提出了一种两阶段移动操作评估方法，通过生成目标图像来明确成功条件并验证结果，在6500次RoboCasa365测试中达到96.83%的人类一致性，并蒸馏出更快的PROVE-Lite用于策略优化。

TLDR: PROVE introduces a two-stage evaluator for mobile manipulation that uses a generated goal image to specify success conditions and then verifies outcomes, achieving 96.83% human agreement on 6,500 RoboCasa365 rollouts and enabling a faster distilled evaluator (PROVE-Lite) for policy optimization.

Abstract: Judging open-world robot manipulation is hard because layouts, articulated fixtures, and valid goal configurations vary widely. On RoboCasa365, simulator predicates agree with human judgments on only 69.09\% of rollouts, and a frontier VLM judge on 86.12\%. We present \textbf{PROVE} (Predict-to-Specify, Observe-to-Verify), which first specifies what success should look like and then checks the outcome. PROVE refines success conditions from the instruction, the initial scene, a target-object reference image, and a generated goal image. The goal image only sharpens the conditions and never serves as evidence. On 6,500 human-annotated rollouts over 65 atomic actions, PROVE reaches \textbf{96.83\%} agreement. Applied to open-source policies, it reports far lower success than native checks and changes their ranking. To reduce evaluation overhead in policy learning, we distill PROVE into \textbf{PROVE-Lite}, a 4B evaluator that needs no reference images. In one forward pass, PROVE-Lite predicts the outcome and the terminal state of each task condition. It reaches \textbf{91.20\%} agreement while running about 38$\times$ faster than PROVE. Mapped to a severity-aware reward, its diagnoses improve PPO post-training over both simulator and binary rewards.

摘要（中文）：判断开放世界机器人操作的成功与否颇具挑战，因为布局、可活动固定装置及有效目标配置千差万别。在RoboCasa365中，模拟器谓词与人类判断的一致性仅为69.09%，而前沿VLM评判器的一致性则为86.12%。我们提出了**PROVE**（预测-细化，观察-验证）方法，该方法首先明确成功的标准，随后对结果进行检查。PROVE依据指令、初始场景、目标物体参考图像及生成的目标图像来细化成功条件。其中，目标图像仅用于增强条件定义，并非评估依据。在涵盖65种原子动作的6,500个人工标注场景中，PROVE达到了**96.83%**的一致性。应用于开源策略时，其报告的成功率远低于原生检查方法，并改变了策略的排名。为降低策略学习过程中的评估开销，我们将PROVE精简为**PROVE-Lite**——一个无需参考图像的4B参数评估器。通过单次前向传播，PROVE-Lite即可预测每项任务条件的最终结果及终止状态。该评估器达到了**91.20%**的一致性，同时运行速度比PROVE快约38倍。当映射到严重性感知的奖励机制时，其诊断结果在PPO后训练阶段相较于模拟器和二元奖励均表现出更优的性能。

Authors: Bowen Lyu, Yunan Liu, Liaoyuan Fan, Qinchuan Cheng, Jiafei Duan, Cheston Tan, Shijie Li

RoboJackVR: Turning Robot Tasks into VR Games for Scalable Demonstration Collection Manipulation

Virtual Reality Demonstration Collection Teleoperation Imitation Learning LIBERO

简要说明：RoboJackVR 将机器人任务收集转化为 VR 游戏，通过设备端仿真和录制实现可扩展的演示收集。基于这些 VR 演示训练的 ACT 策略在 LIBERO-90 任务上保持了约 91% 的基线成功率。

TLDR: RoboJackVR turns robot task collection into a VR game, enabling scalable demonstration collection with on-device simulation and recording. ACT policies trained on these VR demonstrations retain ~91% of the baseline success rate on LIBERO-90 tasks.

Abstract: Scaling robot demonstration datasets requires collection systems that accommodate more participants and diverse tasks, yet teleoperation barriers and task-adaptation effort limit this expansion. We present RoboJackVR, a standalone virtual reality (VR) game in which players manipulate simulated robots to execute combat skills and contribute demonstrations. MuJoCo simulation and demonstration recording run locally on the headset, removing the need for an external PC or simulation server during collection. Tutorials, skill selection, combat consequences, and character progression organize repeated task attempts within a continuing game. Task contracts declare assets, controls, resets, success criteria, and recording semantics; separate game configurations specify guidance, attempt groups, skill effects, and course placement. Shared bindings connect these declarations to task execution, outcome handling, and recording, allowing tasks to reuse the game flow while retaining their control and success semantics. Batch tools package supported resources and generate configurations, with manual adaptation and review for new interfaces and unsupported predicates. We instantiate the approach with SO101-Nexus-derived and LIBERO tasks. On the 66 LIBERO-90 tasks covered by the collected data, ACT policies trained solely on VR demonstrations retain approximately 91% of the full-standard simulation-demonstration baseline's success rate on held-out initial states, averaged over four training seeds. These results support the utility of play-collected VR demonstrations for policy learning in this setting.

摘要（中文）：扩展机器人演示数据集需要能够容纳更多参与者和多样化任务的采集系统，然而遥操作障碍和任务适配工作限制了这种扩展。我们提出了RoboJackVR，一款独立的虚拟现实（VR）游戏，玩家通过操控模拟机器人执行战斗技能并贡献演示数据。MuJoCo模拟和演示录制在头显本地运行，无需外部PC或模拟服务器即可完成数据采集。教程、技能选择、战斗后果和角色进度将重复的任务尝试组织在持续进行的游戏框架中。任务契约声明了资源、控制方式、重置逻辑、成功标准和记录语义；独立的游戏配置则指定了引导、尝试分组、技能效果和关卡布置。共享绑定将这些声明连接到任务执行、结果处理和记录流程，使任务能够复用游戏流程，同时保留各自的控制和成功语义。批处理工具打包支持的资源并生成配置，新接口和不支持的谓词则需手动适配和审查。我们以SO101-Nexus衍生任务和LIBERO任务实例化了该方法。在采集数据所覆盖的66个LIBERO-90任务中，仅使用VR演示训练的ACT策略在保留初始状态上的成功率平均（四个训练种子）约为全标准模拟演示基线的91%。这些结果支持了在该场景下通过游戏化采集的VR演示用于策略学习的有效性。

Authors: Ben Ma, Jixuan Cai

Practice Makes Fluent: Learning to Use Earlier Predictions in Looped Models RLRobot

looped models early exits computation efficiency distillation real robot

简要说明：FLUENT 通过将最终预测蒸馏到早期出口并学习计算感知的出口门，训练循环模型使用更少的迭代，在 Crafter、LIBERO、语言建模和真实机器人操作中提高了效率和性能。

TLDR: FLUENT trains looped models with shared weights to use fewer iterations by distilling final predictions into early exits and learning a computation-aware exit gate, improving efficiency and performance across Crafter, LIBERO, language modeling, and real-robot manipulation.

Abstract: People become faster at a task through practice, but models that improve with experience do not necessarily learn to use less computation. We train looped models, whose intermediate predictions allow earlier exits, to perform tasks with fewer iterations through practice. This is difficult because shared-weight updates can degrade the final-loop prediction while improving early ones, and the exit gate must track early predictions as their quality changes. We propose FLUENT, which requires no additional task labels or rewards: it distills the initial model's final-loop prediction into early predictions, anchors the current final-loop prediction to the same frozen teacher, and trains the exit gate to balance disagreement with the current final-loop prediction against computation cost. FLUENT improves performance at shallower depth in new Crafter worlds, raises LIBERO success with fewer action-head iterations, and maintains language-model accuracy at lower selected depth. On a real robot, success rises from 62.3\% to 74.6\% while mean time over successful episodes falls from 69\,s to 31\,s. The project page is available at https://msseok96-cpu.github.io/FLUENT/.

摘要（中文）：人们通过练习会在完成任务时变得更快，但那些随着经验而改进的模型并不一定会学会使用更少的计算量。我们训练了循环模型，其中间预测允许提前退出，通过实践以更少的迭代次数执行任务。这很困难，因为共享权重的更新可能会在提升早期预测的同时损害最终循环的预测，而退出门必须跟踪早期预测，因为它们的质量在不断变化。我们提出了FLUENT，它不需要额外的任务标签或奖励：它将初始模型的最终循环预测蒸馏到早期预测中，将当前最终循环预测锚定到同一个冻结的教师模型上，并训练退出门以权衡当前最终循环预测的分歧与计算成本。FLUENT在新的Crafter世界中提升了较浅深度下的性能，提高了LIBERO在更少动作头迭代下的成功率，并在较低的选择深度下保持了语言模型的准确性。在真实机器人上，成功率从62.3\%提升至74.6\%，同时成功回合的平均时间从69秒降至31秒。项目页面可在https://msseok96-cpu.github.io/FLUENT/ 获取。

Authors: Minseok seo, Hee-Seon Kim, Changick Kim

A general-purpose safe manipulator planning framework for diverse environments without retraining Manipulation

finite-state abstracted model block-conservative specification safe manipulation planning vision-based feedback control humanoid robot

简要说明：本文提出了一种通用安全操作规划框架，通过有限状态抽象模型和块保守规范生成，使机器人无需重新训练即可在不同环境中完成多种操作任务，并在Unitree G1人形机器人上进行了验证。

TLDR: This paper introduces a general-purpose safe manipulation planning framework that uses a finite-state abstracted model and block-conservative specifications to enable a robot to perform various manipulation tasks across different environments without retraining, validated on a Unitree G1 humanoid.

Abstract: Nowadays, robots need to be retrained whenever their operating environment changes, and this prohibitive training cost keeps them far from daily use. The community is calling for innovations that bestow on a robot the ability to safely grasp different objects under different conditions without excessive training data and computing power. In response to this call, we present a general-purpose manipulator mission-planning framework, allowing a robot to safely perform manipulation tasks, such as grasping objects that fit in its gripper, across different operating environments without retraining its controllers. The framework rests on two innovations: a finite-state abstracted model, bisimilar to the original system dynamics, that describes accessibility of the space in front of the robot under its given arm and gripper, and a block-conservative specification generation method that turns each manipulation task under any specific operational environment into specifications about state accessibility of the abstracted model. A task proven feasible and safe on the abstracted model is guaranteed to be safe and achievable by the robot. Real-world case studies conducted on a Unitree G1 U1 humanoid show that manipulation tasks commonly encountered in daily life, such as grasping an object, pressing an elevator button or picking up a berry, can be handled within this framework, where an abstracted model of the G1 U1 robot is built only once to avoid costly model reconstructions, and different tasks are simply captured by specific block-conservative specifications, achievable by a generic mission planner with vision-based feedback control.

摘要（中文）：如今，每当机器人的工作环境发生变化时，都需要对其进行重新训练，这种高昂的训练成本使其难以在日常场景中广泛应用。业界亟需创新方法，使机器人能够在无需大量训练数据和计算资源的条件下，安全地抓取不同环境中的各类物体。为此，我们提出了一种通用型机械臂任务规划框架，使机器人能够在不同操作环境下安全地执行操作任务（如抓取适合其夹爪的物体），而无需重新训练其控制器。该框架基于两大创新：一是构建一个与原始系统动力学互模拟的有限状态抽象模型，用于描述机器人给定手臂和夹爪条件下前方空间的可达性；二是提出一种块保守的规格生成方法，将任意特定操作环境下的每个操作任务转化为抽象模型状态可达性的规格描述。在抽象模型上验证为可行且安全的任务，即可保证机器人在实际执行中的安全性和可实现性。我们在宇树G1 U1人形机器人上进行的真实场景实验表明，日常生活中常见的操作任务——如抓取物体、按压电梯按钮或拾取浆果——均可在此框架内完成。其中，G1 U1机器人的抽象模型仅需构建一次，从而避免了昂贵的模型重建成本，而不同任务只需通过特定的块保守规格来描述，即可由配备基于视觉的反馈控制的通用任务规划器实现。

Authors: Mingkang Long, Rong Su, Luhang Hong, Qingqing Wang, Ruochen Tai

Systematic study of the performance of small robots on controlled laboratory substrates Locomotion

biologically inspired robots terrain interaction cost of transport stability legged locomotion

简要说明：本文系统比较了两种小型腿式机器人（DASH和RoACH）在刚性和流动基底上的性能，考察速度、功率、运输成本和稳定性，发现地面相互作用的物理特性显著影响性能和稳定性。

TLDR: This paper systematically compares two small legged robots (DASH and RoACH) on rigid and flowing substrates, examining speed, power, cost of transport, and stability, and finds that ground interaction physics strongly affects performance and stability.

Abstract: The design of robots able to locomote effectively over a diversity of terrain requires detailed ground interaction models; unfortunately such models are lacking due to the complicated response of real world substrates which can yield and flow in response to loading. To advance our understanding of the relevant modeling and design issues, we conduct a comparative study of the performance of DASH and RoACH, two small, biologically inspired, six legged, lightweight (10 cm, 20 g) robots fabricated using the smart composite microstructure (SCM) process. We systematically examine performance of both robots on rigid and flowing substrates. Varying both ground properties and limb stride frequency, we investigate average speed, mean mechanical power and cost of transport, and stability. We find that robot performance and stability is sensitive to the physics of ground interaction: on hard ground kinetic energy must be managed to prevent yaw, pitch, and roll instability to maintain high performance, while on sand the fluidizing interaction leads to increased cost of transport and lower running speeds. We also observe that the characteristic limb morphology and kinematics of each robot result in distinct differences in their abilities to traverse different terrains. Our systematic studies are the first step toward developing models of interaction of limbs with complex terrain as well as developing improved limb morphologies and control strategies.

摘要（中文）：能够有效在多种地形上移动的机器人设计需要详细的地面交互模型；遗憾的是，由于现实世界基质在载荷作用下可能发生屈服和流动的复杂响应，此类模型尚属缺乏。为增进对相关建模与设计问题的理解，我们对DASH和RoACH两种小型、仿生、六足、轻量级（10厘米，20克）机器人进行了性能对比研究，这两种机器人均采用智能复合微结构（SCM）工艺制造。我们系统考察了这两种机器人在刚性基质和流动基质上的表现。通过改变地面特性和肢体步频，我们研究了平均速度、平均机械功率、运输成本及稳定性。研究发现，机器人的性能和稳定性对地面交互的物理特性十分敏感：在硬质地面上，必须有效管理动能以防止偏航、俯仰和翻滚造成的不稳定，从而维持高性能表现；而在沙地上，流化交互导致运输成本增加、运行速度降低。我们还观察到，每种机器人特有的肢体形态和运动学特征使其在穿越不同地形时表现出明显的能力差异。我们的系统性研究是迈向开发肢体与复杂地形交互模型、以及改进肢体形态和控制策略的第一步。
