Authors: Chen Li, Aaron M. Hoover, Paul Birkmeyer, Paul B. Umbanhowar, Ronald S. Fearing, Daniel I. Goldman

Fine-Grained Ego-Vehicle Action Recognition from Driving Video AutonomousDriving

ego-vehicle action recognition benchmark multi-source labeling video-based baseline driving video retrieval

简要说明：本文提出了 EgoManeuver，一个用于驾驶视频中细粒度自我车辆动作识别的统一基准，以及多源标注系统和基于视频的基线 DenseEgo，在性能上有所提升，并展示了与语言模型代理集成进行视频检索的应用。

TLDR: This paper introduces EgoManeuver, a unified benchmark for fine-grained ego-vehicle action recognition from driving videos, along with a multi-source labeling system and a video-based baseline DenseEgo, demonstrating improved performance and integration with a language-model agent for video retrieval.

Abstract: Fine-grained ego-vehicle action recognition turns large-scale driving video into structured, searchable driving scenarios, providing a foundation for discovering critical maneuvers and systematically developing and evaluating autonomous driving models. However, large-scale driving videos often lack explicit ego-action labels, and existing datasets vary in action definitions, annotation granularity, and available supervision. We introduce EgoManeuver, a unified benchmark of 16 lateral and 6 longitudinal actions constructed from seven public driving datasets. Our multi-source labeling system leverages existing annotations and complementary evidence available in each source dataset, including vehicle signals, ego poses, HD-map topology, and captions, to assign labels under a unified fine-grained action taxonomy. We further standardize temporal action boundaries across datasets and validate the resulting labels through kinematic consistency checks and targeted human review. The resulting benchmark contains 86.6K segments spanning 190.8 h across 26 countries and provides a long-tail-aware evaluation protocol. We also introduce DenseEgo, a video-based baseline that combines spatially aware representations with dense per-step action supervision. On the EgoManeuver, DenseEgo achieves 82.7 lateral and 83.5 longitudinal mAP, outperforming the strongest existing video model by 1.5 and 5.0 points, respectively. Finally, we demonstrate one way to integrate DenseEgo with a language-model agent for retrieving driving videos that match user-specified actions and scenarios. All code, datasets, and model weights will be publicly released.

摘要（中文）：细粒度的自车动作识别将大规模驾驶视频转化为结构化、可搜索的驾驶场景，为发现关键操作以及系统性地开发和评估自动驾驶模型奠定了基础。然而，大规模驾驶视频往往缺乏明确的自车动作标签，且现有数据集在动作定义、标注粒度和可用监督信息方面存在差异。我们提出了EgoManeuver，一个由七个公开驾驶数据集构建的统一基准，涵盖16种横向动作和6种纵向动作。我们的多源标注系统利用现有标注信息以及各源数据集中可用的互补证据，包括车辆信号、自车姿态、高精地图拓扑和文本描述，在统一的细粒度动作分类体系下分配标签。我们进一步跨数据集标准化了时间动作边界，并通过运动学一致性检查和针对性人工审查验证了所得标签的有效性。该基准包含来自26个国家的86.6K个片段，总时长190.8小时，并提供了面向长尾分布的评价协议。我们还引入了DenseEgo，一种基于视频的基线方法，将空间感知表示与密集的逐步骤动作监督相结合。在EgoManeuver上，DenseEgo在横向和纵向动作上分别达到82.7和83.5的mAP，比现有最强的视频模型分别高出1.5和5.0个百分点。最后，我们展示了一种将DenseEgo与语言模型智能体集成的方法，用于检索符合用户指定动作和场景的驾驶视频。所有代码、数据集和模型权重将公开发布。

Authors: Zhipeng Bao, Wenjie Zhao, Qianwen Li

Fast Muscle-Driven Whole-Body Motion Tracking with a Differentiable World Model RLRobot

muscle-driven differentiable world model motion tracking MuJoCo Beta exploration

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于可微分世界模型的肌肉驱动全身运动追踪快速训练方案，在MS-Human-700和MyoFullBody上分别实现了37倍和34倍的加速，并通过测试时的动作精细化进一步提升了性能。

TLDR: This paper presents a fast training recipe for muscle-driven whole-body motion tracking using a differentiable world model based on SuperMimic, achieving 37x speedup on MS-Human-700 and 34x on MyoFullBody, and further improving performance through test-time policy action refinement.

Abstract: Tracking motion capture with a whole-body musculoskeletal model means coordinating hundreds of muscles through contact, and current controllers take hours to days of GPU time to train, so every tuning decision is expensive. SuperMimic trains a tracking policy by backpropagating through the rollouts of a learned world model. We extend it to MS-Human-700 (700 muscles) and MyoFullBody (354 muscles), with MuJoCo's activation dynamics inside the world model. To make its training fast, our recipe takes the speedups developed for the Unitree G1, replaces three of their settings that fail on muscles, and adds four changes of our own: observations without muscle geometry, data collection concurrent with the updates, Beta exploration noise that keeps every excitation in $[0,1]$, and 50 Hz control. On one RTX 5090 it trains MS-Human-700 in 6.3 minutes to the held-out return that SuperMimic's published hyperparameters reach in 3.9 hours, 37$\times$ sooner, and in 20 minutes to lower tracking errors than theirs after 10 hours. It trains MyoFullBody 34$\times$ sooner without retuning. Ablations show what is specific to muscles: a higher policy learning rate stalls half of the runs, and clipped Gaussian noise adds a tonic co-contraction that Beta noise avoids. Finally, refining the policy's actions through the world model at test time lowers the position error by a further 26% with no held-out clip failing, and reaches the same return after 5.1 instead of 6.3 minutes of training. Code, the training recipe and videos are on the project page https://muscle-supermimic.beanpow.top.

摘要（中文）：使用全身肌肉骨骼模型进行动作捕捉追踪意味着需要通过接触协调数百块肌肉，而当前的控制器需要数小时至数天的GPU时间进行训练，因此每一次调参决策都代价高昂。SuperMimic通过将误差反向传播经过学习到的世界模型的 rollout 来训练追踪策略。我们将其扩展到 MS-Human-700（700块肌肉）和 MyoFullBody（354块肌肉），并在世界模型内部使用 MuJoCo 的激活动力学。为加速训练，我们的方案采用了为 Unitree G1 开发的加速技术，替换了其中三个在肌肉场景下失效的设置，并新增了四项改进：不含肌肉几何结构的观测、与更新并行的数据采集、将每个激励保持在 $[0,1]$ 区间的 Beta 探索噪声，以及50 Hz的控制频率。在一张 RTX 5090 上，训练 MS-Human-700 仅需6.3分钟即可达到 SuperMimic 发布超参数在3.9小时内达到的留出回报，提速37倍；训练20分钟即可获得比其训练10小时后更低的追踪误差。在不重新调参的情况下，MyoFullBody 的训练速度提升了34倍。消融实验显示了肌肉特有的问题：更高的策略学习率会导致一半运行停滞，而截断高斯噪声会引入紧张性共收缩，Beta 噪声则避免了这一问题。最后，在测试阶段通过世界模型优化策略动作，可将位置误差进一步降低26%，且没有出现任何留出片段失败，并在5.1分钟而非6.3分钟的训练后达到相同回报。代码、训练方案和视频见项目页面：https://muscle-supermimic.beanpow.top。

Authors: Kaibo He, Maciej Bakowicz, Shihe Zhou, Yusen Feng, Yanan Sui, Dhanush Radhakrishnan

Best-of-$N$ Test-Time Steering Can Lead to Reward Hacking in Vision-Language-Action Models VLA

test-time steering reward hacking verifier calibration action candidate selection LIBERO-Safety

简要说明：本文研究了视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的最佳N测试时引导，发现当验证器不准确时，增加采样动作数量可能导致奖励黑客攻击，并提出了校准和基于softmax的选择作为部分缓解措施。

TLDR: This paper investigates best-of-N test-time steering for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, showing that increasing the number of sampled actions can lead to reward hacking when the verifier is inaccurate, and proposes calibration and softmax-based selection as partial mitigations.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown promise for general-purpose robotic manipulation, but adapting to changing environmental conditions still remains challenging. Recent test-time steering methods have shown promise in enabling adaptive VLA policies by utilizing additional computation during deployment. In this paper, we consider best-of-$N$ test-time steering for VLA models, where multiple action candidates are sampled from a fixed policy and a verifier is used to select the best one during deployment. We show that increasing $N$ does not always improve performance when the verifier is inaccurate, and can favor candidates whose scores exploit prediction errors, a form of reward hacking. We study this effect on 60 LIBERO-Safety task-level cases using a $π_{0.5}$ policy, with ten repetitions per case. We introduce controlled errors in a MuJoCo trajectory verifier and show that as $N$ increases, selected candidate rewards diverge from the accurate verifier rewards, leading to reward hacking. We also show that verifier calibration and softmax-based candidate selection can mitigate reward hacking in some settings.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在通用机器人操作任务中展现出了巨大潜力，但适应不断变化的环境条件仍具挑战性。近期的测试时引导方法通过在部署过程中利用额外计算，展示了实现自适应VLA策略的可能性。本文研究了VLA模型的最佳N选一（best-of-\(N\)）测试时引导方法，其中从固定策略中采样多个动作候选，并由验证器在部署时选择最优动作。我们发现，当验证器不准确时，增大\(N\)并不总能提升性能，反而可能使得分偏向那些利用预测误差的候选，这构成了一种奖励黑客（reward hacking）形式。我们使用\(π_{0.5}\)策略在60个LIBERO-Safety任务级案例中研究了这一效应，每个案例重复十次。我们在MuJoCo轨迹验证器中引入受控误差，结果显示，随着\(N\)增大，所选候选的奖励逐渐偏离准确验证器的奖励，从而导致奖励黑客现象。我们还表明，验证器校准和基于softmax的候选选择在某些设置下可以缓解奖励黑客问题。

Authors: Vanshaj Khattar, Jing Liu, Toshiaki Koike-Akino, Ming Jin, Ye Wang

Why Does Sensor Depth Fail Learned Manipulation Policies? Finding the Failure Mode with ACT Manipulation

RGB-D imitation policy depth noise depth holes sensor model calibration ACT

简要说明：本文发现深度传感器的空洞（holes）而非噪声是导致RGB-D模仿操作策略性能下降的主要原因，表明对于学习型操作策略，深度覆盖率比测量精度更重要。

TLDR: This paper identifies depth sensor holes, not noise, as the primary cause of performance degradation in RGB-D imitation manipulation policies, showing that coverage matters more than precision for depth sensors in learned manipulation.

Abstract: Learned manipulation policies, from task-specific imitation policies to vision-language-action (VLA) models, rely primarily on RGB images. While some studies report gains from sensor depth, others avoid depth cameras because of measurement noise. Depth cameras introduce both noise and missing depth values (holes), whose relative effects remain unclear. In this study, we calibrate a sensor model using a real wrist-mounted stereo camera and separately evaluate noise and holes on RGB-D imitation policies with three visual encoders in simulation. We found that complete depth improves success by approximately ten percentage points, and most of this gain persists even at twenty times the camera's noise level. In contrast, holes covering about one-sixth of the wrist image eliminate the detectable benefit of depth. The validity mask strongly influences depth reliance: marking a small fraction of pixels as invalid reduces reliance, while filling holes and marking them valid restores most of the benefit. Policies trained on clean depth also lose performance when holes appear only at deployment, sometimes falling below RGB-only performance. These findings suggest that depth cameras for learned policies should therefore be judged by depth coverage more than measurement precision.

摘要（中文）：学习型操控策略，从特定任务的模仿策略到视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，主要依赖RGB图像。尽管一些研究报道了传感器深度信息带来的性能提升，其他研究则因测量噪声而避免使用深度相机。深度相机既引入噪声，也会产生缺失深度值（空洞），而两者的相对影响尚不明确。在本研究中，我们使用真实腕部安装的立体相机标定了一个传感器模型，并在仿真中分别评估了噪声和空洞对采用三种视觉编码器的RGB-D模仿策略的影响。我们发现，完整的深度信息能将成功率提升约十个百分点，且即使在相机噪声水平放大二十倍的情况下，这一增益的大部分仍然保持。相比之下，覆盖腕部图像约六分之一的空洞则完全消除了深度信息的可检测益处。有效性掩码对深度依赖有显著影响：将少量像素标记为无效会降低依赖程度，而填补空洞并将其标记为有效则可恢复大部分增益。仅在部署时出现空洞的情况下，使用干净深度数据训练的策略性能会下降，有时甚至低于仅使用RGB的性能。这些发现表明，对于学习型策略而言，深度相机的选择应更注重深度覆盖率而非测量精度。

Authors: Inayat Rasool, Chulwoo Pack, Shabbir Ahmed

WorldInteract: Controllable Streaming Video Generation for Multi-Material Interactions WorldModel

video world model controllable video generation multi-material interactions physics control material-aware RL

简要说明：WorldInteract 提出了一种流式视频生成框架，将跨材料交互分解为材料相关行为生成和接触响应计算，从而实现对多材料场景中可控推动的控制。

TLDR: WorldInteract introduces a streaming video generation framework that decomposes cross-material interactions into material-dependent behavior generation and contact response computation, enabling controllable push control in scenes with diverse materials.

Abstract: Video world models aim to create interactive physical worlds that capture how diverse materials move and interact. Yet material-dependent dynamics remain underexplored in controllable video generation, limiting reliable control in scenes with different materials. We present WorldInteract, a streaming video generation framework that decomposes cross-material interaction into material-dependent behavior generation and contact response computation. External pushes and contact impulses are expressed through a shared velocity-increment interface, allowing material behaviors learned from interaction-free videos to be reused in interacting scenes. A physics controller predicts contacts and computes velocity increments from estimated masses and restitution coefficients, while a causal generator executes these increments using learned material behaviors. This separation enables cross-material interaction without supervised contact videos spanning diverse material pairings and contact configurations. We train the generator on 30k simulated interaction-free videos spanning 22 material classes and introduce Material-Aware RL, using verifiable physical rewards to refine material behavior and control execution. WorldInteract substantially outperforms state-of-the-art methods on Physics-IQ and delivers more reliable push control on real-world images.

摘要（中文）：视频世界模型旨在创建交互式物理世界，以捕捉不同材料如何移动和相互作用。然而，在可控视频生成中，依赖于材料的动力学仍未得到充分探索，限制了在包含不同材料的场景中的可靠控制。我们提出了WorldInteract，一种流式视频生成框架，将跨材料交互分解为依赖于材料的行為生成与接触响应计算。外部推动和接触冲量通过共享的速度增量接口表达，使得从无交互视频中学到的材料行为能够复用于交互场景中。物理控制器预测接触，并根据估计的质量和恢复系数计算速度增量，而因果生成器利用学到的材料行为执行这些增量。这种分离使得无需覆盖多种材料配对和接触配置的有监督接触视频即可实现跨材料交互。我们在涵盖22种材料类别的3万个模拟无交互视频上训练生成器，并引入材料感知强化学习，利用可验证的物理奖励来优化材料行为和控制的执行。WorldInteract在Physics-IQ上显著优于现有最先进方法，并在真实世界图像上实现了更可靠的推动控制。

Authors: Ahmed Hatem, Caoliwen Wang, Robert Hoang, Siyuan Chen, Spencer Szabados, Zike Wu, Xiyang Tan, Shenyifan Lu, Rafael Bischof, Bernd Bickel, Renjie Liao, Peter Yichen Chen

One Patch, Many Policies: Object-Associated Physical Patch Attacks on Robotic Manipulation Manipulation

adversarial attacks physical patch Vision-Language-Action models World Action Models robotic manipulation

简要说明：本文提出了一种针对机器人操作中VLA和世界动作模型的通用且可迁移的物理补丁攻击框架（OAPA），通过补丁放置实现对特定任务物体操作的定向干扰。

TLDR: This paper introduces a universal and transferable physical patch attack framework (OAPA) targeting VLA and World Action Models in robotic manipulation, enabling attackers to selectively disrupt manipulation of chosen task objects via patch placement.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) and World Action Models (WAMs) are vulnerable to adversarial visual interference, motivating the study of universal and transferable physical patch attacks. We propose Object-Associated Patch Attack (OAPA), a universal and transferable physical patch framework that enables an attacker to select which task object's manipulation to disrupt through patch placement, without re-optimizing the patch. Our framework combines object-associated placement, differentiable physical compositing, and final action-expert representation divergence. Physical compositing accounts for perspective and occlusion across camera views, while representation divergence guides patch optimization using either relative RMS or cosine distance. Experimental results demonstrate strong attack transferability across task suites and policies, together with the ability to selectively disrupt manipulation of an attacker-chosen task object through patch placement.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型与世界动作模型（WAMs）易受对抗性视觉干扰的影响，这促使了对通用且可迁移的物理补丁攻击的研究。我们提出了对象关联补丁攻击（OAPA），这是一种通用且可迁移的物理补丁框架，使攻击者能够通过补丁放置位置选择干扰哪个任务对象的操控，而无需重新优化补丁。我们的框架结合了对象关联放置、可微分的物理合成以及最终动作专家表示散度。物理合成考虑了多相机视角下的透视与遮挡效应，而表示散度则利用相对均方根（RMS）或余弦距离指导补丁优化。实验结果表明，该方法在任务套件与策略之间具有强大的攻击可迁移性，并能够通过补丁放置位置选择性地干扰攻击者指定任务对象的操控。

Authors: Yiqian Liu, Yuqi Lin, Hui Lu, Jiaming He, Qi Zhu, Deyi Ji, Bing Li, Kaizheng Wang, Zhiyuan Zha, Yi Yu

VivaWorld: Long-Horizon Video World Model With Compositional 3D Priors WorldModel

long-horizon video generation compositional 3D representation hybrid camera embedding novel-view synthesis world model

简要说明：VivaWorld 提出了一种从单张图像生成长期、几何一致视频的框架，通过结合重建点云和生成网格，并引入混合相机嵌入，实现了可控的新视角合成和场景探索，以支持物理AI。

TLDR: VivaWorld introduces a framework for long-horizon, geometry-consistent video generation from a single image by combining reconstructed point clouds and generated meshes, along with a hybrid camera embedding, enabling controllable novel-view synthesis and scene exploration for physical AI.

Abstract: Long-horizon video generation is key to interactive world modeling, physical intelligence, and spatial reasoning, yet maintaining geometric consistency and accurate camera control remains challenging without 3D grounding. We introduce \textbf{VivaWorld}, a framework for generating geometry- and view-consistent long videos from an image. We first construct a compositional hybrid 3D representation that combines reconstructed point clouds, which preserve observed scene geometry and appearance, with generated textured meshes, which provide complete object geometry across $360^\circ$ novel views. We also introduce a connected-region filter removing inconsistent floating components for robust cross-view reconstruction and propose a hybrid camera embedding that combines global and object-anchored Plücker rays to capture both scene-level camera motion and camera-object relationships, and inject it together with the visual guidance into a video generation model via a control adapter. Extensive experiments show VivaWorld achieves state-of-the-art visual quality and camera control, while supporting controllable novel-view synthesis, long-horizon scene exploration, and physical AI. Project page is available at: https://research.nvidia.com/labs/sil/projects/vivaworld/

摘要（中文）：长时程视频生成是交互式世界建模、物理智能和空间推理的关键，然而，在没有3D grounding的情况下，保持几何一致性并实现精准的相机控制仍然充满挑战。我们提出 \textbf{VivaWorld}，一个从图像生成几何一致且视角一致的长时间视频的框架。我们首先构建一种组合式混合3D表示，将重建的点云与生成的带纹理网格相结合，其中点云保留观测到的场景几何与外观，网格则提供跨越 $360^\circ$ 新视角的完整物体几何。我们还引入一种连通域滤波器，去除不一致的漂浮成分，以实现鲁棒的跨视角重建，并提出一种混合相机嵌入方法，结合全局与物体锚定的普吕克射线，以捕捉场景级相机运动及相机与物体之间的关系，并通过控制适配器将其与视觉引导一起注入视频生成模型。大量实验表明，VivaWorld在视觉质量和相机控制方面达到了最先进水平，同时支持可控的新视角合成、长时程场景探索以及物理AI。项目主页：https://research.nvidia.com/labs/sil/projects/vivaworld/

Authors: Ying Jiang, Donglai Xiang, Anita Hu, Masha Shugrina

Lost on Campus: Evaluating Embodied Spatial Reasoning of Vision-Language Models in the Wild Other

Embodied Spatial Reasoning 3D Gaussian Splatting Closed-loop navigation Vision-Language Models Benchmark

简要说明：本文提出了Lost on Campus基准，用于在由3D高斯泼溅重建的大规模真实户外3D环境中评估视觉语言模型的具身空间推理能力，结合诊断性QA和闭环交互导航来评估六种空间推理能力。

TLDR: This paper introduces Lost on Campus, a benchmark for evaluating embodied spatial reasoning of vision-language models in large-scale real-world outdoor 3D environments reconstructed with 3D Gaussian Splatting, featuring diagnostic QA and closed-loop interactive navigation to assess six spatial reasoning capabilities.

Abstract: Embodied Spatial Reasoning (ESR) is central to deploying Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in real-world embodied tasks, yet remains inadequately evaluated. Existing benchmarks primarily assess spatial reasoning in static images or synthetic indoor environments, where semantic shortcuts often suffice, making it difficult to faithfully evaluate spatial reasoning capabilities in the wild. In light of this, we present Lost on Campus, a benchmark for evaluating ESR in large-scale real-world outdoor 3D environments reconstructed by 3D Gaussian Splatting. Our benchmark introduces a unified reasoning-action evaluation framework that seamlessly integrates diagnostic QA for isolated reasoning with closed-loop interactive navigation for active reasoning under multimodal instructions. To enable fine-grained diagnosis, we evaluate six capability aspects of ESR: action grounding, spatial foresight, metric awareness, goal-directed planning, ego-allocentric localization, and spatio-temporal consistency. Extensive experiments reveal that: (i) Compared to indoor settings, real-world outdoor environments impose substantially higher demands on spatial reasoning, where existing models exhibit poor performance; (ii) VLMs still struggle with fine-grained visual alignment, with failures in spatial foresight and ego-allocentric localization emerging as primary bottlenecks; (iii) Improving multimodal interaction capabilities and long-term spatial reasoning is crucial for advancing embodied intelligence. These findings highlight that faithful evaluation of ESR demands benchmarks tightly coupling perception, reasoning and action within realistic and continuous environments.

摘要（中文）：具身空间推理（ESR）对于在真实世界具身任务中部署视觉-语言模型（VLMs）至关重要，但目前仍未得到充分评估。现有基准主要评估静态图像或合成室内环境中的空间推理能力，在这些场景中，语义捷径往往足以解决问题，因此难以在真实环境中忠实评估空间推理能力。鉴于此，我们提出了Lost on Campus基准，用于评估由3D高斯泼溅重建的大规模真实世界室外3D环境中的ESR能力。该基准引入了一个统一的推理-行为评估框架，将针对孤立推理的诊断性问答与多模态指令下主动推理的闭环交互式导航无缝结合。为实现细粒度诊断，我们评估了ESR的六个能力维度：行为锚定、空间预判、度量感知、目标导向规划、自我中心-异我中心定位转换以及时空一致性。大量实验揭示：(i) 与室内环境相比，真实世界室外环境对空间推理提出了更高要求，现有模型在此表现不佳；(ii) VLMs在细粒度视觉对齐方面仍存在困难，其中空间预判和自我中心-异我中心定位转换的失败是主要瓶颈；(iii) 提升多模态交互能力和长期空间推理对于推动具身智能发展至关重要。这些发现表明，对ESR的忠实评估需要将感知、推理和行为紧密耦合于真实且连续的环境中的基准。

Authors: Zehan Zheng, Yanyuan Chen, Deming Li, Yutao Tang, Jianwen Xie, Alan Yuille, Jieneng Chen, Cheng Peng

Physicl Scenes: An Artist-created 3D Dataset for Learning Perception and Action Perception3D

3D dataset scene understanding mobile manipulation vision-language-action models embodied AI

简要说明：本文介绍了一个大型艺术家创建的3D场景数据集，包含丰富的注释，并展示了其在训练感知和操作模型方面的价值，包括一个用于VLA模型的移动操作基准。

TLDR: This paper introduces a large artist-created 3D dataset of indoor and outdoor scenes with rich annotations, and demonstrates its utility for training perception and manipulation models, including a mobile manipulation benchmark for VLA models.

Abstract: We present Physicl Scenes, a high-quality artist-created and curated dataset of 6,499 3D scenes spanning household rooms, public interiors, and outdoor spaces. The dataset combines detailed geometry, physically based materials, and carefully composed environments with object- and part-level semantic annotations, providing rich, joint supervision for visual and embodied learning. We demonstrate its value as training data across inverse rendering, 3D reconstruction, scene understanding, and mobile manipulation. Across these tasks, training state-of-the-art methods with our scenes improves performance over alternative synthetic datasets. In addition, we introduce a mobile manipulation benchmark, evaluating vision-language-action models performing physical pick and place in diverse 3D scenes with realistic layouts, and using our part annotations to also score where each object is grasped. Our dataset will be released publicly to facilitate research in visual and embodied AI.

摘要（中文）：我们提出了Physicl Scenes数据集，这是一个由艺术家创建并精心整理的高质量3D场景数据集，包含6，499个涵盖家庭房间、公共室内空间及户外场景的3D场景。该数据集结合了精细的几何结构、基于物理的材质以及精心编排的环境，并附带对象级和部件级的语义标注，为视觉与具身学习提供了丰富的联合监督信息。我们展示了其作为训练数据在逆渲染、三维重建、场景理解及移动操作等任务中的价值。在这些任务中，使用我们的场景训练最先进的方法，相较于其他合成数据集，性能均有所提升。此外，我们引入了一个移动操作基准，用于评估视觉-语言-动作模型在具有真实布局的多样化3D场景中执行物理拾取与放置任务的能力，并利用我们的部件标注对每个对象的抓取位置进行评分。我们的数据集将公开发布，以促进视觉与具身人工智能领域的研究。

Authors: Yueh-Cheng Liu, Snehal Jauhri, Matthias Nießner, Angela Dai

Normalizing Flows are Capable World Models WorldModel

normalizing flows world model action-conditioned prediction latent planning invertible encoder

简要说明：本文提出了归一化流世界模型（NFWM），通过可逆观测编码器与动作条件概率预测器，实现精确似然训练与潜在空间规划，并在游戏与机器人操作任务中验证了有效性。

TLDR: This paper introduces Normalizing-Flow World Model (NFWM), which pairs an invertible observation encoder with an action-conditioned probabilistic predictor, enabling exact likelihood training and latent-space planning across games and robotic manipulation tasks.

Abstract: A world model lets an agent anticipate the consequences of its actions and use imagined futures to make decisions. We introduce Normalizing-Flow World Model (NFWM), which pairs an invertible observation encoder with an action-conditioned probabilistic predictor. Because the encoder is invertible, the predicted distribution over latent states defines a distribution over future observations. Maximizing the exact conditional likelihood of those observations therefore trains the representation and dynamics jointly. An agent can plan directly in the learned latent space and decode sampled trajectories to inspect possible futures. On Teleport, these samples capture the two possible outcomes of the same action. In Flappy Bird, a world model trained by likelihood alone supports reward-based planning that reaches 100 pipes in all ten evaluated games. For goal-conditioned control, an auxiliary inverse-dynamics objective shapes the coordinates used to compare predicted states with a goal. On LIBERO, NFWM uses this distance to select successful action sequences more often than LeWM and SMWM. In Atari Boxing, training on imagined trajectories improves a policy beyond its behavior-cloned initialization. Together, these results establish normalizing flows as capable world models.

摘要（中文）：世界模型让智能体能够预测其行为的后果，并利用想象中的未来进行决策。我们引入了归一化流世界模型（NFWM），它将可逆的观测编码器与基于动作的条件概率预测器相结合。由于编码器是可逆的，潜状态上的预测分布定义了对未来观测的分布。因此，最大化这些观测的精确条件似然可以联合训练表示和动态模型。智能体可以直接在学习的潜空间中进行规划，并通过解码采样轨迹来检查可能的未来。在Teleport任务中，这些样本捕捉到了同一动作的两种可能结果。在Flappy Bird中，仅通过似然训练的世界模型支持基于奖励的规划，在全部十个评估游戏中均能达到100根管道。对于目标条件控制，辅助逆动态目标用于塑造用于比较预测状态与目标的坐标。在LIBERO上，NFWM利用这种距离选择成功动作序列的频率高于LeWM和SMWM。在Atari Boxing中，基于想象轨迹的训练使策略优于其行为克隆初始化。综合这些结果，确立了归一化流作为强大世界模型的能力。

Authors: Zijia Li, Yong-Hyun Park, Shusheng Yang, Jiatao Gu

Anytime-Valid Sequential Verification for Sensing-Efficient Robot Navigation under Perception Uncertainty Other

sequential verification robot navigation perception uncertainty sensing efficiency Gaussian likelihood ratio

简要说明：该论文提出了一种用于感知不确定性下机器人导航的随时有效顺序验证方法，在保持任务成功的同时减少了扫描次数。

TLDR: The paper introduces an anytime-valid sequential verification method for sensing-efficient robot navigation under perception uncertainty, which reduces scan counts while maintaining mission success in static-grid simulations.

Abstract: When a robot navigates an unfamiliar grid, noisy sensor readings can make it hard to tell whether the cells along its next move are free. Additional scans can reduce that uncertainty, but a fixed scan count spends the same sensing effort at every position. In a static-grid simulation, a sequential rule uses a Gaussian likelihood ratio to determine when the cells newly covered by the robot's footprint have enough evidence of free space. On 324 held-out scenarios from 18 public maps, the sequential gate and a four-scan reference chosen on validation data both completed every mission without an observed collision. With their respective validation-selected routing weights, the gate averaged 123.15 scans per episode versus 224.13 for the reference, a reduction of 45.05% (95% map-stratified bootstrap interval: 42.21--48.95%). In a retrospective check on the same scenarios with routing weights held equal, the reductions were 43.91% and 43.37% at the two tested weights, with all missions completed. On 216 scenarios from 12 previously unused maps, allocating more of the same certification error budget near the initial start--goal rectangle cut the sequential gate's scan count by a further 11.58%. The spatial variant completed 206 missions versus 208 for the original gate and increased computation time. The collision bound depends on the assumed observation model and footprint geometry. In a stress test with persistent per-cell bias, the original gate completed 0 of 54 missions.

摘要（中文）：当机器人在陌生网格中导航时，噪声传感器读数可能使其难以判断下一步移动所经过的单元是否空闲。额外扫描可以降低这种不确定性，但固定扫描次数会在每个位置消耗相同的感知资源。在静态网格仿真中，一种序贯规则利用高斯似然比来判断机器人足迹新覆盖的单元是否具有足够的空闲空间证据。在来自18张公开地图的324个保留场景中，序贯门控和基于验证数据选取的四次扫描参考均完成了所有任务，且未观察到碰撞。在各自基于验证集选取的路径权重下，门控方法每回合平均扫描123.15次，而参考方法为224.13次，减少了45.05%（95%地图分层自助法置信区间：42.21%—48.95%）。在相同场景下保持路径权重相等的回顾性检查中，两种测试权重下的减少幅度分别为43.91%和43.37%，且所有任务均完成。在来自12张先前未使用地图的216个场景中，将相同的认证误差预算更多分配在起点—终点矩形附近，使序贯门控的扫描次数进一步减少了11.58%。空间变体完成了206项任务，而原始门控完成了208项，且计算时间有所增加。碰撞界限取决于假定的观测模型和足迹几何形状。在具有持续逐单元偏差的压力测试中，原始门控在54项任务中完成了0项。

Authors: Saad Korchi, Abderrahim Waga

How Well Do Vision-Language Scene Graphs Serve as Memory for Embodied Question Answering? Other

embodied question answering scene graph memory answerability vision-language retained evidence

简要说明：本文探讨了视觉-语言场景图作为具身问答记忆的效果，发现即使经过定向修复，基于图的记忆仍不如问题类型先验，甚至降低准确性，因此主张在准确性之外同时评估保留证据的能力。

TLDR: This paper investigates the use of vision-language scene graphs as memory for embodied question answering, showing that even with targeted repairs, graph-based memory underperforms question-type priors and can lower accuracy, advocating for scoring retained evidence alongside answer accuracy.

Abstract: Embodied QA needs memory, but answer accuracy mixes retained evidence, reading errors and question priors. For a simulated multi-room scene-graph pipeline we define answerability: the fraction of questions a fixed rule-based reader answers correctly from the graph alone. The baseline recovers 24.1% of visible object types and its room labels flicker. Four targeted repairs double recall, raise answerability from 27.2% to 37.4%, and improve retrained QA from 71.4% to 75.9%, yet better object F1 can lower answerability. A question-type prior beats this reader on every predicted graph. In one real-video test, graph memory lowers accuracy. These exploratory findings favour scoring retained evidence alongside accuracy.

摘要（中文）：具身问答需要记忆，但答案准确率混合了保留证据、阅读错误和问题先验。针对一个模拟的多房间场景图流水线，我们定义了可回答性：一个基于规则的固定阅读器仅从图中正确回答问题的比例。基线方法恢复了24.1%的可见对象类型，但其房间标签存在闪烁现象。四项针对性修复使召回率翻倍，将可回答性从27.2%提升至37.4%，并将重新训练的问答准确率从71.4%提高至75.9%，然而更好的对象F1分数反而可能降低可回答性。在每一个预测图上，一种问题类型先验均优于该阅读器。在一次真实视频测试中，图记忆降低了准确率。这些探索性发现支持在准确率之外对保留证据进行评分。

Authors: Divyansh Pandey, Shubh Garg, Vedant Khandelwal, Niyati Rawal, Amit Sheth

Who Is Ego? Scaling Cross-View Camera Wearer Identification and Segmentation beyond Humans Perception3D

cross-view camera wearer identification epipole ego-exo segmentation

简要说明：本文提出了FindEgo-1M基准，用于跨视角相机佩戴者识别与分割，涵盖机器人、车辆等多样佩戴者，并提出了基于几何对极点约束的EgoRay方法，无需任务特定训练即可实现高效识别。

TLDR: This paper introduces FindEgo-1M, a large-scale benchmark for cross-view camera wearer identification and segmentation across diverse wearers including robots and vehicles, and proposes EgoRay, a method that leverages geometric epipole constraints to achieve training-free and trained performance without task-specific supervision.

Abstract: A first-person (ego) image reveals what a camera sees, but not who or what carries it. Given a synchronized third-person (exo) image, camera wearer identification asks who is ego: which candidate carries the ego camera? We extend this task beyond humans to robots, vehicles, animals, and drones, and broaden its spatial scope (where is ego) from selecting a provided candidate mask to wearer segmentation with absence prediction and mutual camera localization across ego-exo views. We introduce FindEgo-1M, comprising 1.16M real and simulated ego-exo pairs across 12 wearer types, 17 domains, and 111 test settings. Our approach exploits a geometric relation: the ego camera's projection into the exo image, i.e., the epipole, lies on or near its wearer. We introduce EgoRay-ZS, the first method to turn a frozen feed-forward 3D reconstruction model, VGGT-$Ω$, into a training-free solution for wearer identification and segmentation. Its geometric readout ranks candidate masks or segmentation proposals by angular offset and distance to the ego camera, while the relative pose provides mutual camera directions. We then develop the full EgoRay model through pose-supervised training on FindEgo-1M and label-free test-time adaptation constrained by candidate masks. Without task-specific training, EgoRay-ZS achieves 78.0% identification accuracy on TF2023's original labels, versus 52.9% reported for the dataset-trained PEN. On FindEgo-1M, EgoRay achieves state-of-the-art chance-corrected accuracy of 87.1 and 77.7 on seen and unseen settings. On matched queries, EgoRay also outperforms GPT-6 Astra by 31.6 and 21.3 points on seen and unseen settings, respectively, while running $18\times$ faster. Data, code, and models will be released.

摘要（中文）：第一人称（自我）图像揭示了相机所见的画面，但并未说明是谁或什么承载了该相机。给定一幅同步的第三人称（外部）图像，相机佩戴者识别任务旨在回答“谁是自我”：哪位候选者佩戴了自我相机？我们将该任务从人类扩展至机器人、车辆、动物和无人机，并将其空间范围（“自我在哪里”）从选择给定的候选掩码扩展至佩戴者分割（含缺席预测）以及跨自我—外部视图的相互相机定位。我们提出了FindEgo-1M数据集，包含116万对真实与模拟的自我—外部图像对，覆盖12种佩戴者类型、17个领域和111种测试设置。我们的方法利用了一种几何关系：自我相机在外部图像中的投影（即外极点）位于其佩戴者之上或附近。我们提出了EgoRay-ZS，这是首种将冻结的前馈三维重建模型VGGT-$Ω$转化为无需训练的佩戴者识别与分割解决方案的方法。其几何读出机制通过候选掩码或分割提议相对于自我相机的角偏移和距离进行排序，而相对位姿则提供相互相机方向。随后，我们通过在FindEgo-1M上进行位姿监督训练，并结合受候选掩码约束的无标签测试时自适应，开发了完整的EgoRay模型。在不进行任务特定训练的情况下，EgoRay-ZS在TF2023原始标签上的识别准确率达到了78.0%，而数据集训练的PEN报告准确率仅为52.9%。在FindEgo-1M上，EgoRay在已见和未见设置下分别实现了87.1和77.7的最新机会校正准确率。在匹配查询上，EgoRay在已见和未见设置下分别比GPT-6 Astra高出31.6和21.3个百分点，同时运行速度快$18\times$。数据、代码和模型将予以发布。

Authors: Yifan Jin, Zheng Zhang, Tianwen Qian, Dong Wang, Bo Zhao, Yanwei Fu, Yuqian Fu

Embodied Lower-limb Exoskeleton Assistance: Survey, Challenges, and Perspectives Locomotion

lower-limb exoskeleton embodied AI human-robot interaction adaptive control self-regulation

简要说明：本文综述了具身下肢外骨骼，从结构自适应、任务自适应、用户特定自适应和控制自我调节四个维度组织文献，并指出人机交互和物理辅助的挑战与未来方向。

TLDR: This paper surveys embodied lower-limb exoskeletons, organizing the literature around structural self-adaptation, task adaptation, user-specific adaptation, and control self-regulation, and outlines challenges and future directions for human-robot interaction and physical assistance.

Abstract: Over the past decade, artificial intelligence (AI) has enabled lower-limb exoskeletons to adapt to complex tasks and assist diverse users. Existing reviews, however, are organized around mechanical design, control strategies, or individual AI algorithms, and provide little systematic coverage of embodied lower-limb exoskeletons and their enabling technologies. This review defines embodied lower-limb exoskeletons and organizes the literature around four dimensions: structural self-adaptation, task adaptation, user-specific adaptation, and control self-regulation. In each dimension, state-of-the-art and representative studies are classified and discussed in terms of the associated challenges, including lightweight and compliant design, data acquisition and fusion, optimization of complex policies, and robust, compliant control. The review then identifies the principal limitations of current research and outlines future directions along these dimensions. From an embodied perspective, this review sets out the closed-loop relationship among mechanical structure, sensing, and control as a framework for analyzing lower-limb exoskeleton performance and for research on human-robot interaction. The directions it identifies point toward lightweight, comfortable, and practical physical assistance.

摘要（中文）：摘要：过去十年间，人工智能使得下肢外骨骼能够适应复杂任务并服务于多样化的用户群体。然而，现有综述多围绕机械设计、控制策略或单一人工智能算法展开，对于具身化下肢外骨骼及其使能技术的系统性覆盖相对不足。本综述对具身化下肢外骨骼进行了定义，并围绕四个维度组织文献：结构自适应、任务适应、用户个体适应以及控制自调节。在每个维度中，分别对前沿进展和代表性研究进行分类讨论，并针对相关挑战，包括轻量化与柔性设计、数据采集与融合、复杂策略优化以及鲁棒柔顺控制进行了深入分析。随后，本综述指出现有研究的主要局限性，并提出了沿这些维度的未来研究方向。从具身视角出发，本综述构建了机械结构、感知与控制之间的闭环关系框架，为下肢外骨骼性能分析与人机交互研究提供了参考。其指出的方向瞄准了轻质、舒适和实用的身体辅助技术。

Authors: Xiao-Yin Liu, Guotao Li, Robert Riener, Zeng-Guang Hou

LUDIUS: A Benchmark for Embodied Social Intelligence in Everyday Human-Robot Interactions Other

social intelligence vision-language models human-robot interaction benchmark embodied evaluation

简要说明：该论文介绍了LUDIUS，一个用于评估家用机器人视觉语言模型社会智能的基准，通过社会技能和居民互动来评估其基于上下文的语言和行为决策能力。

TLDR: This paper introduces LUDIUS, a benchmark for evaluating social intelligence in vision-language models for household robots, assessing their ability to make context-aware verbal and action decisions based on social skills and resident interactions.

Abstract: Social intelligence in a robot requires interpreting a situation from the perspectives of the people involved and using that understanding to decide when and how to act. We introduce LUDIUS, a benchmark for evaluating how vision-language models exercise this judgment through a robot's verbal responses and actions, organized around 15 social intelligence skills drawn from social psychology, sociology, and cognitive science. LUDIUS comprises six editions, each a collection of episodes spanning one simulated week. Three editions each cover all 15 skills in a different household. The other three focus on interactions involving multiple people, safety, and context-specific norms, respectively. We evaluate frontier models and a smaller model finetuned on social-interaction data we generated, using a common evaluation harness. The harness supplies each model with the robot's camera views and residents' reactions, retrieves relevant interaction history, and converts the model's tool calls into robot verbal responses and actions. Models tend to perform worse when they must reason about what a resident saw or heard earlier, reconcile competing interests, or fulfill a request within safety constraints and household rules. Beyond the home setting, LUDIUS's design pipeline offers a way to construct social intelligence benchmarks by translating social intelligence skills into context-specific judgments and observable robot behavior.

摘要（中文）：社交智能机器人需要从相关人员视角解读情境，并据此判断何时以及如何采取行动。我们引入LUDIUS，一个用于评估视觉-语言模型如何通过机器人的言语回应和行为来运用这种判断力的基准测试，该基准围绕从社会心理学、社会学和认知科学中提炼出的15项社交智能技能构建。LUDIUS包含六个版本，每个版本均由涵盖一个模拟周的系列片段组成。其中三个版本分别在不同家庭环境中覆盖全部15项技能，另外三个版本分别聚焦涉及多人的互动、安全以及情境特定规范。我们使用统一的评估框架，评估了前沿模型以及一个在我们生成的社交互动数据上微调的较小模型。该评估框架为每个模型提供机器人的摄像头视角和住户反应，检索相关的互动历史，并将模型的工具调用转化为机器人的言语回应和行为。当模型需要推断住户此前看到或听到了什么、协调相互冲突的利益，或在安全约束和家庭规则内完成请求时，其表现往往较差。在家庭环境之外，LUDIUS的设计流程提供了一种构建社交智能基准的方法，即将社交智能技能转化为情境特定的判断和可观察的机器人行为。

Authors: Chaewon Kim, Sangheon Lee, Seyeon Choi, Kangwook Lee, Yea Seul Kim

End-to-End Image-Goal Navigation for Agile Quadrotors via Recurrent State Distillation Other

image-goal navigation quadrotor recurrent state distillation vision-based policy agile flight

简要说明：本文提出了首个无需状态估计或速度控制器的图像目标导航策略，可直接从单目图像生成敏捷四旋翼的推力与角速度指令，在未知3D环境和真实世界零样本部署中均取得了高成功率。

TLDR: This paper presents the first image-goal navigation policy for agile quadrotors that directly commands thrust and angular rates from monocular images in unseen 3D environments, without relying on state estimation or a separate velocity controller, achieving high success rates in simulation and zero-shot on a real quadrotor.

Abstract: Image-goal navigation asks a robot to reach the viewpoint of a target photograph without a map or goal pose. In three dimensions, this requires not only recognizing the goal but also estimating 3D displacement and generating continuous control actions to approach and settle at the target view. This is difficult because the same visual difference between current and goal image can require very different actions depending on the robot's velocity, yet monocular images alone reveal neither metric scale nor body motion. As a result, existing image-goal policies are limited to planar action spaces and rely on a state estimator for flight control. Policies that map directly from images to low-level control commands have been demonstrated for agile flight, but not toward goal images in unseen environments. We present the first image-goal navigation policy that directly commands thrust and angular rates for agile quadrotor flight in unseen 3D environments, without relying on state estimation (e.g., SLAM, VO, or SfM) or a separate velocity controller. We train a recurrent vision-based policy through a four-stage pipeline that combines geometric and motion supervision with privileged-teacher distillation and end-to-end reinforcement learning fine-tuning. On 1000 held-out flights in unseen environments, the policy achieves an 82.3% success rate with a mean terminal position error of 0.10m across successful flights. Deployed zero-shot on a real quadrotor, the policy reaches an 84% success rate over 25 trials in an unseen indoor environment.

摘要（中文）：图像目标导航要求机器人在没有地图或目标位姿的情况下，到达目标照片所对应的视角位置。在三维空间中，这不仅需要识别目标，还需要估计三维位移，并生成连续的控制动作，以接近并稳定停留在目标视角处。这一任务的难点在于，当前图像与目标图像之间的相同视觉差异，可能因机器人速度的不同而需要截然不同的动作，然而单目图像本身既无法提供度量尺度信息，也无法反映机体运动状态。因此，现有的图像目标策略仅限于平面动作空间，并依赖状态估计器进行飞行控制。从图像直接映射到低层控制指令的策略已在敏捷飞行中得到验证，但尚未在未见环境中针对目标图像实现。本文提出了首个图像目标导航策略，该策略直接输出推力和角速率指令，用于在未见的三维环境中进行敏捷四旋翼飞行，且不依赖状态估计（如SLAM、视觉里程计或运动恢复结构）或独立的速率控制器。我们通过一个四阶段流程来训练基于循环网络的视觉策略，该流程结合了几何监督与运动监督、特权教师蒸馏以及端到端强化学习微调。在未见环境中进行的1000次保留飞行测试中，该策略实现了82.3%的成功率，成功飞行中的平均末端位置误差为0.10米。在真实四旋翼上零样本部署时，该策略在未见室内环境中的25次试验中达到了84%的成功率。

Authors: Simone Nascivera, Ismail Geles, Davide Scaramuzza

RegHarness: Regulating What Code-as-Policy Agents Keep from Steps to Skills Other

Code-as-Policy robotic manipulation skill refinement run-time governance no VLA

简要说明：RegHarness 为代码即策略的机器人智能体引入两级治理系统，控制步骤级执行和跨轮技能改进，在 LIBERO-PRO 上无需 VLA 策略便显著提高了成功率。

TLDR: RegHarness introduces a two-level governance system for Code-as-Policy robotic agents, controlling step-level execution and cross-run skill refinement, achieving significant success rate improvements on LIBERO-PRO without a VLA policy.

Abstract: Code-as-Policy agents generate, execute, and revise robot programs, but often lack explicit mechanisms to govern what persists across executions: which actions are retained within a trial and which code modifications carry over to subsequent runs. This leaves two critical aspects of agent behavior insufficiently controlled: step-level execution and cross-run adaptation. We present RegHarness, a two-level harness that governs both forms of persistence for the RATs agent team, without relying on a vision-language-action (VLA) policy or demonstrations. Within each trial, run-time governance evaluates each proposed step from a reset scene, replaying the committed steps, while a fixed-rule controller commits the step only when both RATs' verifier and a task-long LLM auditor approve it. Between runs, a coding agent uses logged failures to develop and test revisions to skills, primitives, and rules, which remain disabled by default until explicitly enabled by the authors. Using a single low-cost model across all run-time roles, RegHarness achieves an 87.8% success rate (158/180) on paired LIBERO-PRO trials, compared with 39.4% for RATs, and a 72.0% success rate on MolmoSpaces trials. A $2\times2$ ablation study of RegHarness's two levels shows that its skill refinement alone increases RATs' successful trials from 71 to 135, whereas run-time governance alone achieves 105 and RATs' native stepwise reset-and-replay mode achieves only 46. These findings suggest that, for Code-as-Policy agents operating with low-cost models, task success depends not only on how generated programs are executed, but also on the quality of the reusable skills they invoke and how those skills evolve across runs.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 基于代码即策略（Code-as-Policy）的智能体能够生成、执行并修订机器人程序，但往往缺乏显式机制来管理跨执行周期的持久化内容——即在一次试验中保留哪些动作，以及哪些代码修改会延续到后续运行。这导致智能体行为的两个关键方面未能得到充分控制：步骤级执行和跨运行自适应。我们提出RegHarness，一个双层管控框架，用于管理RATs智能体团队的两种持久化形式，且不依赖视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略或示范数据。在每次试验内部，运行时治理机制从重置场景出发，对每个提议步骤进行回放验证，而固定规则控制器仅在RATs验证器和任务级LLM审计员均批准该步骤时才予以提交。在每次运行之间，编码智能体利用记录下来的失败案例，对技能、基元和规则进行开发与测试修订，这些修订默认保持禁用状态，直到作者明确启用。仅使用单一低成本模型承担所有运行时角色，RegHarness在配对的LIBERO-PRO试验中实现了87.8%的成功率（158/180），而RATs为39.4%；在MolmoSpaces试验中实现了72.0%的成功率。对RegHarness两个层级的2×2消融研究表明，仅技能优化一项即可将RATs的成功试验次数从71提升至135，而仅运行时治理可达到105次，RATs原生逐步重置-回放模式仅为46次。这些发现表明，对于使用低成本模型运行的基于代码即策略的智能体，任务成功不仅取决于生成程序的执行方式，还取决于其所调用的可复用技能的质量以及这些技能在跨运行中的演进情况。

Authors: Shengming Liu, Yunyi Gao, Xinyi Wang, Jianyong Sun, Shuai Wang, Yi Deng, Li Chenye, Mingcai Zhou, Sim Kuan Goh

Lab2Sim: Agentic Generation of Interactive Laboratory Equipment from Operation Videos Other

agentic framework simulation asset generation laboratory equipment real-to-sim robot simulation

简要说明：Lab2Sim 是一个代理框架，可从操作视频生成可编辑、可仿真的实验室设备资产，其视觉保真度和交互能力优于基线，并支持可复用的机器人仿真环境。

TLDR: Lab2Sim is an agentic framework that generates editable, simulation-ready laboratory equipment assets from operation videos, achieving higher visual fidelity and interaction capability than baselines, and enabling reusable robotic simulation environments.

Abstract: Generating laboratory assets that faithfully reproduce the appearance, structure, and joint motions of real equipment remains challenging. Existing asset generation methods struggle to directly generate simulation assets for all equipment observed in operation videos and to faithfully reproduce the appearance, joint motions, and internal cavities of the real equipment. To address the challenge, we present Lab2Sim, an agentic framework that generates editable, simulation-ready laboratory equipment assets from egocentric or multi-view operation videos. Lab2Sim comprises four specialized agents. The Evidence Agent combines video observations with laboratory knowledge to specify equipment parts, materials, and functional requirements, which guide the Asset Agent in constructing editable Blender assets. The independent Verifier checks the generated geometry and appearance against the evidence and requirements, providing targeted feedback for revision. The Simulation Integration Agent converts verified Blender assets into simulation instances with physical properties and articulated mechanisms, using execution feedback to refine their behavior. Experiments on human and robot laboratory scenes show that Lab2Sim achieves higher visual fidelity and stronger interaction capability than coding-agent and real-to-sim baselines, including a Codex baseline using the same underlying model. We further demonstrate valve-controlled drainage and use the generated asset library to reproduce laboratory scenes and operations in RoboTwin, supporting reusable simulation environments for robotic laboratory tasks.

摘要（中文）：生成能够忠实再现真实设备外观、结构与关节运动的实验资产仍具挑战性。现有资产生成方法难以直接从操作视频中观测到的所有设备生成仿真资产，也无法忠实再现真实设备的外观、关节运动及内部空腔。为应对这一挑战，我们提出Lab2Sim，一个从第一视角或多视角操作视频中生成可编辑、可仿真实验设备资产的智能体框架。Lab2Sim由四个专门化智能体组成。证据智能体结合视频观测与实验知识，明确设备部件、材料及功能需求，引导资产智能体构建可编辑的Blender资产。独立验证器依据证据与需求对生成的几何结构与外观进行核查，并提供针对性修改反馈。仿真集成智能体将验证后的Blender资产转换为具有物理属性与关节机构的仿真实例，并利用执行反馈优化其行为。在人类与机器人实验场景上的实验表明，Lab2Sim在视觉保真度与交互能力上均优于编码智能体以及真实到仿真基线方法，包括使用相同底层模型的Codex基线。我们进一步展示了阀门控制排水功能，并利用生成的资产库在RoboTwin中复现实验场景与操作，为机器人实验任务提供可复用的仿真环境。

Authors: Yuxin Lin, Pei Ren, Yirong Yang, Xuxin Lv, Xingchuang Liao, Diyuan Hou, Jiale He, Zhengping Che, Yongfei Zhang, Wenjun Wu, Zhaoxin Fan

Do We Still Need Reinforcement Learning When We Can Read the World Model? WorldModel

LLM-based coding agents readable world models policy synthesis sequential decision-making model-based RL

简要说明：本文提出一种替代强化学习的方法：利用基于LLM的编码代理直接根据可读的世界模型源代码合成控制策略，在多个决策基准上以更少的交互经验达到竞争性能。

TLDR: This paper proposes an alternative to RL by using LLM-based coding agents to synthesize control policies directly from readable world model source code, achieving competitive performance with less interaction experience across decision-making benchmarks.

Abstract: Reinforcement learning has achieved remarkable success in sequential decision-making, but learning effective policies often requires substantial interaction experience. Model-based reinforcement learning alleviates this dependence by leveraging world models, which are typically used to support planning or policy optimization. In this paper, we investigate an alternative paradigm in which autonomous LLM-based coding agents directly synthesize control policies by reasoning over readable world models. By examining environment source code, these agents translate environmental knowledge into executable decision rules and iteratively refine their policies using online feedback or offline data, without task-specific RL training. Experiments across diverse decision-making benchmarks show that synthesized policies match or outperform conventional RL methods while requiring substantially less experience. Further analyses reveal interpretable decision rules and how they evolve through feedback-driven refinement. Comparisons with policies generated without source code access and experiments under challenging conditions further demonstrate the benefits of readable world models. These findings suggest that direct policy synthesis can reduce reliance on trial and error, challenging the necessity of task-specific RL training.

摘要（中文）：强化学习在序贯决策中已取得显著成功，但学习有效策略往往需要大量的交互经验。基于模型的强化学习通过利用世界模型来缓解这一依赖，通常用于支持规划或策略优化。在本文中，我们探讨了一种替代范式，即基于LLM的自主编码代理通过推理可读的世界模型直接合成控制策略。通过检查环境源代码，这些代理将环境知识转化为可执行的决策规则，并利用在线反馈或离线数据迭代优化其策略，而无需针对特定任务的强化学习训练。在多种决策基准上的实验表明，合成策略在匹配或超越传统强化学习方法的同时，所需经验大幅减少。进一步的分析揭示了可解释的决策规则及其通过反馈驱动细化而演化的过程。与未访问源代码生成的策略进行比较，以及在挑战性条件下的实验，进一步证明了可读世界模型的优势。这些发现表明，直接策略合成可以减少对试错的依赖，从而挑战了针对特定任务进行强化学习训练的必要性。

Authors: Mingchao Zhang, Miduo Cui, Kangze He, Yuanjun Li, Dapeng Li, Ce Zhang, Chuanchen Luo, Xue Yan, Mingzhe Xing, Zhumin Chen, Hangyu Mao, Bin Zhang, Zhiwei Xu

Embodied-VGGT: Preserving Reliable Local Geometry for Long-Sequence Reconstruction Perception3D

long-sequence reconstruction geometry preservation drift correction autonomous driving 3D reconstruction

简要说明：Embodied-VGGT 通过记忆增强地面块、超点对齐和跨环优化，在长序列三维重建中保留可靠的局部几何并减少漂移，显著提升驾驶场景重建精度。

TLDR: Embodied-VGGT introduces Memory-Augmented Grounded Chunks, Superpoint Alignment, and Cross-Loop Optimization to improve long-sequence 3D reconstruction for robotics and autonomous driving by preserving reliable local geometry and reducing drift.

Abstract: Long sequence reconstruction must correct accumulated drift while preserving locally consistent geometry. In robotics and autonomous driving, embodied acquisition provides recurring platform- environment geometry and repeated observations of scene structure and platform motion. We present Embodied-VGGT, which exploits these cues to establish reliable local relationships and selectively preserve them during global refinement. Memory-Augmented Grounded Chunks (MAGC) builds on Scal3R's global context memory and uses relative scale references derived from predicted ground geometry to regularize test-time memory updates, encouraging cross-chunk consistency while limiting changes to reliable local geometry. Superpoint Alignment (SA) and Cross-Loop Optimization (CL) jointly address the robust establishment and preservation of geometric relationships. SA balances ground and non-ground evidence across spatial regions to estimate inter-chunk translation. CL uses geometric and motion consistency across interleaved windows to select coherent chunk groups, each receiving a shared Sim(3) correction that preserves its internal relative transformations during global optimization. Experiments on five public driving benchmarks demonstrate consistent and substantial improvements in long sequence reconstruction. On KITTI Odometry, Embodied-VGGT achieves a mean absolute trajectory error of 7.30 m and a Chamfer distance of 2.67 m, reducing these errors by 46.8% and 23.3% compared with the state-of-the-art baseline under same evaluation protocol. To facilitate reproducibility, we released our code: https://github.com/Ang-Sheep/Embodied-VGGT.

摘要（中文）：长序列重建必须在校正累积漂移的同时保持局部一致的几何结构。在机器人和自动驾驶领域，具身采集提供了重复出现的平台-环境几何关系，以及对场景结构和平台运动的重复观测。我们提出Embodied-VGGT，利用这些线索建立可靠的局部关联，并在全局优化过程中选择性地加以保留。记忆增强地面块（MAGC）基于Scal3R的全局上下文记忆，利用从预测地面几何中导出的相对尺度参考来正则化测试时的记忆更新，在限制对可靠局部几何改变的同时促进跨块一致性。超点对齐（SA）与跨环优化（CL）共同解决了几何关系的稳健建立与保留问题。SA在空间区域上平衡地面与非地面证据，以估计块间平移。CL利用交错窗口间的几何与运动一致性选择连贯的块组，每个块组获得共享的Sim(3)校正，从而在全局优化中保留其内部相对变换。在五个公开驾驶基准上的实验表明，所提方法在长序列重建方面取得了持续且显著的改进。在KITTI里程计数据集上，Embodied-VGGT实现了7.30米的平均绝对轨迹误差和2.67米的Chamfer距离，与相同评估协议下最先进的基线相比，分别降低了46.8%和23.3%。为促进可复现性，我们已公开代码：https://github.com/Ang-Sheep/Embodied-VGGT。

Authors: Yiheng Han, Ziang Chen, Zhuyong Fu, Yiqing Yin, Nan Ma

WorldUAV: Scaling UAV Data Synthesis via World Models WorldModel

UAV detection data synthesis world models multimodal large language model agentic pipeline

简要说明：WorldUAV 提出了一种基于世界模型的 UAV 检测与跟踪数据合成框架，通过将 UAV 无缝插入真实世界视频来生成高质量数据，并利用多模态大语言模型驱动的智能体流程实现自动化，实验证明该数据集能显著提升检测器性能且成本极低。

TLDR: WorldUAV presents a world model-based framework for synthesizing realistic UAV detection and tracking data by seamlessly integrating UAVs into real-world videos, using an agentic LLM pipeline for automated construction, demonstrating improved detector performance with low-cost data generation.

Abstract: UAV detection and tracking remain constrained by the scarcity of high-quality training data. Existing game-engine-based synthetic UAV data suffer from a substantial synthetic-to-real gap, while the high cost of manually collected real-world UAV data limits dataset scale. Therefore, we introduce WorldUAV, a high-quality UAV dataset constructed through an efficient framework powered by world models. Specifically, WorldUAV directly integrates UAVs into readily available real-world videos, naturally preserving realistic backgrounds, illumination, and scene dynamics. Leveraging the spatiotemporal priors of world models, it generates UAV videos with plausible motion, pose variations, and cross-frame consistency, effectively narrowing the gap between synthetic and real data. We further develop an agentic pipeline orchestrated by a multimodal large language model that acquires sources, plans UAV trajectories, invokes synthesis, and verifies generated videos, enabling fully automated dataset construction. WorldUAV comprises 6,878 UAV videos and 205,778 UAV images. Experiments show that WorldUAV significantly improves the performance of UAV detectors. Moreover, it substantially reduces dataset construction costs, requiring only 15 seconds and USD 0.0005 API cost per high-quality UAV image. Our work offers both a high-quality dataset and a scalable data generation paradigm for UAV detection and tracking.

摘要（中文）：无人机检测与跟踪仍受限于高质量训练数据的稀缺性。现有基于游戏引擎生成的合成无人机数据存在显著的合成与真实之间的差距，而人工采集真实世界无人机数据的高昂成本则限制了数据集的规模。为此，我们提出了WorldUAV——一种通过由世界模型驱动的高效框架构建的高质量无人机数据集。具体而言，WorldUAV直接将无人机融入现成的真实世界视频中，自然保留真实的背景、光照和场景动态。借助世界模型的时空先验，它生成具有合理运动、姿态变化和跨帧一致性的无人机视频，有效缩小了合成数据与真实数据之间的差距。我们进一步开发了一条由多模态大语言模型协调的智能代理流水线，该流水线能够获取源视频、规划无人机轨迹、调用合成功能并验证生成视频，从而实现全自动化的数据集构建。WorldUAV包含6，878个无人机视频和205，778张无人机图像。实验表明，WorldUAV显著提升了无人机检测器的性能。此外，它大幅降低了数据集构建成本，每张高质量无人机图像仅需15秒和0.0005美元的API费用。我们的工作为无人机检测与跟踪提供了高质量数据集和可扩展的数据生成范式。

Authors: Xuewen Liu, Mengjuan Chen, Jing Zhang, Mengzhe Shen, Zekun Xu, Zibo Chen, Zuoxiu Zhang, Yue Dong, Zhikai Li, Qingyi Gu

DreamTour: Layout Steering for Training-Free World Exploration WorldModel

video diffusion training-free camera control world model layout steering

简要说明：DreamTour是一种无需训练的方法，利用冻结的图像修补和基于深度的渲染，从单张图像生成具有更精确相机运动控制的视频导览，提高了视频扩散模型和世界模型在方向准确性和行进校准上的表现。

TLDR: DreamTour is a training-free framework that uses frozen image inpainting and depth-based rendering to generate camera-controlled video tours from a single image, improving directional accuracy and travel calibration in video diffusion and world models.

Abstract: Video diffusion and world models generate plausible videos but do not reliably match the requested camera direction and travel distance. We present DreamTour, a training-free framework that generates camera tours from a single image with more accurate control over camera motion. DreamTour first uses a frozen image inpainting prior to extend the photograph beyond its original field of view while preserving the input pixels. Depth-based rendering of this extended scene along the requested camera path produces approximate target views that serve as spatial guidance. We introduce Layout Steering, which aligns early video latents with these views through decaying low-frequency corrections, leaving later denoising to refine appearance and dynamics. For longer tours, we autoregressively generate the video segments, repeating guidance construction from each segment's final frame to maintain camera control across the full trajectory. DreamTour improves directional accuracy and travel calibration on VBench while maintaining competitive video quality. On WorldScore, it strengthens camera control and scene consistency across chained movements. Together, these results demonstrate that training-free spatial guidance enables more accurate and consistent camera control in pretrained video diffusion and world models.

摘要（中文）：视频扩散模型和世界模型能够生成逼真的视频，但无法可靠地匹配所请求的摄像机方向和移动距离。我们提出了DreamTour，一种无需训练的视频生成框架，能够从单张图像生成摄像机漫游视频，并对摄像机运动实现更精确的控制。DreamTour首先利用冻结的图像修复先验，在保留原始像素的同时将照片扩展到其原始视野之外。基于深度的渲染将该扩展场景沿指定摄像机路径渲染，生成近似的目标视图，作为空间引导。我们引入了布局引导（Layout Steering）机制，通过衰减的低频修正将早期视频潜变量与这些视图对齐，而后续的去噪过程则负责细化外观和动态。对于更长的漫游，我们自回归地生成视频片段，从每个片段的最后一帧重复构建引导，从而在整个轨迹中保持摄像机控制。DreamTour在VBench基准上提升了方向准确性和行进校准精度，同时保持了具有竞争力的视频质量。在WorldScore基准上，它增强了链式运动中的摄像机控制和场景一致性。综合实验结果表明，无需训练的空间引导能够为预训练的视频扩散模型和世界模型带来更精确、更一致的摄像机控制。

Authors: Srikumar Sastry, Meher Gitika Karumuri, Chenqi Li, Sarosij Bose, Mellon Zhang, Allen Tu, Ziyang Long, Yen-Liang Lin, Alexander Schwing, Nathan Jacobs

Distractor-Robust Reinforcement Learning via Variational Bisimulation RLRobot

model-based reinforcement learning bisimulation distractor-robust latent representations Dreamer

简要说明：VIBES 用对抗性潜在目标替代 MBRL 中的像素重建，强制奖励和动态充分性，从而在 Distracting Control Suite、ManiSkill 和 100 链接游泳者上获得对干扰鲁棒的表示。

TLDR: VIBES replaces pixel reconstruction in MBRL with an adversarial latent objective enforcing reward and dynamics sufficiency, yielding distractor-robust representations for control across Distracting Control Suite, ManiSkill, and a 100-link swimmer.

Abstract: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) promises data efficiency and generalization, but typical reconstruction-based objectives encourage models to waste representational capacity on task-irrelevant distractors. We introduce VIBES (Variational Inference for Bisimulation-based Encoded States), a new objective that replaces pixel reconstruction with an adversarial term, which enforces that latent states suffice to predict both rewards and the next latent state. We show that this objective measures how far the encoder is from reward and dynamics sufficiency, and that whenever exact sufficiency is attainable, its global optima induce bisimulation relations on histories. Combined with a fixed-capacity latent bottleneck, this encourages latent states to retain task-relevant information while discarding irrelevant variation. Our method serves as a drop-in replacement for Dreamer's model-learning component, achieves state-of-the-art performance on the Distracting Control Suite, and extends to visually complex manipulation in Realistic ManiSkill. Unlike prior approaches, it does not rely on image-specific augmentations and applies equally well to high-dimensional vector-state tasks, demonstrated on a 100-link swimmer robot. Finally, latent-space analyses (UMAP embeddings and nearest-neighbor probes) confirm that the learned representations are sensitive to task-relevant structure while invariant to distractors.

摘要（中文）：基于模型的强化学习（MBRL）在数据效率和泛化能力方面具有显著优势，但典型的基于重建的目标函数会促使模型将表征能力浪费在与任务无关的干扰因素上。我们提出了VIBES（基于双模拟的编码状态变分推断），一种新的目标函数，用对抗项取代像素重建，从而确保潜在状态足以同时预测奖励和下一潜在状态。我们证明了该目标函数衡量了编码器距离奖励充分性和动力学充分性之间的差距，并且当精确充分性可实现时，其全局最优解会在历史轨迹上诱导出双模拟关系。结合固定容量的潜在瓶颈，该方法促使潜在状态保留与任务相关的信息，同时丢弃无关的变化。我们的方法可作为Dreamer模型学习组件的即插即用替代方案，在Distracting Control Suite上达到了最先进的性能，并扩展至Realistic ManiSkill中视觉复杂的操作任务。与现有方法不同，本方法不依赖图像特定的数据增强，并且同样适用于高维向量状态任务，在具有100个链接的游泳机器人上得到了验证。最后，潜在空间分析（UMAP嵌入和最近邻探测）证实了所学习的表征对任务相关结构敏感，同时对干扰因素保持不变。
